Gen: Ekuthomeni uZimu wabumba izulu nephasi.
Iphasi belingakabi nesimo begodu belingenalitho. Ubumnyama bebusibekele amanzi atjhingileko, begodu uMoya kaZimu bewukhamba phezu kwamanzi.
UZimu wathi: "Akube khona ukukhanya." Ukukhanya kwaba khona.
UZimu wabona bona ukukhanya kuhle. Wehlukanisa ukukhanya nobumnyama.
UZimu wabiza ukukhanya bona "mini", ubumnyama wabubiza bona "busuku". Kwaba kusihlwa, kwaba kusasa. Bekulilanga lokuthoma.
UZimu wathi: "Akube khona isikhala esivulekileko phakathi kwamanzi, sehlukanise amanzi abe ziingaba ezimbili."
Ngalokho uZimu wenza isikhala esivulekileko. Wehlukanisa amanzi angaphasi kwaso namanzi angaphezu kwaso. Kwenzeka njengombana atjhilo.
UZimu wabiza isikhala esivulekileko bona "sibhakabhaka". Kwaba kusihlwa, kwaba kusasa. Bekulilanga lesibili.
UZimu wathi: "Amanzi angaphasi kwesibhakabhaka akabuthelane endaweni yinye, ukobana kubonakale iphasi elomileko." Kwenzeka njengombana atjhilo.
UZimu wabiza iphasi elomileko bona "mhlaba", amanzi abuthelaneko wawabiza bona "malwandle". UZimu wabona bona kuhle.
UZimu wathi: "Umhlaba awumilise iimila: iimila eziluhlaza ezithela imbewu, neemithi ethela iinthelo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo." Kwenzeka njengombana atjhilo.
Umhlaba wamilisa iimila ezithela imbewu, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo, neemithi ethela iinthelo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo. UZimu wabona bona kuhle.
Kwaba kusihlwa, kwaba kusasa. Bekulilanga lesithathu.
UZimu wathi: "Akube khona iinkhanyiso esibhakabhakeni zehlukanise imini nobusuku. Azibe ziimphawu ezitjengisa iinkhathi zomnyaka, amalanga neminyaka.
Azikhanye esibhakabhakeni zinikele iphasi ukukhanya." Kwenzeka njengombana atjhilo.
UZimu wenza iinkhanyiso ezimbili ezikhulu: esikhulu sibuse imini, esincani sibuse ubusuku. Wenza neenkwekwezi.
UZimu wazibeka esibhakabhakeni bona zinikele iphasi ukukhanya,
zibuse imini nobusuku, begodu zehlukanise ukukhanya nobumnyama. UZimu wabona bona kuhle.
Kwaba kusihlwa, kwaba kusasa. Bekulilanga lesine.
UZimu wathi: "Amanzi akazale iinto eziphilako, begodu iinyoni azibhabhe phezu kwephasi esibhakabhakeni esivulekileko."
Ngalokho uZimu wabumba iinto ezikhulu zelwandle neenhlobo zoke zeento eziphilako ezikhamba emanzini. Wabumba neenhlobo zoke zeenyoni. UZimu wabona bona kuhle.
UZimu wazibusisa wathi: "Zalanani nande. Zalisani amanzi weenlwandle, begodu iinyoni azande ephasini."
Kwaba kusihlwa, kwaba kusasa. Bekulilanga lesihlanu.
UZimu wathi: "Umhlaba awuveze iinto eziphilako, ngayinye ngohlobo lwayo: izifuyo, iinto ezincani ezihuquzela emhlabathini, neenlwana zeganga." Kwenzeka njengombana atjhilo.
UZimu wenza iinlwana zeganga, izifuyo neento zoke ezincani ezihuquzela emhlabathini, ngayinye ngohlobo lwayo. UZimu wabona bona kuhle.
UZimu wathi: "Asenze abantu ngesifaniso sethu, bafane nathi. Ababuse iinhlapi zelwandle, iinyoni zesibhakabhaka, izifuyo, iphasi loke, neento zoke ezincani ezihuquzela emhlabathini."
Ngalokho uZimu wabumba abantu ngesifaniso sakhe. Wababumba ngesifaniso sakaZimu. Wababumba bayindoda nomfazi.
UZimu wababusisa wathi kibo: "Belethani abantwana nande. Zalisani iphasi, nilitjheje begodu nilibuse. Busani iinhlapi zelwandle, iinyoni zesibhakabhaka neento zoke eziphilako ezikhamba ephasini."
UZimu wathi: "Qalani! Nginiphe iimila zoke ephasini loke ezithela imbewu, neemithi yoke ethela iinthelo ezinembewu. Zizokuba kudla kwenu.

Begodu eenlwaneni zoke zephasi, eenyonini zoke zesibhakabhaka nakizo zoke iinto ezihuquzela emhlabathini, koke okunomphefumulo wokuphila, nginikela iimila zoke eziluhlaza bona zibe kudla." Kwenzeka njengombana atjhilo.
UZimu waqala koke ebekakwenzile, begodu bekuhle khulu. Kwaba kusihlwa, kwaba kusasa. Bekulilanga lesithandathu.
Ngalokho izulu nephasi kwaqedwa, kanye nakho koke okukhona kikho.
Ngelanga lesikhombisa uZimu bekasaqede umsebenzi ebekawenza. Ngalokho ngelanga lesikhombisa waphumula emsebenzini wakhe woke.
UZimu walibusisa ilanga lesikhombisa walenza lacwengeka, ngombana ngalelo langa waphumula emsebenzini woke wokubumba ebekawenzile.
Le yindaba yezulu nephasi nakubunjwa, ngesikhathi iKosi uZimu yenza iphasi nezulu.
Bekungekho isihlahlana ephasini, begodu bekungekho isimila ebesimilile emasimini. IKosi uZimu beyingakanisi izulu ephasini, begodu bekungekho umuntu wokulima umhlabathi.
Kodwana inkungu yenyuka ephasini yathelela woke umhlabathi.
IKosi uZimu yabumba indoda ngethuli lomhlabathi. Yaphefumulela umoya wokuphila emakhaleni wendoda, indoda yaba siphilo esiphilako.
IKosi uZimu yatjala isivande ngepumalanga, e-Edeni. Lapho yabeka indoda ebeyiyibumbile.
IKosi uZimu yamilisa iinhlobo zoke zemithi emhlabathini. Beyihle ukuqalwa begodu ilungele ukudliwa. Phakathi kwesivande bekume umuthi wokuphila nomuthi wokwazi okuhle nokumbi.
Umlambo bewugeleza uphuma e-Edeni ukuthelela isivande. Ukusuka lapho wahlukana waba milambo emine.
Umlambo wokuthoma ubizwa bona yiPishoni. Ugeleza uzungeleza ilizwe loke leHavila, lapho kunegolide khona.
Igolide lelo lizwe lihlwengekile. Kutholakala nenhlaka enuka kamnandi nelitje eliligugu le-onikisi.
Umlambo wesibili ubizwa bona yiGihoni. Ugeleza uzungeleza ilizwe loke leKushi.
Umlambo wesithathu ubizwa bona yiTigrisi. Ugeleza ngepumalanga ye-Asiriya. Umlambo wesine yi-Ewufrathe.
IKosi uZimu yathatha indoda yayibeka esivandeni se-Edeni bona ilime umhlabathi begodu iwutjheje.
IKosi uZimu yanikela indoda umyalo lo: "Ukhululekile ukudla kinanyana ngimuphi umuthi esivandeni,
kodwana ungadli emuthini wokwazi okuhle nokumbi. Ngelanga ozokudla kiwo, ngeqiniso uzokufa."
IKosi uZimu yathi: "Akukuhle bona indoda ibe yodwa. Ngizoyenzela umsizi oyifaneleko kuhle."

Ngomhlabathi iKosi uZimu yabumba iinlwana zoke zeganga neenyoni zoke zesibhakabhaka. Yaziletha endodeni ukubona bona izozibiza ngaliphi ibizo. Nanyana ngiliphi ibizo indoda elinikela isiphilo ngasinye esiphilako, laba libizo laso.
Ngalokho indoda yathiya izifuyo zoke amabizo, neenyoni zesibhakabhaka neenlwana zoke zeganga. Kodwana u-Adamu bekanganaye umsizi omfaneleko kuhle.
Ngalokho iKosi uZimu yalalisa indoda ubuthongo obukhulu. Ngesikhathi isalele, uZimu wathatha olunye lweembambo zendoda, wavala leyondawo ngenyama.
IKosi uZimu yenza umfazi ngembambo ebeyiyikhuphe endodeni, yamletha endodeni.
Indoda yathi: "Ekugcineni! Lo mumuntu olithambo lamathambo wami nenyama yenyama yami. Uzokubizwa bona 'mfazi', ngombana uthethwe endodeni."
Kungebanga lokho indoda itjhiya uyise nonina, inamathele kumkayo, begodu boke ababili baba nyama yinye.
Indoda nomkayo boke ababili bebanqunu, kodwana bebangazizweli iinhloni.
Inyoka beyihlakaniphe ukudlula zoke iinlwana zeganga iKosi uZimu ebeyizenzile. Yathi kumfazi: "Kghani kuliqiniso bona uZimu uthe, 'Ningadli kinanyana ngimuphi umuthi esivandeni'?"
Umfazi waphendula inyoka wathi: "Singadla iinthelo zemithi esesivandeni.
Kodwana ngomuthi ophakathi kwesivande, uZimu uthe: 'Ningadli iinthelo zawo. Ningawuthinti nokuwuthinta, ukobana ningafi.'"
Inyoka yathi kumfazi: "Anikukufa!
UZimu uyazi bona lokha nidla kiwo, amehlo wenu azokuvuleka. Nizokufana noZimu, nazi okuhle nokumbi."

Umfazi wabona bona isithelo somuthi besilungele ukudliwa begodu sihle ukuqalwa, nokobana besifiseka ngombana singenza umuntu abe nokuhlakanipha. Ngalokho wathatha ezinye iinthelo wadla. Wanikela nendodakhe ebeyinaye, nayo yadla.
Amehlo wabo boke ababili avuleka, babona bona banqunu. Ngalokho bathunga amakhasi womkhiwa bazenzela izembatho.
Ngesikhathi esipholileko selanga, bezwa itjhada leKosi uZimu ikhamba esivandeni. Indoda nomkayo bacatjha iKosi uZimu phakathi kwemithi yesivande.
Kodwana iKosi uZimu yabiza indoda yathi: "Uphi?"
Yaphendula yathi: "Ngikuzwile esivandeni, ngesaba ngombana nginqunu. Ngalokho ngicatjhile."
UZimu wabuza wathi: "Ngubani okutjele bona unqunu? Kghani udlile emuthini ebengikuyale bona ungadli kiwo?"
Indoda yathi: "Umfazi ombeke lapha nami unginikele isithelo somuthi, ngadla."
IKosi uZimu yathi kumfazi: "Yini le oyenzileko?" Umfazi wathi: "Inyoka ingikhohlisile, ngadla."

Ngalokho iKosi uZimu yathi enyokeni: "Ngombana wenze lokhu, uqalekisiwe ukudlula zoke izifuyo neenlwana zoke zeganga. Uzokuhuquzela ngesisu sakho, begodu uzokudla ithuli woke amalanga wokuphila kwakho.
Ngizokwenza bona wena nomfazi nibe zizitha, neenzukulwana zakho neenzukulwana zakhe zibe zizitha. Yena uzokuchoboza ihloko yakho, wena uzokuluma isithende sakhe."
Kumfazi yathi: "Ngizokwandisa khulu ubuhlungu bakho nawuthwele. Uzokubeletha abantwana ngobuhlungu. Uzokufisa indodakho, yona izokubusa."

Ku-Adamu yathi: "Ulalele umkakho wadla isithelo somuthi ebengikuyale bona ungadli kiwo. Ngalokho umhlabathi uqalekisiwe ngebanga lakho. Woke amalanga wokuphila kwakho kuzokufuze usebenze budisi bona uthole ukudla kiwo.
Uzokumilisela ameva neenhlahla ezihlabako, begodu uzokudla iimila zeganga.
Uzokujuluka bona uthole isinkwa sakho bekube kulapho ubuyela emhlabathini, ngombana uthethwe kiwo. Ulithuli, begodu uzokubuyela ethulini."
U-Adamu wathiya umkakhe ibizo lokobana ngu-Efa, ngombana bekazokuba nguunina wabo boke abaphilako.
IKosi uZimu yenzela u-Adamu nomkakhe izembatho ngamakhumba weenlwana, yabembatha.

IKosi uZimu yathi: "Qala, nje umuntu sele afana nomunye wethu, ngokwazi okuhle nokumbi. Akukafaneli avunyelwe ukwelula isandla sakhe, athathe nesithelo somuthi wokuphila, asidle bese aphila ngokungapheliko."
Ngalokho iKosi uZimu yamkhupha esivandeni se-Edeni bona alime umhlabathi ebekathethwe kiwo.

Ngalokho-ke, ungakhathazeki; ngizokulethela wena kanye nezingane zakho. "Uthe ke wabasabisa, futhiranjela ngenhliziyo sabo.
Wahlala uYosefu eYiputa, yena nomndeni wonke kayise; waphila uYosefu iminyaka eyikhulu nesigamu.

Wathi uYosefu kubazalwane bakhe, Ngizofa; kodwana uzimu uzokubonani ngokuqinisekile, begodu uzozikhuphula nisuka kule lizwe liya ezweni ebelibhekwa nguAbrahama noIsake noYakobi.
UYusufu wathatha isibopho esiqinile, wathi kubo: "Uma uzimu efika ukukusizani, khona-ke kufanele nizikhuphule izicubu zami ponad pleva.

Exod: Lawona amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, abafika eYiputa noYakobi, wonke umuntu nomndeni wakhe:
uRubhene, noSimeoni, noLevi, noYuda;
uIssakha, noZebuloni, noBhenjamini,
uDani noNaphtali, uGadi noAsheri.
Wonke umndeni kaYakobi, owaphuma emilenzeni yakhe, waba ngumuntu oyisixhenxe. UYosefu wayesele eYiputa.
Wafa uYosefu, nabazalwane bakhe bonke, nabo bonke abantu baleso sikhathi.
Bakhulela ke amadodana aseSirayeli, bakhula bekhula, babe namandla amakhulu khulu; izwe lagcwele ngawo.
Kwaphuma ukumkani omusha phezu kweYiputa, ongakaze ayazi uYosefu.
Wathi kubo abantu bakhe, Thola, abantu bakaSirayeli baningi kunathi, begodu banamandla kunathi.
Hamba, sibhekene nabo ngokuzimela, noma bangakhula khulu; uma kwenzeka umkhosi, bangakwazi ukujoyina abasolwa bethu, bazinqobe nathi, bashiye izwe.
Bathi ama-Egyptians abeke phezu kwabo abaphathi, ukuba basebenzele ngemisebenzi enzima; begodu bakwakha iPithom, neRaamses, imiphakathi yokugcina izinto, uFaro.
Kodwana uma bebacindezela khulu, bakhulela khulu, bakhulule khulu; begodu abaMishi bakhathazekile ngenxa yamadodana aseSirayeli.
I-Egyptians yacindezela abantu baseSirayeli ukuba basebenze ngaphandle kothando.
Bakwenza impilo sabo ibe buhlungu ngomsebenzi onzima, ngokwenza ingilazi, nokwenza amatshe, nokwenza yonke imisebenzi yasendaweni; emisebenzini sabo yonke, abaMishi abengabazi.
Wathi ukumkani waseMisri ezibhedlela zesiHebhere, izibhedlela zokubelethisa; igama lomunye lalinguShifra, negama lomunye linguPua.
Wathi, "Uma nisiza iziHebhere bona zikhulelwe, begodu nibona ezibhedlela bona zikhulelwe, uma kuzalwa umntwana umfazi, bulala yena; kodwana uma kuzalwa indodakazi, ahlale ephila.
Kodwana labo ababelethisi bagwema uzimu, bangakwenzanga njengokuthi ukumkani waseYiputa kubo; bagcine izingane zamadoda ziphila.
Wathi ukumkani waseMisri, wabiza labo ababelethisi, wathi kubo, Kungani na bona nikwenze lokhu? Kungani na bona nigcine izingane zamadoda ziphila?
Wathi uFaro, ngombana amakhosikazi aseHebhere awafana namadodakazi aseMisri; ngenxa yokuthi anamandla khulu; ngaphambi kokuba afike khona umfazi, bakhulela.
uzimu wakwenza kahle labo abakhulelwa; abantu bakhula, babe namandla khulu.
Nokho, ngenxa yokuthi labo ababelethisi bakhathazekile ngoNkulunkulu, uzimu wabanika izingane.
Wathi uFarawo kubo bonke abantu bakhe, uthi: Wonke umfana ozalwa eSirayeli niwuthule emfuleni iNil, kodwana onke amantombazane ahlale eduze.
Kwaba khona umuntu wesizwe sakwaLevi, washada nomkakhe umfazi wasesizwe sakwaLevi.
Wayekhulelwa, wazala indodana. Yabona bona ubukeka kahle, yafihla ingane iminyaka emithathu, yazibuza bona: "Ubani lo mntwana?

Lapho engakaze ikwazi ukumfihla ngaphezu kwalokho, yathola inkomishi eyenziwe ngezinkuni begodu yayigqoka nge-tar ukuze amanzi angeke afike ngaphakathi. Yabeka ingane kuyo begodu yamisa phakathi kwezihlahla eziphakeme ngaphesheya komfula
Udadewabo wahlala eduze ukuze abone bona kuzokwenzekani kuye.
Kwathi uma inkosikazi kaFaro ikhuphuka elwandle ukuze ihlanzwe, begodu izisebenzi zayo zihamba ngaphesheya komfula, yabona ibhokisi phakathi kwezinkomo, yathumela umkhonzi wayo bona ayithole.
Yavula, yabona ingane. Wayenyamalala, wazama ukumsindisa, wathi: "Lena enye yezingane zesiHebhere."
Wathi indodakazi kaFaro, Ingabe ngizoya ngifuna umfazi waseHebroni, ukuze akulelise lo mntwana?
Wathi indodakazi kaFaro, Yeka, uye; wahamba udadewabo, wamthatha umngane wakhe.
Wathi kuye indodana kaFaro, Thola lo mntwana, uyidlele; begodu ngizokulethela imali yakho. Wathatha uwesifazane lo mntwana, wayidlalela.
Wakhula lo mntwana, uthethwe yinkosikazi kaFaro, waba ngunyana wayo; yabiza igama lakhe bona uMoses; ngombana, kusho yena, ngawukhipha emanzini.
UMoses, lapho eneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala, waphuma waya ezweni lakwaHebhere. Wabona umsebenzi wabo onzima; wabona umuntu waseMisri eshaya umuntu waseHebhere, owayengumuntu wakhe.
UMoses wabheka ngapha nangapha, nakabona bona akukho okubonayo, wabulala umYiputa, wamfihla emhlabathini.
Kwathi ngesikhathi esilandelayo, lapho ephuma khona, wabona abantu ababili baseHebhere bedlalana. Wathi kulowo owenza iphutha lakhe, Kungani na ushaya umngane wakho waseHebhere?

Wathi yena kuye, Ubani owakwenza wena ube nguMengameli noMthethosivivinywa kuthina? Ingabe ufuna ukungibulala, njengokuthi wabulala umYiputa? UMoses wakhathazeka, wathi, Bazokwazi abantu lokho engikwenze.
UFaro wafumana lokhu, wafuna ukumbulala uMoses; kodwana uMosis wehla phambi kukaFaro, waya ezweni laseMidiyani, wahlala khona enhliziyweni yempuphu.
Umbingeleli waseMidiyani wayenezingane ezisixhenxe. Zafika ziphuze amanzi, zagcwalisa amabhodwe okudlidliza izinkomo zikababa wabo.
Bafika ababheki, baphoqa ukuba bahambe; uMoses wavuka, wabasiza, waza wageza inkomo sabo.
Kwathi ziye kuyise uRehuweli, wathi kubo, Kungani na bona nifike namuhla ekuseni khulu?
Bathi kubo, Umuntu waseMisri usindise izandla zethu emgodini wamabhishobhi; wageza begodu amanzi ethu, wamisa izimvu.
Wathi kubo izingane zakhe, Uphi yena? Kungani na nimushiya khona? Nimwisele bona afike aphuze nathi.
UMoses wavuma ukuba ahlale nalowo muntu; yena ke wamnika intombi yakhe, uSepora, abe ngumfazi wakhe.
Wazala unyana, wathi uMoses igama lakhe nguGershon; ngombana wathi, Ngiye ngangihlala ezweni elisha.
Ngosuku olude, ukumkani waseYiputa wafa; begodu abantu bakaSirayeli baphuca ngenxa yobugebengu babo, baphoqa umlilo. Umlilo wabo ngenxa yobugebengu babo wawufinyelela kukaNkulunkulu.
Wasikia uzimu ukudubula kwabo, wakhumbula isivumelwano sakhe noAbrahamu, noIsake noYakobi.
uzimu wabheka abantu baseSirayeli, waqonda bona bahamba kanjani.
UMoses ke wayebhema izinkomo zikaJethro, ubaba wakhe wesifazane, umpristi waseMidiyani; waqhuba inkomo enyakatho-ntshonalanga yesiqhingi, waya eHorebhi, entaba kaThixo.
Wabonakala kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, emlilweni womlilo osuka phakathi kweqhwa; wabheka, wabona bona iqhwa ligcwele umlilo, kodwana alingena mlilo.
Wathi uMoses, Ngizohamba ngibheka le mboni enkulu, bona kungani lo mnqumo ungenamlilo.
Wabona ikosi bona uMoses ufike ukubheka, wamwisela uzimu phakathi kweqhwa, wathi, UMosese, uMosese. Wathi uMosese, Ngikhona.
Wathi, Musa ukufinyelela lapha; khulula izinyawo zakho; ngombana indawo lapho uhlala khona yindawo engcwele.
Wathi, Ngiye uzimu kababa wakho, uzimu ka-Abrahamu, nozimu ka-Isakha, noThixo kaYakobi. UMoses wafihla ikhanda lakhe; ngombana wayekhathazekile ukubheka uzimu.
Wathi ikosi, Ngabona ngokucacile ukuhlupheka kwabantu bam abaseYiputa; ngikuvile ukungcola kwabo ngenxa yabaphathi babo, ngombana ngizi izidumbu zabo.

Ngiye ngaphuma ngiwasindise emazweni aseMisiya, begodu ngiwakhuphule ezweni labo, ngiwaveze ezweni elilungile, elibanzi, elinokufulathela ubisi nengulube, endaweni yamaKanana, namaHeti, nama-Amoreti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Ngiyabona bona inkohlakalo yabantu bakaSirayeli ifike kimi, begodu ngibonile ubuhlungu abaMishithi bebawenza kubo.
Ngiyakuthumela kuFaro, ukuze ukhiphe abantu bam, oonyana bakaSirayeli, emazweni aseYiputa.
Wathi uMoses kuThixo, Ngibani na, bona ngiye kuFaro, begodu ngisuse abantu bakaSirayeli emazweni aseYiputa?
Wathi, Ngizobe ngikhona nawe; begodu lokhu kuzoba uphawu lwakho bona ngiyakuthumela: lapho ukhiphe khona abantu eYiputa, nizokhonza uzimu kulo mfula.
Wathi uMoses kuThixo, Khangela, uma ngiya kubo amadodana aseSirayeli, ngitjho kubo, uzimu wabababa benu ungithumelele kuni; begodu bengibuza bona, Liyini igama lakhe? Ngizobatshelani yini?
Wathi uzimu kuMoses, Ngiye nginguye lowo ngiye ngaye. Lokho wukuthi uzothi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Unginjalo-ke, ngimi, ungisithumeleleni.

Wathi uzimu kuMoses, Uzokhuluma ngale le kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, uthi: UYehova, uzimu kababa benu, uzimu ka-Abrahamu, uzimu ka-Isake, noThixo ka-Yakobi, ungithumelele kuni; leli yigama lami kuze kube sekupheleni; leli yigama labo elizongikhumbula ngalo kuze kube sekupheleni.

Chofoza lapha, uyeke ukuqoqa izikhulu zakwaSirayeli, uthi kubo: UYehova, uzimu wababa bakho, uzimu ka-Abrahama, no-Isake, no-Yakobi, ubonakala kimi, wathi, Ngikuboneni, begodu ngikubona konke okube sekwenzekile kuwe eYiputa.
Ngikutshele bona ngizokulethela ezweni laseMisri, ezweni lamaKanana, namaHethi, namaAmoreti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube.

begodu izikhulu zakwaSirayeli kuzokulalela; begodu wena, kanye nezikhulu zakho, kufanele ufike ukumkani waseYiputa, nithi kuye: UYehova, uzimu wamaHebhere, wahlangana nathi; ngalokho-ke, sicela, usivumele sihambe indlela yezinsuku amathathu esiqhingini, ukuze sinikeze insindiso kukaNkulunkulu wethu.
Ngiyazi bona ukumkani waseMisri ngeke akuvumeleni ukuba nihambe, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesandla esinamandla.
Ngizomisa isandla sami, ngibize iMisri ngazo zonke izinto ezimangazayo engizenzayo phakathi kwazo; begodu ngemuva kwalokho uzokushiya ukhambe.
Ngizobeka abantu bami ebusweni bama-Egipta; begodu uma niphuma, ngeke nihambe ngezandla ezingasebenzi.
Umama ngamunye uzocela umngane wakhe, nomfazi ohlala ekhaya lakhe, izinto zesiliva, negolide, nezigqoko; nizigqoke izingane zenu namadodakazi akho; begodu nizothatha isibopho sabantu baseYiputa.
Waphendula uMoses, wathi, Kungenzeka bona bangangikholwanga, begodu bangangisizi izwi lami. Ingabe bazothi, uzimu akakubonakalisile?
Wathi ikosi kuye, Yintoni leyo esandla sakho? Wathi uMoses, Intambo.
Wathi ikosi, Yithule phasi. UMoses wayithulela phasi, yashintsha ibe yinyosi; uMosis wabaleka phambi kwayo.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Nciphisa isandla sakho, uyiqambe ngomlenze wayo. UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe, wayiqamba; yabuya ibe yintambo esandlani sakhe.
Wathi ikosi, Yenza lokhu; ukuze bakholwa bona ikosi, uzimu wababa babo, ubonakala kuwe, uzimu ka-Abrahama, uzimu ka-Isake, nozimu kaYakobi.
Wathi ikosi, Thola isandla sakho emgodini wakho. UMoses wabeka isandla sakhe emgodini wakhe; begodu lapho ekhipha khona izandla zakhe, yabona bona imilenze yakhe ibimhlophe njengethebhulethi.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Thola begodu isandla sakho esiqhingini sakho. UMoses wehlise isandla sakhe esiqhingini sakhe; wakhipha, yabuya ibe ngcono kunawo wonke umzimba wakhe.
Wathi ikosi, Uma bekungakukholwa wena, noma bekungakuqapheli uphawu lokuqala, bazokukholelwa uphawu lwesibili.
Uma bengazikholwa lezi zimpawu ezimbili, begodu bangakulalela, khona-ke uthathe amanzi emfuleni iNil, uwaphuze phezu kweqhwa; begodu amanzi owathatha emfuleni azoshintsha abe yigazi phezu kweqhwa.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Ngicela, Kosi yami; ngombana angizange ngibe nolimi oluhle, namanje nalapho ukhuluma ngami njengomkhonzi wakho; ngombana nginomsindo, begodu ulimi lwami lunzima.

Wathi ikosi kuye, Nguwubani owenza abantu babe nemilomo? Ngabe nguwubani owenza bona bangakhuluma, noma bona bangalalela? Ngabe nguwubani owenza bona babone, noma bona bagweme? Angeke ngibe ngimi yini, Kosi?
Ngizokusiza bona ukhulume, begodu ngizokufundisa bona yini okufanele uyenze.
Wathi uMoses, Ngicela, Kosi, thumela omunye.
uzimu wagwema uMoses, wathi, "Ubekho yini uAron, umngane wakho, uLevi? Ngiyazi bona ukhuluma kahle; bheka, ufika ukukujabulela, begodu uzojabula uma ekubona.
Uzokhuluma naye bese utshela bona yini ongayisho. Ngizokusiza nikhulume, begodu ngizokufundisa bona yini okufanele niyenze.
Uzokhuluma nabantu endaweni yakho; uzobe efana nomlomo wakho, nawe uzobe ufana noThixo kuye.
Uzothatha le nkomishi esandla sakho, ukuze uyenze ngale imiqondiso.
UMoses wabuyela kuYethro, udadewabo, wathi kuye, Ngizobuya ngiye ezweni lami, eYiputa, ukuze ngibone bona ngabe kukhona ophilayo phakathi kwabo. Wathi Yethro kuMoses, Yiya, ube nokuthula.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses eMidiyani, Yiya ubuyela eYiputa; ngombana bonke abantu abafuna ukukwenza ufile bafa.
Wabeka uMoses indodana yakhe nomfazi wakhe phezu kwebhodlela, wabuyela ezweni laseYiputa; wathatha isandla sakhe isibhamu sikaThixo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Uma usuya ezweni laseYiputa, bheka bona ukwenze phambi kukaFaro zonke izimanga eniyimise esandleni sakho; kodwana ngizomisa inhliziyo yakhe, aze avumele abantu bahambe.
Uzothi kuFaro, Usho lokhu ikosi: Isirayeli ngunyana wami, umzali wam wokuthoma.
Ngithe kuwe, Landela unyana wami, ukuze angikhonze; kodwana awuzange uwulandele; ngalokho-ke ngizowubulala unyana wakho omdala.
Endlela, lapho behlala khona ekuseni, ikosi wabhekana noMoses, wafuna ukumbulala.
Wathi uSepora, ethatha itshe elinobukhali, wamisa isisu somntwana wakhe, wehlisa izinyawo zakhe ngaso, wathi, "Uyindodana yegazi kimi!"
Wathi ikosi kuye: "Uwowesifazane wegazi," ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe.
Wathi ikosi ku-Aron, Yiya esiqhingini ukuhlangabezana noMoses. Wahamba ke uAron, wahlangana noMoses emfuleni kaThixo, wamxola.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron zonke izindaba zokuthi ikosi wamthumela, nazo zonke izibonakaliso akhenge azivumele.
Wahamba ke uMoses no-Aron, bahlanganisa bonke abakhulu bomndeni kaSirayeli.
Wathi u-Aron kubo konke okuthi ikosi abewisela kuye uMoses, wakwenza izibonakaliso phambi kwamehlo abantu.
Abantu bakholwa. Bathe beva bona ikosi wafika ukusindisa oonyana bakaSirayeli, begodu wabona ukuhlupheka kwabo, baphakamisa ikhanda labo, bakhonza.
Kusukela lapho, uMoses no-Aron bafika kuFaro, bathi kuye, Uthi lokhu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Landisa abantu bam, ukuze bagcine isikhumbuzo kimi ezweni elimnyama.
Wathi uFarawo, Ubani ikosi, bona ngiwuthobele, ngivumele amaSirayeli ahambe? Angiyazi ikosi, begodu ngeke ngivumela amaSirayeli ahambe.
Bathi ke, uzimu wamaHebhere uhlangana nathi; sizohamba, sicela, uhambo lwezinsuku amathathu esiqhingini, ukuze sisindise ikosi uzimu wethu; uma kungenjalo, angasibulala ngobhubhu noma ngeqhwa.
Wathi ukumkani waseMisri, UMosesi no-Aron, kungani nisusa abantu emisebenzini sabo? Yendeni nisebenzele umsebenzi wenu.
Wathi uFiraun: "Njengombana abantu bakho baningi ezweni, yini oyenzayo bona nizivumele ukuba zingasebenzi?
Wathi uFaro, ngalolusuku olulodwa, wamisa abaphathi bezisebenzi, nabaqondisi bomphakathi.
Wathi, Musani ukunikeza abantu inkomo ukuze benze amatshe, njengokuba bekwenza ngaphambilini; bangaya baqoqe inkomo sabo.
Kodwana ukwenze bona bakhiqize amatshe alinganayo nenani elingaphambilini; ungawanciphisi inani labo, ngombana bangasekho. Ngenxa lalokho bekhala, bathi, Siye sinikeze insindiso kuThixo wethu.
Yenza umsebenzi kube nzima khulu kubo, ukuze bahlale besebenza begodu babeke amehlo abo ekukhohliseni.
Baphuma ke abaphathi bezindlu, nabaqondisi babo, bakhuluma abantu, bathi, Lokho kusho uFaro, Ngizoyeka ukuninika isihlabathi.
Chofoza lapha ukuze uthole imbewu yakho, lapho ungathola khona; kodwana umsebenzi wakho ngeke ugwenywe ngalutho.
Basuka abantu ezweni lonke laseYiputa, baqoqe imbewu, ukuze bayisebenzise njengenkomo.
begodu abanikazi babo baqhubeka ukucindezela kubo, esithi, "Ukuphela umsebenzi wakho ngosuku ngalunye, njengombana wakwenza lapho imbewu!
Bathi abaphathi bakaSirayeli, abaholi bakaFaro, babulala labo abaphathi babo, besithi kubo: Kungani na bona ningasebenzisi nsuku zonke inani lethu lamagquma, njengombana nisebenza ngaphambili?
Baye ke abaphathi bakaSirayeli, befika kuFaro, besithi, Kungani na ukwenze lokhu kubakhonzi bakho?
Asikho isitsha esithunyelwa nathi, begodu sithe kuthiwe, Ukwenza amatshe; begodu abakhonzi bakho bahlaselwa, kodwana abantu bakho banecala.
Wathi uFaro, Niyinyamakazi, niyinyamakazi; ngalokho nithi, Thina sizohamba sinikela ngomnikelo kuYehova.
Manje buyela emsebenzini! Awuzothola noma yiluphi udoti, kodwana kufanele wenze inani eliphelele lamatshe."
Babona abaphathi bakwaSirayeli bona sebesengozini, ngombana kwathiwa kubo: Akufanele ninciphise inani lamatshe owenzayo ngosuku ngalunye.
Uma bephuma kuFiraun, bathola uMoses no-Aharon belinde ukuhlangabezana nabo.
Bathi kubo, uzimu abhekane nalokho nikwenzayo, begodu akuhlonipheni; ngombana ninze uFaro nomakhelwane bakhe bafuna ukusikhohlisa, nibeka ikhebula esandla sabo ukuba basibulala.
Wabuyela uMoses kuYehova, wathi, Kosi yami, yini na ekwenzeni izimo ezibi kubo bonke labo abantu? Kungani na ungisithumela?
Kusuka lapho ngiye kuFaro, ngakhuluma ngegama lakho, wakwenza kabi abantu labo; wena ke awuzange usindise abantu bakho.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Manje uzobona bona ngizokwenzani noFarao; ngenxa yesandla sami esinamandla, uzowashiya bahambe; begodu ngenxa yesandla sami esinamandla, uzowasusa ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uzimu kuMoses, Ngiye ikosi.
Ngiye ngabonakala ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngokuba nguThixo Onamandla onke; kodwana ngegama lami, ikosi, angikaze ngiphawulwe kubo.
Ngakwenza begodu umhlangano wami nabo, bona ngibanike izwe likaKanana, lapho behlala khona njengezivakashi.
Nami ngikuvile ubuhlungu bomndeni wakwaSirayeli, abaYiputa bewaphatha njengabakhonzi; begodu ngakhumbula isivumelwano sami.

Uzothi kubo: Ngiye ikosi, begodu ngizokususa ngaphasi kwemisebenzi enzima yama-Egipta, begodu ngizokukhulula ekusebenzeleni kwabo; begodu ngizokusindisa ngesandla sami esinamandla, nangenqubekelaphambili enkulu.
Ngizokuthathela bona ube ngumuntu wami, begodu ngizoba uzimu wenu; niyazi bona ngimi ikosi uzimu wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ngezansi kwemisebenzi enzima yama-Egypt.
Ngizokulethela izwe engithembise ngalo uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi; ngizokulinika wena libe yikhaya lakho. Ngiye ikosi.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; kodwana abawutholile umsindo wakhe, ngenxa yokuthi inhliziyo sabo yaba buhlungu, begodu umsebenzi wabo wawunzima.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Chofoza lapha, bese ukhuluma kuFaro, ukumkani waseMisri, bona avumele abantu bakaSirayeli baphume ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uMosis kuYehova, Abantu bakaSirayeli bangangilalelanga; kungani khona-ke bona uFaro angamilalela, uma ngikhuluma ngamazwi anzima?
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noAron, mayelana nabantu bakaSirayeli naphezu kukaFaro ukumkani waseYiputa, wathi kubo, Nizikhuphule izingane zikaSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa.
Lawa amakhosikazi emindeni sabo. Oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali kaSirayeli: uHanoki, noPalu, noHezron, noKarmi; lalawa amabandla kaRubhen.
Oonyana bakaSimeoni: uJemuyeli, noYamini, noOhadi, noYakhini, noZohari, noShawuli, umfazi waseKanana; lezi zimindeni kaSimeoni.
Lawa amagama oonyana bakaLawi, ngokusho kohlelo lokuzalwa kwabo: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari. Amalanga wokuphila kukaLawi zaba yiminyaka engumakhulu amathathu anamashumi ayisithupha.
Oonyana bakaGershoni, ngokwemindeni sabo: uLibni noShimeyi.
Oonyana bakaKohati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli. Waphila uKohati iminyaka engumakhulu amathathu anamashumi amathathu anesihlanu.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi; lezi ziyimindeni yamaLevi, ngokusho kohlelo lokuzalwa kwabo.
U-Amram washada noJokhebedi, indodakazi yodadewabo; yena wazala uAron noMoses. Waphila u-Amram iminyaka engumakhulu amathathu anamashumi ayisithupha.
Oonyana baka-Ishar: uKora, noNefegi, noZikhri.
Oonyana bakaUziyeli: uMishayeli, noElzaphane, noSithri.
U-Aron washada noElisheba, intombi ka-Aminadabhi, inkosikazi ka-Nahshon; yena wazala uNadab, no-Abihu, no-Eleazare, no-Ithamari.
Oonyana bakaKora: u-Asiri, no-Elkana, no-Abiyasaphe; lezi zimindeni yama-Korahi.
U-Eleazare, unyana ka-Aron, washada nenye yezingane zika-Puthiyeli, wazalelwa nguPhinehasi; labo babe ngabaphathi bezindlu zakwaLevi ngokwezindlu zabo.
Lokho ngu-Aron noMoses, ababethi kubo ikosi, Nciphisa izingane zakwaSirayeli zisuka eYiputa, ngohlobo lwazo ngalunye, njengeqhwa.
Baye labo abakhuluma noFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, bona bakhuphule abantwana bakaSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa; lo Mosesi noAron.
Kwathi lapho ikosi ekhuluma noMosesi eYiputa,
Wathi kuye, Ngimi ikosi; khuluma kuFaro ukumkani waseYiputa konke engikushoyo kuwe.
Wathi uMosis kuYehova, Nginezwi elibi khulu; kungani uFaro engangilalela?
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Bona, ngikwenza ube nguThixo kuFaro; no-Aron umngane wakho uzobe ngumprofeti wakho.
Uzokhuluma konke okungiwiselayo; uAron umngane wakho uzokhuluma kuFaro, bona avumele abantu bakaSirayeli ukuba baphume ezweni lakhe.
Ngizomisa inhliziyo kaFaro, begodu ngizahlule izibonakaliso zami nezimanga ezweni laseYiputa.
UFaro ngeke akuxhumaneni, kodwana ngizobeka isandla sami ezweni laseYiputa, begodu ngizokhipha abantu bami, izingane zakwaSirayeli, zisuka ezweni laseYiputa, ngomthetho omkhulu.
Bazokwazi ama-Egyptians bona ngiyiNkosi, uma ngiphakamisa isandla sami e-Egypt, begodu ngikhuphe izingane zakwaSirayeli phakathi kwabo.
Wakwenza ke uMoses noAron, njengokuthi ikosi wabawisela umthetho.
UMoses ubeneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, no-Aron abeminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye namashumi mathathu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Uma uFiraun ekhuluma nani, ethi: 'Ningibonise uphawu', khona-ke utshele uHaruni: 'Thiba inkomishi yakho, uyithule phambi kukaFiraun, izobe yinkomo.
Waphuma uMoses noAron, wafika kuFaro, bakwenza njengokuthi ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; uArono wehlisa inkomishi yakhe phambi kukaFaro, nangaphambili kwabaphathi bakhe, yashintsha ibe yinyoka.
Wathi uFaro, wabiza abantu bakhe abadumile, nabamangali bakhe; bakwenza njalo nabamangali baseYiputa ngobuciko babo.
Bakhipha wonke umuntu inkomishi yakhe, begodu inkomishi ngayinye yashintsha ibe yinyoka; kodwana inkomishi ka-Aron yazidla inkomishi zabo.
Nokho intliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, akhenge abonise, njengombana ikosi abeshoyo.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Intliziyo kaFaro iqinile; akafuni ukuwashiya abantu bahambe.
Yiya kuFaro ekuseni, lapho ephuma emlanjeni, ulinde kuye enhliziyweni yeNil. Thola isandla sakho isibhamu esishintshile ibe yinyamakazi.
Uthi kuye, UYehova, uzimu wamaHebhere, ungithumela kuwe, ngikutshele bona, Vumela abantu bam bahambe, bamikhonze ezweni lezulu elimnyama; kodwana wena awuzange ulalele kuze kube manje.
Uthi ikosi bona: Ngalokhu uzokwazi bona nginguYehova; bheka, ngizoshaya amanzi aseNilweni ngesandla sami, begodu azoshintsha abe yigazi.
Inhlanzi emfuleni iNayile izofa, begodu umlambo uzoba nephunga elibuhlungu; abantu baseMijiphu bangadlanga amanzi akhe.

Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Uthi uHaron, Thola isandla sakho phezu kwamanzi aseYiputa, eduze kwezintaba zawo, eduze kwemifula yawo, eduze kwemifula yakhe, eduze kwezintaba zakhe, eduze kwezintaba zayo zonke, ukuze zishintshe zibe yigazi; begodu kuzoba khona igazi ezweni lonke laseYiputa, nasezindaweni zokhuni, nasezindaweni zetshe.

Wakwenza uMoses noAron, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; waphakamisa uAron inkomishi yakhe phambi kukaFaro, nangaphambili kwabaphathi bakhe, washaya amanzi aseNil, begodu amanzi onke eNil aguqulwa ibe yigazi.
Iinhlapi eNil zafa, begodu umlambo waba nephunga elibi khulu, ngalokho-ke aBamishiyanga babengeke baphuze amanzi awo. Kwabekho igazi kiwo wonke amaMisiya.
Bakwenza njalo begodu abamangali baseYiputa ngobuhlakani babo; inhliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, awavami uMoses noHaarnau, njengokuthi ikosi abesho.
UFiraun wehla, wabuyela endlu yakhe, begodu akhenge athathe lokhu enhliziyweni.
Bathi bonke abaMijipida, baxhuma phezu kweNil, befuna amanzi okudlidliza; ngombana abengawadla amanzi emfuleni.
Kwadlula amalanga ezisixhenxe, ngemuva kokuba ikosi ahlasele iNil.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Yiya kuFaro, uthi kuye, Utsho ikosi bona, Landisa abantu bam, bamikhonze mina.
Uma ungenasifiso ukuwashiya bahambe, ngizothumela ubhubhane lwezinhlanzi ezweni lakho lonke.

INtaba-mlilo izogcwele izimvu, zifike endlwini yakho, nasegumbini lakho lokuphumula, nasesibhedlela sakho. Ziya kungena ezindlini zabasebenzi bakho, nakwabanye abantu bakho, namabhodwe akho, nezitsha zakho zokupheka.
Iinhlapi zizohamba phezu kwakho, kanye nabantu bakho, begodu zonke iziphathimandla zakho.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Uthi uAron, Nciphisa isandla sakho ngentambo yakho phezu kwezintaba-mlilo, neziqukathi zendabuko, nezingqimba zolwandle, ukuze zikhuphule izingulube phezu kwezwe lakwaMisra.
Wamisa u-Aron isandla sakhe phezu kwamanzi aseYiputa, zaphuma izingulube, zagubuzela umhlaba wonke.
Nabo abamangali bakwenza njalo ngobuhlakani babo, begodu baphakamisa izingulube phezu kwezwe laseYiputa.
UFaro wabiza uMosis noAron, wathi, "Nxusa ikosi bona asuse lezi zinyoni kum nakubo bonke abantu bami; ngizovumela abantu ukuba bahambe, ukuze banikela ngenhlanhla kuNkosi.
Wathi uMoses kuFaro, Uzokwazi wena; kuphi lapho ngizothandaza khona kuwe, namakhosana akho, nabantu bakho, ukuze izinyoni zihambe kude nawe, nezindlu zakho, zihlale emfuleni kuphela?
Wathi uFaro, NgoMsombuluko. Wathi uMoses, Ngokuya ngamazwi akho, ukuze wazi bona akukho muntu ofana noYehova uzimu wethu.
Izinkomo ziyakushiya wena, nezindlu zakho, nabaphathi bakho, nabantu bakho; kuzohlala eNtshonalanga kuphela.
UMoses noAron baphuma kuFaro; uMosis wathandaza kuYehova ngenxa yezinhlanzi, azenzayo kuFaro.
Wakwenza ikosi njengokuthi uMosis; zafa izinyoni ezindlini, nasezikhungweni, nasezindaweni.
Bathi abantu, "Siyibeke phezu kwamanzi," begodu izwe lonke lalimaza.
UFaro, lapho nakabona bona izinkinga ziphelile, wakwenza intliziyo yakhe ibe namandla, akawatholi amazwi abo, njengombana ikosi abesho.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Uthi uAron, Nciphisa isandla sakho, cindezela inkungu yezulu, ukuze ibe yizinhlanzi ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Bakwenza njalo. U-Aron wehlisa isandla sakhe ngentambo, washaya uthuli lwezulu; kwavela amakhowe abantu nasezilwaneni. Uthuli lonke ezweni liphela laseYiputa lashintsha libe ngamakhowe.
Baye bazama ukwenza ama-lice ngemisebenzi sabo efihlakeleyo, kodwana abakwazi, begodu ama-lice ahlala abantu nenyama.
Bathi abamangali kuFaro, Le yimikhono kaThixo; kodwana intliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, akayiqondi, njengokuthi ikosi wayesho.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Uvuka ekuseni, uhlale phambi kukaFaro; uma ephuma amanzi, uthi kuye, Lokho kusho ikosi: Landisa abantu bam, ukuze bamikhonze.

Uma ungazivumela abantu bam bahambe, bona, ngizothumela phezu kwakho, nakwabezi bakho, nakwabantu bakho, nasezindaweni zenu, inqwaba yezinhlanzi; begodu izakhiwo zakwaMisiriya zizogcwele iinhlapi, nayo yonke indawo abahlala kuyo.
Ngosuku olulodwa ngizomisa izwe laseGosheni, lapho abantu bami behlala khona; ngeke kube khona amabhubesi, ukuze wazi bona ngiyiNkosi phakathi kwalolu lizwe.
Ngizomisa isinqumo phakathi kwabantu bam nomphakathi wakho. Lo mqondiso uzokwenzeka kusasa.'
Wakwenza ikosi lokhu: kwafika amabhungane akhulu endlu kaFaro, namabhungane emindenini yabantu bakhe; izwe lonke laseYiputa lalahleka ngamabhungane.
UFaro wabiza uMoses no-Aron, wathi, Yiya, ninikeze insindiso kuThixo wenu ezweni elinjalo.

Wathi uMoses, Akulungile lokhu; ngombana uma sinikela kuYehova uzimu wethu ngezinto ezibi engqondweni yama-Egipta, uma sinikela ngezinto ezibi engqondweni sabo phambi kwamehlo abo, bangasithutha kanjani ngamathumbu?
Sizohamba uhambo lwezinsuku amathathu, sifike ezweni lezulu elimnyama, sinikeze umnikelo kuYehova uzimu wethu, njengombana esesiwiselayo.
Wathi uFaro, Ngizowavumelani nihambe, ukuze ninikeze insindiso kuYehova uzimu wenu esiqhingini; kodwana akufanele nihambe eduze khulu; ngicelani manje.

Wathi uMoses, "Ngizothandaza kuYehova uma ngiphuma kuwe, ukuze izinyoni zihambe kaFaro, nabakhonzi bakhe, nabantu bakhe, kusasa; kodwana akumele uFaro aphinde anikeze abantu ithuba lokuphuma, ukuba banikela kukaNkulunkulu.
Waphuma uMoses kuFaro, wathandaza kuYehova.
Wakwenza ikosi ngokusho kwaMosesi; izinyoni zasuka kuFaro, nabaphathi bakhe, nabantu bakhe; akukho linye lazo elihlala.
Kodwana uFaro wehlise inhliziyweni yakhe begodu ngalolu hlobo, akawavumela abantu bahambe.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Iya kuFaro, uthi kuye, Usho lokhu ikosi, uzimu wamaHebhere: Vumela abantu bam bahambe, ukuze bamikhonze.
Uma ungenasifiso ukuwashiya bahambe begodu uqhubeka nokuzibopha kubo,
Isandla sikaYehova sizoletha umkhuhlane omkhulu ezilwaneni zakho ezisendaweni, ezibhakabhakeni zakho, ezimbotsheni zakho, ezigungwini zakho, ezinkomo zakho, nezimvu zakho, nezimbuzi zakho.
Kodwana ikosi uzozenza izilwane zakwaSirayeli zihlukile ezilwaneni zakwaYiputa; ngeke kube khona isilwane ngayinye sabantu bakaSirayeli esizofa.
Wabeka ikosi isikhathi, wathi, NgoMsombuluko ikosi uzokwenza lokhu ezweni.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, ikosi wakwenza njalo; zonke izilwane zakwaMisra zafa; kodwana kwabaSirayeli akukho lutho lwazo lwafile.
UFaro wathumela abantu, babheka, begodu bona, kubonakala sengathi angeke kube nenyama yomndeni kaSirayeli efile; kodwana intliziyo kaFaro yaqhubeka iqinile, awazami ukuwashiya labo bantu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaronu, Nciphisani izinkomishi zenu ezigcwele isibhakabhaka somlilo, uMosesi ayisetshenzise emkhathini phambi kukaFaro.
Uzoba wuthuli oluncane phezu kwezwe lonke laseYiputa, luzobangela ukuba kube khona izinhlungu ezibulalayo kumuntu nokudla kwezilwane ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Bathi ke, bathathe inkungu yomlilo, behlala phambi kuka-Firaun; uMoses wehla ngayo emkhathini, yaphuma khona imihuzuko evulekile kubantu nakwinyama.
Abamangali abazange bahlale phambi kukaMoses, ngenxa yezinhlayiya; ngombana izinhlayiya zazikhona kubo bonke abamangali, nakwabenzi bomhlaba.
Wakwenza ikosi intliziyo kaFaro ibe yindida, akawalalelanga uMoses noAron; njengokuthi ikosi wayesho kuMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Khumbula ekuseni, uhlale phambi kukaFaro, uthi kuye, Usho lokhu ikosi, uzimu wamaHebhere: Vumela abantu bam bahambe, ukuze bangikhonze.
Ngokuba ngaleso sikhathi ngizothumela zonke izifo zami phezu kwakho, naphezu kwabaphathi bakho, naphezu kwabantu bakho; ukuze wazi bona akukho muntu ofana nami emhlabeni wonke.
Ngalokhu ngangikwazi ukudlulisa isandla sami, begodu ngikuhlasele wena nomndeni wakho ngegciwane, ukuze ngikususe ezweni.
Kodwana ngalesi sizathu ngikugcine uphila, ukuze ngikubonise amandla ami, begodu bona igama lami likwaziswe emhlabeni wonke.
Sekuyisikhathi eside ubeke isandla sakho phezu kwabantu bam, begodu awukaze ubavumele bahambe.
Ngokuba ngaleso sikhathi, ngizothumela ngoMsombuluko isivunguvungu esibi kunazo zonke, esingase sidlule eYiputa, kusukela ngosuku lapho yaba yizwe, kuze kube manje.

Ngalokho-ke, utshele bona zithunyelwe izilwane zakho, nezinto zonke ezikhona ezindaweni zomhlaba; begodu uma umuntu noma isilwane sishiywa ezindaweni zomhlaba, begodu singathunyelwa ngaphakathi, khona-ke isikhukhula sizogwama.
Baze bakhathazeka abaphathi bakaFaro ngenxa yezwi likaYehova, behamba ngokushesha, bezikhipha izisebenzi zabo nezilwane zabo.
Kodwana labo ababengabazi ilizwi likaYehova, bashiya abakhonzi babo nezilwane zabo ezindaweni zazo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho esibhakabhakeni, ukuze kube khona isikhukhula ezweni lonke laseYiputa, kubantu, nezilwane, nakwezo zonke iimila ezikhula emhlabathini waseYiputa.
UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, ikosi wakhipha intaba-mlilo nezingqimba zeqhwa, begodu amatshe emvula akhuphuka ezweni; ikosi wasusa izingqimba zeqhwa phezu kwezwe laseMizi.
Imvula yeqhwa yaphuma, begodu umlilo wawuhamba phakathi kwemvula yeqhwa; kwakuyimvula enkulu kunazo zonke ezweni lonke laseYiputa, kusukela lapho yaba yizwe.
Umlilo wabulala zonke izinto ezikhona ezweni lonke laseYiputa, abantu nokudla kwazo zonke izilwane; wabulala yonke imifino yezulu, waphula wonke umthi.
Indawo eyodwa kuphela lapho kwakungekho khona imvula enkulu, yilizwe laseGosheni, lapho abantu bakaSirayeli behlala khona.
Wathi uFaro, ebiza uMosis noAron, wathi kubo, Ngaphezu kwalokho ngihlulekile; ikosi ulungile, begodu mina nemindeni yami siyingozi.
Ngicelani ikosi, ngombana sekuyinto eyanele izulu lethu nemvula yeqhwa; ngizokushiya ukhambe; ngeke nihlale isikhathi eside.
Wathi uMoses kuye, Uma ngiphuma kulo mzi, ngizokhuphula izandla zami kuYehova; izivunguvungu zizoyeka, begodu ngeke kube khona isikhukhula; ukuze wazi bona le mhlaba nguwo ikosi.
Kodwana ngiyazi bona wena nabangani bakho angeke nigweme ikosi uzimu.
I-flax ne-barley zalahleka, ngombana i-barley yadala izindlebe zayo begodu i-flax yayihlotshiswe.
Kodwana-ke, inkomo ne-spelt azikabi zilahlekile, ngombana zikhula ngokushesha.
Waphuma ke uMoses emzini, esuka kuFaro, waphakamisa izandla zakhe kuye ikosi; begodu izivunguvungu nezingqimba zeqhwa zanyamalala, intwasahlobo namanzi abandayo awabikho emhlabeni.
UFarawo, lapho nakabona bona imvula nezingqimba zeqhwa nezivunguvungu ziphelile, waqhubeka nokwenza ubugebengu; waba nomsindo emlonyeni wakhe, yena nabangane bakhe.
Inhliziyo kaFaro yacindezelwa, akaze avumele abantu bakaSirayeli bahambe; njengokuba ikosi wathi ngaye ngoMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Yiya kuFaro; ngombana ngiyiqinise inhliziyo yakhe, kanye nenhliziyo yabangani bakhe, ukuze ngikwenze lezi zibonakaliso zami phakathi kwabo.
begodu ukuze utshele izingane zakho, nezingane zabantwana bakho, bona ngikwenze kanjani eMisiyani, nezibonakaliso zami engizenza phakathi kwabo; ukuze nikwazi bona ngingiNkosi.
Baye ke uMoses noAron kuFaro, bathi kuye: Uthi lokhu ikosi, uzimu wamaHibhuri, uthi: Kuze kube nini uma ungathandanga ukuxolisa phambi kwami? Vumela abantu bam bahambe, bangangikhonza.
Uma ungenasifiso ukuwashiya bahambe, ngoMsombuluko ngizoletha izingulube ezweni lakho.
Zizovala izwe, ukuze lingabonakali; ziyodla konke okuncane okusele kuwe ngemuva kweqhwa, kanye nesihlahla soke esikhula ezweni lakho.

Zizogcwalisa izakhiwo zakho, nezindlu zabasebenzi bakho bonke, nama-Egyptians onke; okunjalo abazali bakho, nabangani bakho abakhulu, abangabonanga lutho olufana nalo, kusukela ngosuku lapho behlala khona ezweni lenu, kuze kube manje. UMoses wabuyela, waya kuFaro.
Bathi abaphathi bakaFaro kuye, Ingabe kuze kube isikhathi esingakanani bona lo muntu abe yingozi yethu? Vumela abantu bahambe, bakhonza ikosi uzimu wabo; awubonanga yini bona iMisri iyafa?
Babuyiselwa uMoses noAron kuFaro; wathi kubo, Yiya, nikhonza ikosi uzimu wenu; kodwana ningamitshela bona ngubani ozoya.
Wathi uMoses, Sizohamba nabangane bethu nabadala bethu, namantombazane ethu namadodakazi ethu, nezingulube zethu nezinkomo zethu; ngombana sinomkhosi woNkulunkulu.
Wathi uFaro: uzimu uzobe nawe, uma nje ngikushiyela wena nomndeni wakho. Kubonakala sengathi isinqumo sakho siyisinqumo esibi.
Amadoda kuphela azoya, akhonze ikosi; ngombana lokhu kungenxa yenu. Waphuma ke uMoses noAron ebusweni bukaFaro. Bathi kuMosis, "Ubani lo muntu?"
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho phezu kweYiputa, ukuze izingulube zikhuphuke phezulu ezweni lonke, zidle yonke imifino, konke okushisayo.
Wamisa uMoses inkomishi yakhe phezu kweYiputa; ikosi waveza umoya osuka eningizimu ezweni lonke lona usuku, nobusuku bonke. Kwafika isihlwa, umoya waba nezinhlanzi.
Kwafika amakhowe phezu kwezwe lonke laseYiputa, wahlala kiwo wonke indawo. Akukho makhowe anjalo ngaphambilini, begodu ngeke kube namakhowe anjalo.

Zazifihla zonke izingxenye zezwe, kuze kube yimnyama; zadla zonke iimila ezikhula ezindaweni zomhlaba, nazo zonke izithelo zezinhlamvu, konke okushiwo imvula yomlilo. Akukabikho okunye okuluhlaza kinanyana yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlamvu, noma kwezinhlamvu eziphilako, ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Wathi uFaro, ehamba ngokushesha, wabiza uMoses noHaarnau, wathi, Ngihlulekile kuYehova uzimu wenu, nani na.
Manje ke, ngiyakucela, usindise isono sami ngaleso sikhathi nje kuphela; nithandazani kuYehova uzimu wenu, ukuba asuse kum lo monakalo wokufa.
Waphuma uMoses kuFaro, wathandaza kuYehova.
uzimu washintsha umoya ube wumoya onamandla khulu osuka enyakatho, uthathe izingulube, waza uzisusa emfuleni oMnyama. Akukho isingulube esisodwa esishiyeka ezweni lonke laseYiputa.
Kodwana ikosi wenza intliziyo kaFaro iqinile, akaze avumele abantu bakaSirayeli bahambe.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho esibhakabhakeni, ukuze kube nokukhanya ezweni laseYiputa, ukukhanya okuncane khulu, okungukuthi, kungabikho muntu ongakulingisa.
UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni, kwafika ubusuku obumnyama ezweni lonke laseYiputa nsuku amathathu.
Wonke umuntu angeke abone omunye umuntu, begodu akukho muntu osuka endaweni yakhe amalanga amathathu; kodwana bonke abantu bakaSirayeli babe nelanga lapho behlala khona.
UFaro wabiza uMoses, wathi, Yiya, nisebenzele ikosi; begodu izingane zenu zingaya nani; izingulube zenu kuphela nezimbuzi zenu zihlale.
Wathi uMoses, Uzodinga begodu bona usinikeze izinkomo zokudla kanye nezinkomo zokudla okuthosiwe, ukuze sizinikela kuYehova uzimu wethu.

Begodu izilwane zethu kumele zihambe nathi; akufanele sishiye ikhanda elilodwa lazo, ukuze sisebenzise ezinye zazo ukukhonza ikosi uzimu wethu; begodu kuze sifike khona, asikaze sikwazi bona yiziphi ezidingekayo ukuba sisebenzele ikosi.
Kodwana ikosi wamisa intliziyo kaFaro, akaze avumele bona bahambe.
Wathi uFaro kuMoses, Yiya kude nami; qiniseka bona ngeke ubone isithombe sami begodu; ngombana lapho ubona khona isithombe sami, uzofa.
Wathi uMoses, "Ngalokho-ke usho bona: ngeke ngibona isithombe sakho.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Ngizoletha igciwane elilodwa ePharao naseYiputa; ngemuva kwalokho uzowashiya niphume lapha; begodu uma ekwenzela njalo, uzokuphoqa bona nihambe.
Uzokhuluma abantu bona wonke umuntu, indoda nomfazi, kufanele abuze izihlobo zakhe zaseMisiya izinto zesiliva negolide.
Nokho ikosi wenza abantu bathandeke ebusweni bamaMishi; begodu noMoses waba mkhulu khulu ezweni lakwaMishi, phambi kwabaphathi bakaFiraun, nangaphambili kwabantu.
Wathi uMoses, Usho lokhu ikosi: Ngobusuku obuphakathi, ngizodlula emiphakathini yaseYiputa.

Wonke umzali wesifazane ezweni laseYiputa uzofa, kusukela kumzali wesifazane kaFaro, ohlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, kuze kube ngumzali wesifazane wendodakazi yowesifazane, obhaka imbewu emgodini wakhe, nanoma ngimuphi umzali wesifazane wezilwane.
Kuzobe khona ubuhlungu obukhulu ezweni lonke laseYiputa, obubi kunawo wonke ngaphambilini, noma kuzoba njalo.
Kodwana kuzobe kungabi khona inja eshaya wonke amakhosikazi aseSirayeli, noma zonke izilwane zabo; ukuze nikwazi bona ikosi unquma phakathi kweMisiya neSirayeli.
Bazofika lapha kimi bonke abaphathi bakho, babhujiswa phambi kwami, bathi, Yiya wena, nawe wonke umuntu olandelana nawe; begodu ngemuva kwalokho ngizophuma. Washiya uMoses uFaro, ehlukumezeka.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, UFaro ngeke akulalelani, ukuze ngiphinde ngikwenze izimanga zami ezweni laseYiputa.
UMoses no-Aron bazenza zonke lezi zinto ezimangazayo phambi kukaFaro; kodwana ikosi wakwenza intliziyo kaFaro ibe yindida, aze avumele izingane zakwaSirayeli ziphume ezweni lakhe.
Wakhuluma ikosi kuMoses noHaroni eYiputa, wathi,
"Le nyanga kumele ibe ngukuqala kwezinyanga kuwe. Kuzobe yinyanga yokuqala yonyaka wakho.
Bheka, ngikhuluma emphakathini wonke waseSirayeli: Ngosuku oluyishumi lwale nyanga, umuntu ngamunye athathe inkomo eyodwa ngendlu yakhe, inkomo eyodwa ngendlu ngayinye.

Uma ikhaya lincane khulu bona lidle inkomo ephelele, kumele bahlukanise nenye nomngane wabo ohamba phambili, ngokuya ngenani labantu. Sebenzisa inani lenyama yenkomo edingekayo ngokwenani lomuntu ngamunye ozodla.
Inja oyikhethayo kumele ibe yindoda eneminyaka engu-1 ubudala ngaphandle kokungalungile kuyo. Ungayithola kusuka ezimvu noma ezinkomo.
Niyigcine kuze kube yimini eyisishiyagalombili yale nyanga; khona-ke bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bazozibulala izinyamazane zabo, uma ilanga liphuma.
Bazothatha ezinye zalezi gazi, bazibeke emadolweni nakwesobunxele komnyango wendlu lapho bedla khona izingulube.
Ngobusuku obufanayo kufanele baphuze inyama ethosiwe emanzini, kanye nezithelo ezijulile nenyama eyenziwe ngaphandle kommbila.
Ungadli inyama ethosiwe noma ethosiwe emanzini. Nciphisa inhlanzi yonke phezu komlilo, ikhanda layo, izinyawo zayo, nezicubu zaso.
Musa ukushiya noma yini kuyo kuze kube ekuseni. Uma kukhona okushiwo kuze kube kusasa, kufanele umlilo.
Ngale le nizoyidla; ugqozi lwakhe luyimisiwe, izicathulo zakhe ezinyawo zakhoni, nentambo yakhe esandlani sakho. Niyidle ngokushesha, ngombana yiPasha kaYehova.
Ngizodlula ezweni laseYiputa ngalolu busuku, begodu ngizobulala wonke umzali omusha, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama; begodu ngizolungisa isinqumo phezu kwamasiko aseYiputa onke. Ngiye ikosi.
Uma ngibona igazi ezindaweni zenu, ngiyakudlulani; ngeke kube khona ubhubhane olubulalayo, uma ngishaya iMisri. Uzothola bona igazi likhona ezindlini zenu, begodu ngizokubona igazi.
Lemini kumele ibe ngusuku lokukhumbula kwenu; kufanele niyigcine njengosuku lokuphumula kukaNkulunkulu, kuze kube yiminyaka yonke ezayo. Lolu hlelo luzohlala njalo.

Amalanga ezisixhenxe kufanele nidle ukudla okungenaziqhamo. Ngosuku lokuqala kumele nisuse iziqhamo ezindaweni zenu; ngombana wonke umuntu odla ukudla okungezincibilikisiwe, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala kuze kube usuku oluyisixhenxe, lowo muntu uzosuswa ezweni laseSirayeli.

Ngosuku lokuqala uzoba nengqungquthela engcwele, begodu ngosuku lwesixhenxe uzoba nengqungquthela engcwele. Akukho msebenzi ozowenza ngalolu suku, ngaphandle kokulungiselela ukudla komuntu ngamunye. Lokho konke ongayikwenza.

Uzogcina usuku lwezithelo ezingenawo umhluzi; ngombana ngalolu busuku ngibakhipha abantu bakho ezweni laseMisiya, ngohlobo lwabo; uzogcina lo mhla kuze kube yisikhathi sakho samanje. Lo ngumthetho ohlala njalo.
Ngonyaka wokuthoma, kusukela ngemini eyisishiyagalombili yokuhlwa kuze kube yimini yeshumi nanye yokuhlwa, nidla ubisi olungenamhluzi.

Amalanga ezisixhenxe akufanele kube khona ukhilimu ezindaweni zenu; ngombana wonke umuntu odla noma yini enokhilimu, lowo muntu uzosuswa emphakathini wakwaSirayeli, noma ngabe ungumhlali wasezweni, noma ngabe ngumzali walo.
Ungadla noma yini eyenziwe nge-lemongrass; kuzo zonke izindlu zenu, kufanele nidle ubisi olungena-lemongrass.
UMoses wababiza bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Yeni, nithathe inkomo ngemindeni yenu, nifile inkomo yepasha.

Uzothatha iqoqo le-hyssop, uyifake emlonyeni wegazi elingena emgodini, uthele emanzini okungena emgqeni womnyango, nakwezinye izingxenye zomngcele womgwaqo; begodu akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ozophuma emgqeni wendlu yakhe kuze kube ekuseni.

Uma ikosi ehamba, ehlasela ama-Egipta, bese nakabona igazi emgodini womnyango nakwezinye izingxenye zomnyango, khona-ke uzodlula kulowo mnyango, begodu ngeke avumele lowo obulalayo ukuba afike ezindlini zenu, ahlasele.
Wena nabantwana bakho kumele nithobele le mithetho, ibe ngumthetho ohlala njalo.
Uma nifika ezweni ikosi ozokunika lona, njengokuba wathi, kufanele nigcine lo mthetho.
Uma izingane zakho zibuza bona, 'Iyini incazelo yalo mcimbi?'

Uzothi kubo, Le yinyama yepasha kaYehova; ngenxa yokuthi wadlula phezu kwezindlu zakwaSirayeli eYiputa, lapho abulala khona ama-Egipta, begodu wagcina izindlu zethu. Abantu ke babhujululwa, bakhonza ikosi.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses noAron.

Ngobusuku obuphakathi, ikosi wabulala wonke umzali wesifazane ezweni laseYiputa, kusukela kumzali wesifazane kaFaro ohlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, kuze kube ngumzali wesifazane wowesifazane obekwe emgodini; wabulala begodu wonke umzali wesifazane wenyama.
UFaro wavuka ngobusuku, naye wonke umphathi wakhe, nabo bonke abantu baseMisiya; kwabe sengathi kungenxa yobuhlungu obukhulu eMisiya; ngombana kwakungeke kube khona indlu engafile kuyo.
UFaro wabiza uMoses noHaarnau ngobusuku, wathi, Yiya, phuma phakathi kwabantu bam, niye nabantwana bakaSirayeli; chofoza, nikhonze ikosi, njengombana nithe.
Nizithathe izingulube zenu, nezimbuzi zenu, njengombana nithi, nihambe; begodu nimi, ngibabusise.
Bathi abantu base-Egypt: "Kuyashesha bona niphume ezweni lenu; uma ningaphumanga, sizofa bonke!"
Bathi ke abantu, bathathe ukhilimu wabo ngaphambili kokuba ukhilimu usetshenziswe, bagqoke amabhodlela abo okudla ngezinto zabo zokugqoka, bazithwale ezinyaweni zabo.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bakwenza ngokusho kwelizwi likaMoses, becela abaMishithi izinto zesiliva negolide, nezigqoko.
UYehova wabeka abantu ebusweni beziYiputa, ukuze babe nabo; ngalokho abaSirayeli bathatha izimpahla zabaseYiputa.
Basuka ke abantu bakaSirayeli eRameshe, bafika eSukhothi; kwakungumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili amawaka amadoda ahamba ngezinyawo, ngaphandle kwabancane.
Abanye abantu abaningi bahamba nabo, kanye nezilwane ezifuywayo ezinkulu nezilwane.

Bapheka imbewu sabo, ebengayitholile emazweni aseYiputa, ibe yizingulube ezincane; ngombana imbewu sabo yayingenawo umhluzi, ngenxa yokuthi babethunyelwe emazweni aseYiputa, begodu abazange balungiselele ukudla.
Bahlala abantu bakaSirayeli eYiputa iminyaka engumakhulu amane namathathu.
Kwathi ngemuva kweminyaka engumakhulu amane namashumi amathathu, ngalolusuku oluthile, abantu bonke bakaYehova baphuma eYiputa, njengamabutho.
UYehova wagcina ubusuku balo, ukuba awakhiphe emazweni aseYiputa; ngalokho bonke abantwana bakaSirayeli bagcine lo busuku, ukuze bagweme ikosi, kuze kube sekuphele amalanga.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses noAron, Lokho wumthetho wosuku lwepasha: Akunamuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe azowudla.
Omunye umkhonzi wakho othengiwe, uma usuwutholile, uzokudla wona.
Omunye umuntu ohlala nawe isikhathi eside, noma umqashi, akakwazi ukuyidla.
Kudingeka idlalwe ngaphakathi kwendlu eyodwa. Ungathatha noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama ngaphandle kwendlu. Ngalokho-ke, ungaphula noma iyiphi yemisipha yayo.
Umphakathi wonke wase-Israyeli kufanele ujabulele.

Uma uhlala phakathi kwenu umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe, efuna ukwenza uPasha kaYehova, kufanele wonke indodana yakhe itholwe inkulumo, ukuze akwazi ukuyidla njengomuntu owazalwa kulo mhlaba; kodwana akukho muntu ongatholwe inkulumo angayidla.
Umthetho owodwa uzobe ukhona kulowo ozalwa ezweni lenu, nomunye ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Bakwenza njalo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses noAron.
Kwathi ngalolusuku olulodwa, ikosi wakhipha amadodana aseSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa, ngeqembu ngalinye, njengeqhwa.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi ikosi kuMoses: "Nquma ngimi wonke umuntu ovula ibele lakhe; wonke umuntu ovula ibele lakhe phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngabe ngumntu noma ibe yinyama, uzongiwo mina.

Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu, Khumbulani namuhla, usuku lokuphuma kwenu ezweni laseYiputa, lapho bebengabe abakhonzi khona; ikosi wakhipha khona isandla sakhe esinamandla; ngeke nidle noma yini eyenziwe nge-lemu.
Namhlanje, kunyaka we-Abib, usuka.

Uma ikosi ekhuluma kubaba bakho, bona uzokunika izwe lamaKanana, namaHeti, nama-Amoreti, namaHivi, namaJebhusi, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube; uma ekulethela khona, kufanele wenze lo mcimbi kulo nyaka.
Amalanga ezisithupha uzokudla inyama engabhakiwe, begodu ngosuku oluyisixhenxe uzoba nemini yokuphumula kuYehova.
Uzokudla ukudla okungenazithelo ezinoshukela nsuku ezisixhenxe; ngeke kube khona ubisi olunoshukela phakathi kwakho, begodu ngeke kube khona ubisi olunoshukela ezweni lakho lonke.
Uzotshela unyana wakho ngalolu busuku, uthi: Ngikwenza lokhu ngenxa yokuthi ikosi wenza kimi, lapho ngiphuma eYiputa.

Ngiyakwenza kube nguphawu esandlani sakho, begodu ube yisiqongo esiphakathi kwekhanda lakho, ukuze umthetho kaYehova uhlale emlonyeni wakho; ngombana isandla esinamandla soMoya oNgcwele waphuma wena eYiputa.
Ngalokho-ke kufanele ugcine lo mthetho ngesikhathi esifanele ngonyaka wonke.
Uma ikosi ekulethela izwe lakwaKanana, akunika lona, njengokuthi wakhuluma kuwe nababa bakho.
Uzonikela kukaNkulunkulu wonke umfazi wesifazane; wonke umfazi wesifazane wezinto zakho eziphilako uzowunikela kuzimu.

Uzokwazi ukuthenga ibhokhwe ngayinye ezalwa kuqala, ukunikeza inkomo endaweni yayo. Uma ungayithenganga, kufanele uvule umlomo wayo; begodu wonke umfazi ozalwa kuqala phakathi kwabantwana bakho uzowuthenga.
Ngosuku oluzayo, uma unyana wakho ebuza wena, ethi, Yikuphi lokhu? Uzothi kuye, uzimu wawusikhuphe ngesandla sakhe esinamandla ezweni laseMisiya, lapho sahlala khona njengezikhonzi.

Uma uFaro enqaba ukusivumela ukuba sihambe, ikosi wabulala wonke umuntu oqale ibele ezweni laseYiputa, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama; ngalokho-ke nginikela ngazo zonke izinja eziqala ibele kuYehova, begodu wonke indodana yami eqala ibele ngiyithenga.
Kuzobe sekuyiphawu esandlani sakho, begodu ibe yimiqondiso emehlweni akho; ngombana ikosi usikhuphule eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.

Kwathi lapho uFarawo evumela abantu ukuba bahambe, uzimu akawaqondisi ngendlela yezwe lamaFilistimi, nakuba incane khulu; wathi uzimu, Ngabe uma bebona umkhosi, bangase bashintshe inhliziyo sabo, babuye eYiputa.
uzimu waholela abantu emgwaqeni obanzi, ezweni laseNdiya, kuze kube yilwandle olumnyama. Abantu bakaSirayeli baphuma eYiputa, belungiselela ukulwa.

Wathatha uMoses amathambo ka-Yusufu naye; ngombana uYusufu wayewuthathele umnqumo amadodana aseSirayeli, wathi kubo, Uma uzimu efika ngokuqinisekile ukukusiza, khona-ke nizikhuphule izitho zami lapha nani.
Basuka eSukhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Ethame, enkabeni yesiqhingi.
UYehova wayehamba phambi kwabo ngemini, emgodini wezulu, ukuba abaqondise indlela; ngasebusuku, emgodini womlilo, ukuba ajabulise, ukuze bahambe ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Uphahla lwesibhakabhaka usuku lonke, nophahla lwesibhakabhaka somlilo ngobusuku bonke, aluzange lushiye indawo yalo phambi kwalabo bantu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 23"Utshonalela izingane zakwaSirayeli bona zishintshe begodu zenze isikhashana ePi-Hahiroth, phakathi kweMigdoli nelwandle; zezenze isikhashana emfuleni obhekene noBaalesephon.
UFaro uzothi, Abantwana bakaSirayeli bahamba ezweni; isiqhingi siwuvala umnyango wabo.
Ngizomisa inhliziyo kaFaro, aze alandela emuva kwabo; begodu ngizoba nomhlonishwa kuFaro nomndeni wakhe wonke; begodu bayazi abantu baseMijipi bona ngingiNkosi. Bakwenza njalo oonyana bakaSirayeli.

Bathi kubo ukumkani waseMisri, bathi abantu baphuma; uFaro nabangane bakhe bashintsha inhliziyo sabo ngalabo bantu, besithi, Sikwenze yini lokhu, bona sivumele amakhosikazi aseSirayeli ukuba ahambe? Akekho osebenza nathi.
UFaro walungisa imoto yakhe, wathatha ikosi yakhe naye.
Wathatha izimoto zakhe ezihuquzela phambili eziyikhulu nesishiyagalombili, nazo zonke izimoto zakwaYiputa, nabangane babo bonke.
Wakwenza ikosi inhliziyo kaFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, ibe yindida; walandela izingane zakwaSirayeli, ziphuma ngamandla.

Bathi abaMishi bayawalandela, bafinyelela kubo zonke izibhamu zikaFaro, nezithuthi zakhe zokulwa, nabangane bakhe abahamba ngezikebhe, nomndeni wakhe wonke, lapho behlala khona emfuleni, ePi-Hahirothi, ngaphesheya kukaBaale-zephon.
Uma uFaro efika, abantu bakaSirayeli baphakamisa amehlo abo, bebona bona amaMijipi ehamba kulandelana nabo; bakhathazeka khulu, bathandaza kuYehova.
Bathi kuMosesi, Akukhona yini eYiputa amagobho, ukuze ukhiphe siphume sife esiqhingini? Ukwenzeni kuphi lokhu, bona ukhiphe siphuma eYiputa?
Asikutsheleni yini lapho eYiputa, sithi, Sishiyeke, sisebenzele ama-Egyptians? Kungcono ukuba sisebenzele ama-Egyptians, kunalokho bona siphele kulo mfula womhlaba.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Musani ukukhathazeka; hlalani, nibone bona ikosi uzokusindisa nini namuhla; ngombana aBamisrayeli ababonayo namuhla, ngeke nibabone begodu.
uzimu uzobhekana nabanye ngenxa yenu, kodwana nihlale nihlala phasi.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Kungani na bona unqume ngami? Beka izingane zakwaSirayeli zihambe.
Kodwana wena, uphakamise inkomishi yakho, ubambe isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, uhlukanise amanzi, ukuze izingane zakwaSirayeli zihambe phakathi kolwandle ngeqhwa.
Ngizomisa inhliziyo yama-Egipta, bafike kulandelana kwabo; begodu ngizoba nomhlonishwa kuFaro, nenkosi yakhe yonke, namabhayisikili akhe, nabahamba ngezinyawo bakhe.
Bayazi bona nginguYehova abantu baseMijipi, uma ngibona ubuhle ngaphesheya kukaFaro, namabhayisikili akhe, nabahhashi bakhe.
Umbingeleli kaThixo, owahamba phambi kweqhwa lakwaSirayeli, wehla waya ngasemva kwabo; begodu umbhoshongo wezulu wehla wasuka ngaphambili labo, wahlala ngasemva kwabo.

Wafika phakathi kweqembu lakwaMisiriya neqembu lakwaSirayeli. Ngobusuku bonke udaba lwaba mnyama ngasohlangothini olulodwa, begodu lukhanya ngasohlangothini olulodwa; ngoko ke, akukho okunye okufinyelela kolunye usuku lonke.
Wamisa uMoses isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, begodu ikosi wehlisa umlambo ngomoya onamandla wasempumalanga yonke le busuku, wakwenza kube yindawo emnyama; amanzi ahlukaniswa.
Baye badlula emiphakathini yolwandle, behamba ngomhlaba omnyama, begodu amanzi abe ngudonga ngakwesokudla kwabo nakwesobunxele babo.
Bathi ama-Egipta awalandela, ayewalandela phakathi kolwandle, wonke amahhashi kaFaro, namabhayisikili akhe, nabangane bakhe abahamba ngezinyawo.
Ngaphambi kokuvuka kwelanga, ikosi wabheka umkhosi wama-Egipta, esuka emgodini womlilo nezulu, wabasusa, wathi:
Wakwenza bona amasondo emoto sabo aphume, bakwazi ukugibela ngosayizi. Bathi abaMishi: "Sizophuma phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngombana ikosi ubhekana nabo emazweni aseMishi."
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Nciphisa isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, ukuze amanzi abuye abe ngaphesheya kwabaYiputa, namabhasi abo, namabhayisikili abo.

UMoses wehlisa isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, nolwandle luye lwabuyela endaweni yalo lapho kuvuka khona ubusuku; abaMishi bafuna ukugibela ngaphandle kwalo, kodwana ikosi wabasusa emaphakathi olwandle.
Ulwandle lwabuyela, lwagquma izimoto zokulwa, namabhayisikili, wonke umkhosi kaFaro, owawungene emfuleni ngemuva kwabo; kwakungekho umuntu owodwa wabo owahlala.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli ayehamba phakathi kolwandle, ezindaweni ezishisayo; begodu amanzi abe ngudonga ngakwesokudla kwabo nakwesobunxele babo.
Ngomhla lowo, ikosi wasindisa amaSirayeli esandla sama-Egipta; begodu amaSirayeli abona ama-Egipta enkabeni yolwandle.
Babona amadoda aseSirayeli isandla esikhulu ikosi alenzako kuma-Egipta, bakhathazeka ngenxa kaYehova; bakholwa kuYehova, noMoses umkhonzi wakhe.
Wathi uMoses, nabantwana bakaSirayeli, bakhuluma ngalolu limi kuYehova, besithi: Ngizokhuluma kuYehova, ngombana wabhida khulu; ingulube nomfazi wayo wabeka emfuleni.
uzimu unamandla ami, nengoma yami. Wangisindisa; Nguye uzimu wami, begodu ngizowubonga; uzimu kababa wami, begodu ngizowuphakamisa.
uzimu ungumnqobi, igama lakhe nguThixo.
Wabeka elwandle izimoto zikaFiraun, nemikhosi yakhe. Abaphathi abangcono kaFiraun baqhutshwa emfuleni omnyama.
Izintaba-mlilo zazigqoka, Zazishiya zibuyele phasi njengetshe.
Isandla sakho sakwesokudla, Kosi, sidumile ngokunamandla; isandla sakho sakwesokudla, Kosi, sishaya isibhamu.
Ngenkundla yakho enkulu, ubeke phasi labo abaphikisayo wena; wathumela inkohliso yakho ekhanyayo, yababulala njengamatshe afile.
Ngomoya ophuma emlonyeni wakho, amanzi akhuphuka. Amanzi ahlanzekile aphakama njengedonga. Amanzi amahle ayeqinile phakathi kolwandle.
Uzothi umnakwabo, Ngizowalandela, ngiwathole; ngizohlukanisa konke okusemandleni ami; ngizothatha konke okufunayo; ngizokhipha ikebhe lami, begodu isandla sami sizobabulala.
Waphuza umphefumulo wakho, ulwandle lwabafihla; bahlanganiswa njengamapuleti emanzini amakhulu.
Ubani phakathi kwamasiko ofana nawe, Kosi yami? Ubani ofana nawe, onesithunzi esingcwele, onothando olukhulu, owenza izimanga?
Ubambe isandla sakho sokudla, begodu izwe liwudlulisa.
Ngothando lwakho uzoba nomqondisi wabo bonke abantu obabambisene nabo, begodu ngokunamandla akho uzobaqondisa ezweni lakho elingcwele.
Izizwe zizozizwa, zize ziqhekeke; ubuhlungu buzothatha abantu bakaFilisti.
Bazokhathazeka abaphathi base-Edom, begodu labo abanamandla aseMowabhi bazogxeka; bonke abantu baseKanana bazogxeka izandla zabo.

Ubuhlungu nokukhathazeka kuzoba phezu kwabo; ngenxa yobukhazikhazi besandla sakho, bazobe bengakhululeki njengamatshe, kuze kube yilapho abantu bakho bedlula, Kosi, kuze kube yilapho abantu abathengise wena bedlula.
Uzowangenisa, uzowatshala emfuleni wakho, endaweni, Kosi, oyilungiselele indawo yokuhlala kwakho, indawo engcwele, Kosi, eyenziwe ngamehlo akho.
uzimu uzolawula kuze kube sekupheleni.

Kwathi amabhayisikili kaFaro, namabhasi akhe, nabangani bakhe abahamba ngebhayisikili, bafika elwandle; ikosi wabuyisela amanzi olwandle phezu kwabo; kodwana izingane zakwaSirayeli zadlula phakathi kolwandle ngamanzi apholile.
Wathi uMiriyamu umprofeti, inkosikazi ka-Aron, wathabatha intambo esandlani sakhe; nabesifazane bonke balandelana, bedlala izingcingo, bedansa.
UMiriyam wakhuluma kubo, wathi: "Gcwabeni kuYehova; ngombana usindise ngobuqotho obukhulu. Wabeka elwandle ingulube nomfazi wayo."
Wathi uMosis, esuka emfuleni oMnyama, wabahambisa amaSirayeli, bafika esiqhingini saseShure; behamba amalanga amathathu esiqhingini, bangatholanga amanzi.
Bafika eMara, kodwana abakwazi ukuphuza amanzi ayo, ngombana amanzi awo amnandi khulu; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lendawo bona Mara.
Bathi abantu kuMoses, besithi, Sidla yini?
UMoses wathandaza kuYehova; ikosi wambonisa itshe elilodwa, wayalela amanzi, begodu amanzi abuye abe mnandi. Wabanikeza khona umthetho nomthetho, wabahlola khona, wathi kubo: "Ubani lo muntu?

Wathi, Uma ulalela izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho ngokucophelela, begodu wenze okulungile emehlo akhe, uma unquma izimiso zakhe, begodu ugcina zonke izenzo zakhe, ngeke ngikulethe phezu kwakho noma iyiphi yezifo engivele ngazilethela ku-Egipta; ngombana mina ngiwuNkulunkulu ophilisayo.
Bafika e-Elim, lapho bekukhona khona imifula yamanzi eyishumi nambili, nezihlahla zezimbali ezimashumi asixhenxe; bamisa izindlu zangasese eduze kwezilwandle.
Basuka e-Elim, befika esiqhingini sase-Sin, esisephakathi kwe-Elim neSina, ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesithathu, ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo eYiputa;
Ibandla lonke lakhala ngoMosesi noAron ezweni lezulu elimnyama.

Bathi kubo abazalwane bakaSirayeli, "Ngabe ikosi angasibulala eYiputa, lapho sahlala khona eduze kwamabhodwe enyama, lapho sadla khona ukudla okugcwele inhliziyo yethu! Kodwana-ke, nisisikhuphele kulo mfula womhlaba, ukuze le ndawo yonke ibe nendlala.

Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Bheka, ngizokulethela inkomishi esuka esibhakabhakeni; abantu bangaphuma ngosuku ngalunye, baqoqe ukudla okudingekayo usuku ngalunye, ukuze ngibacabangele, bona bazohamba yini emthethweni wami.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili kumele balungiselele bona yini abazoyifaka, begodu izobe iphindwe kabili kunezinto abazoziqoqa ngezinye izinyanga.
Wathi uMoses noAron kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Namuhla ekuseni nizokwazi bona nguYehova owabasusa ezweni laseYiputa.
Ngomsombuluko nizokubona ubuhle bukaYehova, ngombana walalela ukucasuka kwenu kuye; thina siyini, bona nicasuke nathi?

Wathi uMosis, Uma ikosi ekunika inyama ukuyodla kusasa, nokudla okugcwele inhliziyo yenu ekuseni; ngombana unguNkulunkulu owaziyo inkohlakalo yenu ngaye. Sibani na thina? Akusiyo inkohlakalo yethu eniyenzayo, kodwana yinkohlakalo yoNkulunkulu.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Bheka ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, sithi, Njalo nifikeni kuYehova; ngombana yena walalela ukubuzwa kwenu.
Kwathi, lapho uAron ekhuluma khona kubandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, babheka emazweni asogwini, bese bebona izulu likaYehova likhanya emlilweni.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Ngikutshele, ngikuvile ukukhuluma kwabantu bakaSirayeli; khuluma kubo, usithi: Uma ilanga liphuma, nizodla inyama, begodu uma lifika ekuseni, nizophuza isidlo sakusihlwa; khona-ke nizokwazi bona ngiyami uzimu wenu.
Kwathi ngesikhathi sobusuku, kwafika ama-quails, wagubuzela isibhedlela; begodu ngesikhathi sakusihlwa, kwaba khona ungqimba lwesihlabathi esijikeleze isibhedlela.
Uma imvula idlula, khona-ke ezweni elivuthayo bekukhona izinhlayiya ezincane, ezijikelezayo, ezithambile njengeqhwa elibukhali eningizimu.
Wathi uMosis kubo, "Le yinyama oyinikayo ikosi ukuba niyidle; uma niyidla, nizokwazi bona ngimi uzimu wakho." UMoses waphendula wathi kubo, "Inani elinjalo likhona.
Lokho wumthetho kaYehova, uthi: Nizoqoqa wonke umuntu ngokuya ngokudla kwakhe; nizothatha i-omeri ngaye wonke umuntu ohlala ekhempini yakho.
Bakwenza njalo abantu bakaSirayeli; abanye baqoqa khulu, abanye baqoqa kancane.
Uma beyilinganisela, lowo othole khulu akhenge adlulele, begodu lowo othole kancane akhenge adlulele. Wonke umuntu waqoqa ngokuya ngesidingo sakhe.
Wathi uMoses kubo, "Akukho muntu ongayigcina kuze kube ekuseni."
Baningi phakathi kwabo abazange balalela uMoses, kodwana bagcina okuthile kiwo kuze kube ekuseni; kwathi lapho kwavela khona amakhowe, begodu kwaba nephunga. UMosis waphoqelela.
Ngomsombuluko wonke umuntu waqoqa konke okudingayo. Lapho ilanga liqala ukushushuluza, laphuma.
Kwathi ngosuku lwesine, baqoqa inani eliphindwe kabili, ama-gomeri amabili umuntu ngamunye. Bafika abakhulu bebandla, babatshela uMoses.

Wathi kubo, Lokho wumthetho kaYehova, ethi, NgoMsombuluko yimini yokuphumula, iSabhati engcwele kuYehova; begodu uma nifuna ukubhaka, kuphikeni, begodu uma nifuna ukubhaka, kuphikeni; kodwana noma yini engalahlwe, gcinani kuze kube ubusuku.
Bagcina khona kuze kube ekuseni, njengokuba uMoses ewiselayo; kwaze kwaba sekungabi nephunga, kwaze kwaba nezinhlanzi ngaphakathi.
Wathi uMoses, Kulileni namuhla; ngombana namuhla yiShabbati kaYehova; namuhla ngeke niyithole phezu komhlaba.
Nizoyiqoqa amalanga ezine; kodwana ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, usuku lweShabbat, ngeke kube khona.
Baphuma abanye abantu ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, ukuze baqoqe; kodwana abengatholanga.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Ngabe nizoyeka kuze kube nini ukulalela imiyalelo yami nemithetho yami?

Khumbulani bona ikosi wamnika usuku lokuphumula; ngalokho ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili aninika ukudla kwezinsuku ezimbili. Ngosuku lwesine, wonke umuntu ahlale lapho uhlala khona; akukho muntu ozophuma ngaphandle.
Baphumule abantu usuku oluyisixhenxe.
Amadodana kaSirayeli abiza lo mnqumo bona i-manna. Yabe mhlophe njengezithelo ze-coriander, ibe nephunga elifana neziphuzo ezincane ezenziwe ngojusi.

Wathi uMoses, Lokho wukuthi ikosi awawisele umthetho ngalo: Uzogcina i-omeri ye-manna kuze kube namuhla, ukuze izingane zenu zibone isidlo eninikele ngaso esiqhingini, lapho ngizikhipha khona ezweni laseYiputa.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Thola ibhodlela elilodwa, uthele kulo umgomelo owodwa we-manna, uyibeke phambi koYehova, ukuze igcinwe kuze kube yilapho.
U-Aron wabeka i-manna phambi kwebhokisi lesinqumo, ukuze ligcinwe, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Badla i-manna iminyaka emashumi mane, kuze kube sekufikeni kwabo ezweni elihlala abantu; badla i-manna kuze kube sekufikeni kwabo emfuleni waseKanana.
I-omer iyingxenye yesithupha ye-efa.
Ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lahamba lisuka esiqhingini sika-Sin, behamba ngemizila sabo, njengokuthi ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; bamisa isikhashana eRefidim; kwakungekho amanzi abantu abawadla.
Baze babhekana noMoses, bathi, Sinike amanzi bona siphuze. Wathi uMoses, Kungani na ukubhekana nami? Kungani na ubuza uzimu?
Kwathi abantu bekhala khona ngenxa yokudla amanzi, baphoxela uMoses, bathi, Kungani na bona usikhuphule eYiputa? Ufuna ukusibulala thina, nezingane zethu, nezilwane zethu, ngokudla.
UMoses wehlalela ikosi, wathi, Ngingakwenzani nalabo bantu? Basuke bengishaya ngemigodi.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Yiya phambi kwalabo abantu, uze uthathe nabantu abakhulu phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli nawe; begodu isandla sakho, osiphikisayo isiNtaba, usithathe esandla sakho, uye.
Bheka, ngizohlala khona phambi kwakho, eduze kwengcindezi eHorebi; ugweme ingcindezi, begodu amanzi azophuma kuyo, abantu bazodla. UMoses wakwenza njalo phambi kwezikhulu zakwaSirayeli.
Wabiza igama lesi sifundazwe bona iMasa, noMeribha, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu bakaSirayeli, begodu ngenxa yokuthi bacindezele ikosi, bathi, UYehova unethu yini, noma akakho?
Bafika ama-Amaleki, bahlasela abantu bakaSirayeli eRefidim.
Wathi uMoses kuYoshuwa, Khetha nathi abantu, uyeke ukuhlasela ama-Amaleki; ngizohlala kusasa phezu kophahla oluphezulu, nginesandla sikaThixo esandla sam.
Wakwenza uYoshuwa njengokuthi uMoses kuye, wahlasela ama-Amaleki; kodwana uMosis noAron noHure bafika phezulu emfuleni.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho uMoses ephakamisa izandla zakhe, amaSirayeli awina; kodwana ngaso soke isikhathi lapho ekhuphula izandla zakhe, ama-Amalekhi awina.

Kwathi uma izinyawo zikaMosis zaphazamiseka, bathatha itshe, bayibeka ngaphasi kwakhe, wahlala phezu kwalo; uAron noHure babambe izinyawo zakhe, omunye ngakwesobunxele, omunye ngakwesokudla. Ngaleyo le izinyawo zakhe zahlala ziqinile kuze kuphele usuku.
UYoshuwa wahlasela isizwe sama-Amaleki ngeqhwa.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Bhala lokhu encwadini, ukuze kube yisikhumbuzo, begodu uxhumane noYoshuwa bona ngizocima ngokupheleleko isikhumbuzo sakwa-Amaleki ngezansi komhlaba.
UMoses wehla isibingelelo, wabiza igama lakhe bona, "uzimu ngusibonakaliso sami."
Wathi, UYehova usho lutho: uzimu uzobe esempini no-Amaleki kuze kube yiminyaka eminingi.
UJethro, umpristi waseMidiyani, udadewabo kaMoses, wafunda zonke izinto azenzayo uzimu kuMoses, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe, bona ikosi wakhipha amaSirayeli eYiputa.
UMoses washiya uSipora indodana yakhe, waya ekhaya lakhe; begodu uJethro, ubaba wakhe wesifazane, wamthatha.
Wabiza igama lomunye ngegama likaGershon; ngombana wathi uMoses, Ngiye ngangihlala ezweni elingaphandle.
Omunye igama lakhe lalinguEliyezeri; ngombana wathi, uzimu kababa wami wawungusizo lwami, wasindisa ngasekhephu likaFiraun.
UJethro, udadewabo kaMoses, wafika kuMosis esiqhingini, yena nomfazi wakhe, nabantwana bakhe; uMosis ke wayesesitezi esiphakeme saNkulunkulu.
Wathumela uYethro umlayezo kuMoses, esithi, Ngizofika kuwe, ngiyinkosikazi yakho uJethro, nomfazi wakho nabantwana bakhe ababi.
Waphuma uMoses, wabhekana noyisekazi wakhe, wabhujiswa, wamxosha. Babuzana bona baphile kanjani; kwathi lapho befika esitezi.
Wathi uMoses kuyise-ndaba wakhe zonke izinto azenzayo ikosi kuFaro, nakwaMishi, ngenxa yamaSirayeli; zonke izimo ezibuhlungu ababenazo enyangeni, nokuthi ikosi wabasindisele.
Wajabula khulu uJethro, lapho ekhuluma ngazo zonke izinto ezinhle azenzayo ikosi kwabaSirayeli, ekusindiseni kwabo emazweni aseMijiphu.
Wathi uJethro, Kuhlolwe ikosi, owakusindiseleni emaYiputa, nakumaFaro; owakusindisela abantu ngaphasi kwesandla samaYiputa.
Manje ngiyazi bona ikosi mkhulu ukudlula bonke abangcwele, ngenxa yalezo zinto azenzayo kilabo abazabalalisa ngazo amaSirayeli.
UYethro, udadewabo kaMoses, wanikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula nokudla kwasekuseni kuThixo. Wafika uAron, nabaholi bonke bakaSirayeli, ukuba badla ukudla nodadewabo kaMoses phambi koNkulunkulu.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, wahlala uMoses ephatha abantu; begodu abantu babekhona phambi kwakhe kusukela ekuseni kuze kube semini.

Wabona ugogo wakhe zonke izinto azenzayo abantu, wathi kuye, Yini le nto oyenza ngayo abantu? Kungani na bona uhlale ulawula wena kuphela, begodu abantu bonke bekhona phambi kwakho kusukela ekuseni kuze kube sebusuku?
UMoses waphendula wathi kuye, "Ngenxa yokuthi abantu bezifika kimi ukubuza bona yini uzimu ufuna.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho banenkinga, bafika kimi, begodu ngixazulula phakathi komuntu nomunye, begodu ngiwafundisa imithetho nemithetho kaThixo."
Wathi udadewabo kaMusa kuye: "Kungakuhle lokho okwenzayo.
Uzolahlekelwa yisikhathi sakho kanye nalabo abantu abafika kuwe. Le misebenzi inzima khulu kuwe. Awukwazi ukuyenza wena kuphela.
Manje khuluma nami, begodu ngizokunika iziphakamiso ezithile, begodu uzimu ube nawe. Kudingeka bona ukhulume ngezwe phambi kukaThixo begodu uveze izinkinga zabo kuye.
Bafundise izimiso zakhe namasiko akhe, ubabonise bona kufanele baphile kanjani, nokuthi kumele benzeni umsebenzi.

Kodwana ukhethe phakathi kwabantu bonke amadoda anamandla, abantu abagwemayo uzimu, abanethemba, abangamthandanga umshwalense; uwabeke phezu kwabantu, abe ngabaphathi bamawaka, namakhulu, namahlanu, namashumi.

Vumela bona bagweme izimo zomuntu ngaso soke isikhathi. Bangakwazi ukuletha izimo ezinzima kuwe, kodwana bangagwema izimo ezilula ngokwabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza umthwalo wakho ube mncane, ngombana bazowuhlukanisa nawe.
Uma ukwenza lokhu, begodu Allah uyakucela ukuba, uzokwazi ukumelana nobunzima. Nabo bonke abantu bazoya ekhaya labo bekhululekile."
UMoses walalela udadewabo, wakwenza konke obekushoyo.
Wakhetha amadoda anamandla kuzo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, wakwenza abe ngabaphathi bomphakathi, abaphathi bamawaka, namakhulu, namahlanu, namashumi.
Bathi balungisa abantu ngaso soke isikhathi; izingxabano ezinzima babeziletha kuMoses, kodwana izingqungquthela ezilula babezilungisa bona.
Wathi uMosis, ashiye udadewabo, wahamba; waya ezweni lakhe lakhe.
Ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo eYiputa, ngomhla owodwa bafika emfuleni iSinayi.
Besuka eRefidim, befika emfuleni iSina; bamisa khona amaSirayeli esihlabathini, phambi kombhoshongo.
UMoses wanyuka waya kuThixo, ikosi wambiza emfuleni, wathi, Kulokhu ozothi emndenini kaYakobi, begodu uzokutshela izingane zakwaSirayeli:
Wabona bona ngikwenze kanjani eYiputa, nokuthi ngakuthwala kanjani phezu kwamaphiko omnqumo, begodu ngakuletha kimi.
Uma ningilalela ngeqiniso, begodu nigcina isivumelwano sami, khona-ke ningaba impahla yami ekhethekile phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe; ngombana umhlaba wonke ungumkhaya wami.
kodwana nizobe ngumbuso wami wamabhishobhi, nezwe elingcwele. Lawa amazwi ozokhuluma ngawo kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wabuyela uMoses, wahlanganisa bonke abakhulu bomphakathi, wabatjela zonke lezi zinto ikosi abemwisile bona azikhulume.
Baphendula bonke abantu ndawonye, bathi, Zonke izinto akhuluma ngazo ikosi sizozenza. UMoses waveza kukaNkulunkulu impendulo yabantu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, "Njengombana ngizofika kuwe entwasahlobo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukungilalela uma bekhuluma nawe, begodu bakholwa kuwe nsuku zonke." UMosesi waveza ikosi amazwi abantu.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Iya kubo abantu, ubangcwelele namuhla nakusasa; bahlanze izigqoko zabo;
Uzobe ulungile ngosuku olulandelayo, emini yesithathu. Ngosuku olulodwa ikosi uzowela phezu komfula iSinayi phambi kwamehlo abantu bonke.

Uthi uMoses kuMosis: "Nquma umkhawulo phakathi kwalabo abantu, bese ukhuluma kubo, usithi: 'Khumbulani bona ningayikhuphuka intaba-mlilo, noma bona ningayifinyeleli isiphetho sayo; wonke umuntu ozoyifinyelela intaba-mlilo uzofa.

Akukho muntu ozowushaya lowo muntu; kufanele agwegwe ngetshe, noma aqhutshwe ngamabhodlela. Noma ngabe umuntu, noma ngabe isilwane, ngeke siphile. Uma nje isidumbu sengulube siphuza umsindo omde, kumele bafike emfuleni."
UMoses wehla emfuleni, waya kilabo abantu, wabahlanza; begodu bahlamba izigqoko zabo.
Wathi ke kubo abantu, Bukelani kuze kube yimini yesithathu; akufanele nihlangane nendodakazi.

Ngosuku lwesithathu, ekuseni, kwabe sengathi kunezingqimba-ngqimba, nezingqimba-ngqimba, nezivunguvungu, namafu abandayo emfuleni; begodu kwabe sengathi kukhona umsindo omkhulu khulu wezinhlamvu; abantu bonke abasemakhazeni bakhathazeka.
Wakhipha uMoses abantu ezindaweni zokuhlala, ukuba bahlangane nozimu; behlala eduze komfula.
begodu iNtaba iSinayi yaqhuma ngomlilo, ngombana ikosi wakhuphuka phezu kwayo emlilweni; begodu iphunga layo likhuphuka, njengephunga lefuthe, begodu intaba yonke yaqhuma khulu.
