Kuzo zonke amalanga zomsebenzi wakhe, angeke kube khona umqhele ekhanda lakhe; kuze kuphele usuku lwakhe lokuzinikela kukaNkulunkulu, ungcwele; kufanele avumele izinwele zakhe zikhule.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho ehlonishwa khona ikosi, angeke afike kumuntu ofile.
Uma ubaba wakhe, noma umama wakhe, noma udadewabo, noma inkosikazi yakhe, befa, angeke enze isono ngenxa sabo; ngombana isibopho sakhe sokuba nguNazirethi sikaThixo sikhona ekhanda lakhe.
Ngazo zonke amalanga zobuNazirethi bakhe, ungcwele kuYehova.
Uma umuntu efa ngaso soke isikhathi phambi kwakhe, begodu enze izinwele zakhe zibe nephunga elingcolile, kufanele awele ikhanda lakhe ngosuku lwakhe lokuhlanzeka, usuku oluyisixhenxe.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, kufanele athathe izinkomo ezimbili, noma izingulube ezimbili ezincane, aze aziveze kumpristi, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Ubaba-ke uzonikela ngayinye ibe yisonka, nenye ibe yisonka esiqhutshwayo, ukuze alungise isono sakhe, ngenxa yokufa kwakhe; begodu ngosuku olulodwa uzomisa isisu sakhe.

Uzophinde ahlukanise yena ngokwakhe kuYehova, kuze kube yisikhathi esiphelele sesinqumo sakhe; begodu uzoletha inkomo eneminyaka eyodwa ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wesono. Amalanga zangaphambilini ngeke zibalolwe, ngombana amalanga zokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe zazingenawo uthuli.
Lokho wumthetho weNazirethi, uma amalanga zokuzibophezela kwakhe ziphelile; kumele athathwe emnyango wetente lengqungquthela,

Ake afake khona iminikelo yakhe kuYehova: inkomo eyodwa yonyaka owodwa, engabi necala, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa; inkomo eyodwa yonyaka owodwa, engabi necala, ibe yi yizipho zesono; nomuntu oyedwa, ongabi necala, abe ngumnikelo wokudla.

Uzothatha begodu ibhokisi elilodwa lemifino engaphekwanga, imifino eyenziwe ngesikhunta esiqinile, encibilikisiwe ngophethiloli, nama-waffles ancibilikisiwe ngophethiloli, kanye nomnikelo wabo wokudla, neminikelo sabo yokushiswa.
Umbingeleli uzozinikela phambi kukaNkulunkulu, alungiselele isonka sesono, nomnikelo wokushiswa.
Uzonikela ngomuntu wesifazane njengomnikelo wokuthula kuYehova, kanye nebhodlela lenyama engaphekiwe; begodu umbingeleli uzonikela ngesondlo sayo sokudla nesiphuzo.

Uzothatha izinwele zakhe, azigqugquzele emgodini wesitezi sokuhlangana, aze azibeke emlilweni ongaphansi komnikelo wokudla. Uzokhipha begodu izinwele zakhe, azigqugquzele emgodini wesitezi sokuhlangana.

Uma uNazireli egqoke izinwele zakhe, khona-ke umbingeleli uzobeka emlonyeni wakhe isifuba sembuzi esithosiwe, nekhekhe elilodwa elingenakho ukhilimu, kanye nomquba owodwa ongenakho ukhilimu osuka ebhokisini.
Uzozishaya ngazo phambi koYehova, zibe ngumnikelo oshiswayo. Zingcwele, ziwuwe umbingeleli, kanye nebele elifihliwe, nemilenze enikeziwe; begodu ngemuva kwalokho uzokudla iwayini loNaziri.

Lokho wumthetho weNaziri, owenza isibopho, ngomnikelo wakhe ozowuletha kuYehova ngenxa yobungcwele bakhe, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto angakwazi ukuzithola; ngazo zonke izibopho zakhe azozenza, ngokwemithetho yeNaziri.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis ku-Aron nonyana bakhe: "Kule le nizobabalisa abantu bakaSirayeli.
UYehova akubabazise, begodu akugcine.
uzimu angakuxwayisa begodu akuthande.
uzimu akubonakalise wena, begodu akunikeze uxolo.
Ngale le bazobeka igama lami phezu kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, begodu ngizobasiza.
UMoses, lapho eqedile ukumisa itente, wayithambisa, wayingcwelela, nayo yonke impahla yayo; wayithambisa begodu isibingelelo, nezinto zayo zonke, wayazingcwelela.
Ngosuku olulodwa, abaphathi bakaSirayeli banikela ngesipho; laba baholi bezindlu zabazali babo, abaphathi bezizwe zabo, labo abaye babhaliswa kubo.

Bathi, "Sizonikela ngomnikelo wethu kuYehova: izimoto eziyisishiyagalombili ezigqugquzelwe, nezinkomo eziyishumi nambili; imoto ngayinye ngamadodana amabili, nengulube ngayinye ngamadodana amabini; sizonikela ngazo phambi kwekamelo elingcwele.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uzozithola kuzo, ukuze zisetshenziselwe umsebenzi wendawo yokudlela yokuhlangana; uzozinikeza amaLevi, ngaso soke isikole, ngokuya ngomsebenzi wabo.
Wathi uMoses, athathe izimoto nezingulube, wazisabalalisa kumaLevi.
Wabanikeza amabhayisikili amabili, nezingulube ezine, abaGershoni, ngokwemisebenzi sabo.
kanye namabhayisikili amane, nezinkomo eziyisishiyagalombili, zamadodana kaMerari, ngokwemisebenzi sabo; basebenza ngaphasi kwesandla sika-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umpristi.
Amadodakazi ka-Kohati uMoses akayinika, ngombana babeziphatha izinto ezingcwele, bezithwala emlenzeni wabo.
Kwathi lapho isibingelelo sibhakwe khona, abakhulu banikela ngezinto zokuyilungiselela; banikela ngomnikelo wabo phambi kwesibingelelo.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Uzonikela umholi ngamunye isipho sakhe sokuzibophezela kwesibhedlela, ngosuku ngalunye.
Ngosuku lokuqala wanikela ngomnikelo wakhe uNahshon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi, waseYuda.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula, izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka emihlanu ubudala. Lowo ngumnikelo kaNahshon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi.
Ngosuku lwesibili wanikela uNethaneli unyana ka-Zuare, umholi wakwa-Issakare.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaNathaneli unyana ka-Suwari.
Ngosuku lwesithathu wanikela uElibha, unyana kaHeloni, umholi wamaZabuloni, ngomnikelo wakhe.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaEliyaba unyana kaHeloni.
Ngosuku lwesine wanikela uElisuri unyana ka-Shedeure, umholi wamaRubheni, ngesipho sakhe.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,

kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, nezimbuzi ezifileyo eziyisishiyagalombili, nezingulube ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala eziyisishiyagalombili. Lowo ngumnikelo kaElisure unyana kaShedeure.
Ngosuku lwesihlanu wanikela uShelumiyeli, unyana kaZurisadai, umphathi wezingane zikaSimeoni.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala amahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishadai.
Ngosuku lwesine wanikela uEliyashaphe, unyana ka-Dehuyeli, umholi wabafazi bakaGadi.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaEliyasaf, unyana ka-Dehuyeli.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe wanikela uElishama unyana ka-Amihude, umholi wabaLevi baseEphrayim.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula, izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaElishama unyana ka-Amihude.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili wanikela uGamaliyeli, unyana kaPedasuri, umphathi wezingane zikaManase.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,

kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, nezimbuzi ezifileyo eziyisishiyagalombili, nezingulube ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala eziyisishiyagalombili. Lowo ngumnikelo kaGamayeli unyana kaPedashuri.
Ngosuku lwesine wanikela uAbidan, unyana kaGideoni, umholi wamaBhenjamini, ngomnikelo wakhe.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula, izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka emihlanu ubudala. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Abidan unyana kaGideoni.
Ngosuku oluyishumi wanikela u-Ahiezer, unyana ka-Ammisadai, umphathi wabangane bakaDani.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Ahiezer unyana ka-Amishadai.
Ngosuku oluyishumi nanye, wanikela uPagiyeli unyana ka-Okran, umholi wabaLevi baseAsheri.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo kaPagiyeli unyana ka-Okrane.
Ngosuku oluyishumi nambili wanikela u-Ahira, unyana ka-Enani, umholi wabafazi bakaNafetali.

Umnikelo wakhe waba isipuni esisodwa sesilivere, esiyishekeli elilodwa nenkulungwane namathathu, inkomishi eyodwa yesilivere eyisishiyagalombili seshekeli, ngokweshekeli lendawo engcwele; zombili zazigcwele ubisi olunomsoco oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokudla.
Waletha nebhodlela elilodwa legolide, elilinganiselwa ngeshekeli ezilishumi, ligcwele uvumba;
ingulube encane eyodwa, nomuntu wesifazane owodwa, nenyama yomntwana oneminyaka emihlanu ubudala ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa;
inkomo eyodwa yaba yisonka sesono,
kanye neminikelo yokuthula: izinkomo ezimbili, namakhoboka amahlanu, namabhokhwe amahlanu, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala mahlanu. Lowo ngumnikelo ka-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lokho kwakungumnikelo wamadodana aseSirayeli, wokuzibophezela kwesihlalo somlilo ngosuku lokuyinquma: izinkomishi zesiliva ezingu-12, namabhodwe egolide ayizi-12.

Umthamo wesinkwa esisodwa sesilivere wawungushekeli elilodwa neshumi namashumi amathathu, nomthamo wombhoshongo ngamunye ube yishekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili; wonke umthamo wezithelo zesilivere waba ngushekeli ezinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu amane, ngokweshekeli engcwele.
Izitsha zegolide eziyishumi nambili, ezigcwele uvumba, isisindo sazo zonke izitsha zegolide kwakuyishekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili, ngokweshekeli yendawo engcwele.
Inyama yomnikelo wokushiswa yaba yizingulube ezingu-12, nezimvu eziyisithupha, namabele aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala ayi-12, kanye nesibopho sazo sokudla; amabhokhwe amane abe yisonka.

Inyama yomnikelo wokuthula ibiyizingulube ezingu-24, nezimvu ezingu-60, nezinkomo ezingu-60, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala ayi-60. Lowo ngumnikelo wokuqokwa kwesihlalo somlilo, ngemuva kokuyibhaka.

Uma uMoses efika entabeni yokuhlangana, ukuba akhulume noYehova, walalela ilizwi elikhuluma naye phezulu emgodini womthetho, phakathi kwezilwane eziphilako ezimbili. Wathetha naye ngoNkulunkulu, wathi:
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Usho ku-Aron: Uma umisa izibani eziyisixhenxe, kufanele zikhanya ezindaweni ezingaphambili zesibani.
Wakwenza njalo uAron; wamisa izibani, ukuze zikhanya phambi kwesibambo sokukhanya, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
UMoses wayenza ngegolide, eyenziwe ngokhonkolo, kusukela esinqeni sayo kuze kube amabhulukwe ayo. Wayenza ngokwesifanekiso ikosi abemwise sona.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Thola amaLevi phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, uwahlanze.
Ngale le uzowahlanza: uzobaphilisa ngamanzi, bahlanzwe; bahlanze isikhumba sabo soke, bahlanze izingubo zabo, bahlanzeke.
Bazothatha inkomo encane, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, ubisi olufino oluhlanganisiwe nephethiloli; begodu uzothatha inkomo encane eyesibili, ibe yisonka sosono.
Bheka amaLevi phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana, uhlanganise khona ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.
Uzobeka amaLevi phambi koYehova, begodu izingane zakwaSirayeli zibeke izandla zabo phezu kwabo.
U-Aron uzowaphakamisa amaLevi kuYehova, abe ngumnikelo oshiswayo ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ukuze basebenze umsebenzi kaYehova.
Lawa maLevi azobeka izandla zawo ezindlebeni zezinkomo, begodu uzonikela ngayinye ibe yisonka sesono, nenye ibe yisonka esishiswayo kuYehova, ukuze alungise amaLevi.
Uzobeka amaLevi phambi kuka-Aron, begodu phambi kwabantwana bakhe; uzobanikela kubo ngomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Ngaleyo le uzohlukanisa amaLevi phakathi kwamadodakazi aseSirayeli, ukuze abe yimi labo abaLevi.
Uzozihlanza ngazo, uzozinikela ngazo njengomnikelo oshiswayo; bese befika labo abaLevi, basebenzele umsebenzi wabo efulethini lengqungquthela.
Bami abanikezelwe ngeqiniso phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ngibathathe ngami, endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala emiphakathini yabantu bakaSirayeli.
Wonke ozalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli, umuntu nomuntu kanye nenyama, yimi. Ngosuku lapho ngabulala khona wonke ozalwa kuqala ezweni lakwaYiputa, ngawamisa ngesandla sami.
Ngibathathe labaLevi endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ebantwini bakaSirayeli.

Ngibanikela ku-Aron nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe, phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli bonke, abaLevi; ukuze basebenzele umsebenzi wabo bonke abantwana bakaSirayeli esitezi sokubonisareigni, ukuze benze ukuxoshwa kwabo, ukuze kungabikho ubuhlungu phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, uma befika endaweni engcwele.
UMoses no-Aron, kanye nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, bakwenza ngalawa maLevi konke ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses.
Bahlanza izandla zabo, bahlamba izigqoko zabo; uAron wanikela ngazo ngenhlanhla phambi koYehova, wabalungisa ebusweni bakhe, ukuba bangabi necala.
Ngemuva kwalokho, baphuma labaLevi ukuba benze umsebenzi wabo esitezi sokuhlangana, ngaphasi kuka-Aron nezingane zakhe; njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMoses, njalo bakwenza labo abaLevi.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Lokho wumthetho wamaLevi: kusukela eminyaka eyishumi nambili nesishiyagalombili ubudala nangaphezulu, kumele afike asebenzele esitezi sokubonisa.
Eneminyaka engu-50 ubudala kufanele baphume emsebenzini wabo ojwayelekile bese beyeka ukusebenza.
Bazosiza abazalwane babo emisebenzini sabo esitezi sokuhlangana, kodwana bangeke benze umsebenzi wabo; ngalokho-ke kufanele ubeke imithetho yomsebenzi wamaLevi."
Ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo ezweni laseYiputa, ngonyaka wokuthoma wenyanga yokuqala, ikosi wathi kuMoses esiqhingi saseSinayi, esithi,
Abantu bakaSirayeli kumele bagcine iPasha ngesikhathi sayo esifanele.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili lwalenyanga, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, niyigcine ngesikhathi sayo; niyenze yonke imibandela yayo nemithetho yayo.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bona bagcine amalanga zokugcina.

Bakwenza njalo emfuleni iSina, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala, lapho ilanga liphuma khona. Ngokungafani nalokho ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMosese, kanjalo bakwenze oonyana baka-Israyeli.
Kwaba khona abantu abathile ababengenawo uthuli ngenxa yokufa, ukuze bangakwenza iPasha ngalolusuku. Bafike kuMosesi noAron ngalolusuku olulodwa,
Bathi, Singcolile thina, ngombana sithole umuntu ofile; kungani ke singavunyelwa ukuba sinikeze umnikelo kaYehova ngesikhathi sakhe, phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli?
Wathi kubo uMoses, Nqabe lapha, kuze ngibone bona ikosi unqume kuphi mayelana nani.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Uthi ikosi kuMosis, 21"Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, uthi: Uma umuntu othile phakathi kwenu noma phakathi kwezizukulwana zenu engekho emthethweni ngenxa yokufa komuntu, noma uma esehamba ngendlela ende, ungayenza iPasha kaYehova.
Ngonyaka wesithathu, ngomhla wama-14 wenyanga yesibili, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, niyigcine. Niyidle inkomo nenyama eyenziwe ngengxube yamafutha omnqumo;
Akufanele nishiye lutho kulo kuze kube ubusuku, namathambo alo angeke niwaphuze; kufanele nigcine yonke imibandela kaPashu.

Kodwana uma umuntu ehlanzekile, angasekho emgwaqeni, akwenzele iPasha, lowo muntu kufanele ahlonipheke emiphakathini yakhe; ngenxa yokuthi akahlinzekeli umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu ngesikhathi esifanele, yena uzothwala isono sakhe.
Uma uhlala phakathi kwenu umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe, efuna ukwenza uPasha kuYehova, kufanele akwenze ngokuya ngemithetho yayo, nomthetho wayo; inqubekela phambili yakhe izofana naleyo yomzali wakhe.

Ngosuku lapho ikamelo elingcwele lamiswa khona, icloud yayifihla, itabernakele yomthetho wesivumelwano; kusukela emini kuze kube ekuseni, ukubonakala kwecloud ngaphezu kwegumbi elingcwele kwakufana nomlilo.
Kunganjalo njalo. Imvula yayigqoka ngemini, begodu ngobusuku yayifana nomlilo.
Uma izulu likhuphuka phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, abantu bakaSirayeli basuka; lapho izulu lihlala khona, abantu bakaSirayeli bafudukela lapho.

Ngokusho kwamazwi kaYehova abaSirayeli babehamba, begodu ngokusho kwamazwi kaYehova babesezindaweni zabo zokucampa; ngaso soke isikhathi lapho izulu lihlala khona phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, babesezindaweni zabo zokucampa.
Uma imvula ihlala isikhathi eside phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, khona-ke abantu bakaSirayeli bephula umthetho kaYehova, bangahambanga.
Ngamanye amaxesha icloud yahlala phezu kwendlu yokuphumula amalanga ezimbalwa kuphela. Ngokusho komthetho kaYehova, bahlale esiteshini, begodu ngokusho komthetho wakhe, bahambe.

Ngamanye amaxesha icloud ihlala kuphela kusukela ekuseni kuze kube ngasekupheleni kwemini, begodu uma ikhuphuka ekuseni, basuka; noma ngabe ngobusuku noma ngemini, lapho icloud ikhuphuka khona, basuka.

Noma amalanga ezimbili, noma unyaka owodwa, noma iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, uma izulu lihlala phezu kwendlu yokuphumula, abantu bakaSirayeli behlala esiqhingini, bangahamba; kodwana lapho likhuphuka khona, basuka.
Ngokusho komthetho kaYehova bamisa iziqhingi, begodu ngokusho komthetho kaYehova basuka; balandela umthetho kaYehova, njengombana ewiselayo ngoMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
"Yenza ama-trumpets amabili enziwe ngegolide elihlanganisiwe. Sebenzisa ukubiza imindeni ibe ndawonye begodu utshele izikole bona zingahamba nini.
Uma bephuza amabhungane amabili, khona-ke ibandla lonke lizohlangana phambi kwakho emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana.
Uma kuqhuma enye kuphela, khona-ke abaholi, abaphathi bezizwe zamaSirayeli, kumele bahlangane phambi kwakho.
Uma ama-trumpets ephonsa umsindo omkhulu, izizwe ezicampe engxenyeni esenyakatho kumele ziphume.
Uma i-alarm izwakala kathathu, izizwe ezihlala engxenyeni esenyakatho kumele zihambe. I-alarm izobe yisikhombisi sokuhamba.
Uma ubambe abantu bonke, khona-ke cindezela i-trumpet ngaphandle kokushayela umsindo.
Amadodana ka-Aron, ababingeleli, kumele baphuze amabhungane. Lo mthetho uzobe uhlala kuze kube sekupheleni, kuwe nakwabo bonke abazalwane bakho.

Uma niphuma emidlalweni, ezweni lenu, enkundleni yomshayeli ophikisayo, nizophonsa inqwaba yezinhlamvu zesibhakabhaka; begodu ikosi uzimu wenu uzokukhumbulani, begodu uzokusindisa ebusweni bomshayeli.

Nakuzo zonke amalanga zenu ezijabulisayo, nasezimisweni zenu ezidume khulu, nangemva kokuqala kwenyanga ngayinye, kufanele niphuze amabhungane phezu kwezipho zenu ezibomvu, nezipho zenu zokuthula; begodu kuzokukhumbula uzimu wenu. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wakho.
Ngonyaka wesithathu, ngomhla wama-20 wenyanga yesibili, imvula yakhuphuka phezu kweTenda loMthetho woMhlangano.
Basuka esiqhingini saseSinayi, bahamba behamba, kuze kube yilapho isibhakabhaka sihlala esiqhingini saseParan.
Lokhu kwakungukuqala kokuhamba kwabo, ngokusho komyalo kaYehova ngoMoses.
Kwathi lapho, kwaqala ukuboshwa iqembu lamadodana kaYuda; uNahshon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi, waba ngumkhuluwa walo mkhosi.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sika-Issakha, kwaba nguNathaneli unyana kaZuare.
Ngaphesheya komkhosi wesizwe sikaZebulun, uElibha unyana kaHeloni.
Bakhupha khona itente, basuka abaGershoni nabaseMerari, bethwala itenti.
Kusukela lapho kwasuka umkhosi, ngohlobo lwawo, ngaphasi kwesibhakabhaka sesitena sikaRubhen; uElisuri unyana kaShedeure waba ngumkhuluwa womkhosi.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sikaSimeoni kwakunguShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishaddai.
Ngaphesheya komkhosi wesizwe sikaGadi kwakunguEliyashaphi unyana kaDehuyeli.
Basuka ke abaKahati, bethwala izinto ezingcwele; kwamiswa itente elingcwele phambi kokuba bafike.
Kusukela lapho kwasuka umkhosi, ngohlobo lwawo, ngaphasi kwesibhakabhaka somkhosi ka-Ephrayim; noElishama unyana ka-Amihude waba ngumkhuluwa womkhosi.
Ngaphesheya komkhosi wesizwe sikaManase kwakunguGamayeli unyana kaPedasuri.
UAbidan, unyana kaGideoni, waba phezu komkhosi wesizwe sikaBhenjamini.
Kwathi, ngemuva kwazo zonke lezi zikhulu, wahamba umvikeli wesitezi sikaDani; begodu uAhiezer, unyana ka-Ammisadai, waba ngumkhuluwa wabo.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sika-Ashere kwakunguPagiyeli unyana kaOkran.
Ngaphezu komkhosi wesizwe sikaNaphtali kwakungu-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lokho kwakuyisinqumo sabantu baka-Israyeli lapho bephuma khona.

Wathi uMoses kuHobabu, unyana kaRehuyeli, umkakhe uMoses, waseMidiyani, thina siyohamba ezweni ikosi akhenge akusho bona azosinika lona; phuma nathi, begodu sizokwenza kahle kuwe; ngombana ikosi usekhuluma izinto ezinhle ngeSirayeli.
Wathi ke uHobaba, Ngangizohamba; ngizobuyela ezweni lami, nakwabantu bam.
Wathi uMoses: "Ungasishiya, ngombana uyazi bona sizohlala kuphi ezweni lethu, begodu uzoba ngumqondisi wethu.
Uma ufika nathi, sizokwabelana nawe ngazo zonke izinto ezinhle azenzayo ikosi.
Basuka khona emfuleni kaYehova, behamba uhambo lwezinsuku amathathu; ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova lahamba phambi kwabo uhambo lwezinsuku amathathu, lifuna indawo yokuphumula kubo.
Imvula kaYehova yaba phezu kwabo nsuku zonke, lapho besuka khona esitezi.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho ibhokisi lesivumelwano lihamba khona, uMoses wathi, Yize, Kosi, bahlukaniswe izitha zakho, bahambe phambi kwakho labo abakuxosha.
Kwathi lapho ihlala khona, wathi, Buyela, Kosi, kumakhulu amawaka kaSirayeli.
Kwathi abantu bekhala ngenxa yezinkinga zabo, begodu ikosi wabalalela; wakubona ke, wehla umsindo wakhe, khona-ke kwaphuma umlilo osuka kukaNkulunkulu phakathi kwabo, wawudlidliza izingcezu zesiteji.
Bathi abantu kuye uMoses, wathandaza uMoses kuYehova; khona-ke umlilo wehla.
Ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iTabera, ngenxa yokuthi umlilo osuka kuYehova wawuncibilika phakathi kwabo.
Wathi uMosis kilabo abahlala phakathi kwabo, "Kungaba yini uma sithola inyama ukuyodla?" Bathi, "Ngabe sizoba nenyama!"
Sikhumbula iinhlapi esizidla ngazo mahhala e-Egypt, nama-currants, ama-melon, ama-leeks, ama-onion, ne-garlic.
Kodwana manje silahlekile isifiso sethu sokudla. Asikuboni lutho ngaphandle kwe-manna!"
I-manna yayifana nezithelo ezincane ze-coriander begodu yabukeka njenge-resin emnyama.
Abantu bahamba beyiqoqa. Beyifaka emigodini yezandla noma beyicindezela ngemigodi, bese beyibhaka emabhodweni noma beyenza ibe ngama-flat bread. Iphunga layo lifana nokudla okuthosiwe nge-olive oil.
Ngobusuku, lapho imvula iphuma esiteji, i-manna yaphuma nayo.
Wathi uMoses, ezwa izizwe zonke zikhala, ngaso soke isikhathi, wonke umuntu emgwaqeni wetente lakhe. UYehova wagwema khulu, begodu uMosis wakhathazeka.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Kungani na ungenza lokhu okumbi kumkhonzi wakho? Ngikwenzeni kuphi, ukuze kube nzima phambi kwakho, bona ubeke phezu kwami isisindo sabantu bonke?

Ngibazalile yini labo bonke abantu? Ngaba ngibangenise ezweni, bona ungangitshela ukuba ngiwathathe enhliziyweni yami, njengokuthi umama okhulelwe athwale ingane yakhe, kuze kube yilapho ngiya khona ezweni olibekele izikhulu zabo?
Ngizothola kuphi inyama yalabo bonke abantu? Bathi kimi, Ninikele inyama bona siyidle.
Angikwazi ukuthwala labo bonke abantu ngami. Lo mthwalo unzima khulu kimi.
Uma lokhu kuyinto oyifunayo ukungiphatha ngayo, khona-ke ngiyakucela usindise manje, uma unesithakazelo kimi ngaso soke isikhathi.

Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Thola ngizo abantu abamashumi asixhenxe abakhulu phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, owaziyo bona bangabaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli, nabaphathi bomphakathi; ubaveze ekhempini yokuhlangana, bahlale khona nawe.
Ngizokhuphuka, ngikhuluma nawe khona lapho; begodu ngizothatha umphefumulo okhona phezu kwakho, ngiwubeke phezu kwabo; begodu bazoyithwala impahla yalabo abantu nawe, ukuze ungayithwali wena kuphela.

Uzothi kilabo abantu, Nciphiseni izandla zenu, nizilungiselele kusasa, lapho ningadla khona inyama; ngombana ikosi wakubona bona nikhala, nithi, Uma kungenjalo sizothola inyama yokuyidla! Kungcono kwabe sekuyilapho eYiputa. Ngokuba ikosi uzokunika inyama, niyidle.
ngeke niyidle ngosuku olunye, noma usuku olulodwa, noma usuku oluhlanu, noma usuku olulishumi, noma usuku olumashumi amabili;
unyaka onke, kuze kuphume emlonyeni wenu, niyiphoxe; ngenxa yokuthi ningamtholanga ikosi ophakathi kwenu, naphezu kwalokho niyezela kuye, nithi, Ngabe saphuma kanjani eYiputa?
Wathi uMoses, Namuhla ngiphakathi kwamakhulu amathandathu amaphesenti abantu abahamba ngezinyawo; begodu uthi, Ngizobanikeza inyama inyanga yonke, baphile.
Ingabe kuzokwanela, noma ngabe zonke izingulube nezimbuzi zibulawa ngenxa sabo? Ingabe kuzokwanela, noma ngabe zonke iinhlapi elwandle zithathwa ngenxa sabo?"
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Ingabe amandla ami ancane khulu? Manje uzobona bona uma ngikhuluma, kuzokwenzekani noma ngeke.
Waphuma ke uMoses, wabatjela abantu amazwi kaYehova; wahlanganisa abaholi babo abamashumi asixhenxe, wababeka ngaso soke isikhathi esitezi.

UYehova wehla emlilweni, wakhuluma noMoses; wathatha umphefumulo owawuseMoses, wababeka phezu kwabakhulu abamashumi asixhenxe. Kwathi lapho umphefumlo ufike kubo, baqala ukuprofetisa, kodwana akhenge aqhubeke nokuprofeta.

Kwakhona kwaba khona abantu ababi abasele emgodini, okuthiwa ngu-Eldadi no-Medadi, ababesencwadini yamadoda amakhulu, kodwana abengaphumanga ekhempini; begodu uMoya waba phezu kwabo, baqala ukuprofetisa emgodini.
Waphuma umfana, watshela uMoses, wathi, U-Eldade no-Medade baprofetisa esiteji.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune, umkhonzi kaMoses kusukela encane, waphendula wathi, "Unkosi wami uMoses, vimbela labo!
Wathi uMosis, Ingabe unesithakazelo ngami? Ngingathanda bona bonke abantu bakaYehova babe ngabaprofeti, begodu ikosi abeke umphefumulo wakhe kubo bonke!
Wabuyela ke uMoses, namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli, ekamelweni.

Wathumela ikosi umoya, waletha ama-quails elwandle, wabeka phezu kwazo zonke izingxenye zesibhedlela, ngaso soke isikhathi sokuhamba kosuku olulodwa, ngaso soke isikhathi; zathi zihlala zinemilenze emihlanu ezingeni lezulu.

Baphuma bonke abantu, baqoqa amakhowe onke ekuseni nakusihlwa, kanye nosuku lonke olulandelayo; akukho muntu okwaziyo ukuqoqa ngaphezu kwamalitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, begodu babeka ngaso soke isiqhingi.
Uma inyama ikhona emlonyeni wabo, ngaphambi kokuba bayiphuze, uMoya oNgcwele wagwema abantu, wababulala ngobuhlungu obukhulu khulu.
Kwathi kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo bona iKibrothi-hataava, ngokuba khona lapho babulawe khona abantu abafunayo ukudla.
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bahamba befika eHaserothi, bahlala khona.
UMiriam no-Aron bakhuluma ngoMoses, ngenxa yowesifazane waseKushi ayemthandana naye; ngombana wayemthandanisa indodakazi yaseKushi.
Bathi, Ingabe ikosi wakhuluma ngoMoses kuphela? Akhenge akhulume nathi na? uzimu walalela amagama abo.
UMusa ube ngumntu osheshayo khulu, osheshayo kunanoma ubani emhlabeni.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, no-Aron, noMiriam, Niphumani nithathu, nifike esihlalweni sokuhlangana. Baphuma ke bona abathathu.
UYehova wehla emgodini wezulu, wahlala emgwaqeni wesitezi, wabiza uAron noMiriam; bafike bonke ababi.
Wathi, Yiqiniso, ngikhuluma: Uma kukhona umprofeti phakathi kwenu, ngizovela kuye ngamehlo ephupho, ngizokhuluma naye ngephupho;
Akunjalo umkhonzi wami uMosis; yena uthembekile endlwini yami yonke.
Ngikhuluma naye ngobuso nobuso, ngamazwi acacile, hhayi ngezinhlamvu ezifihlakele; begodu ubona isithombe soNkulunkulu. Kungani na ke bona ningeke nikhohlwe ukukhuluma ngomkhonzi wami uMoses?
UYehova waba necala elikhulu kubo, waphuma.
Kwathi lapho izulu likhuphuka phezulu esitezi, yabona uMiriamu isikhumba sakhe simhlophe njengethebhulethi. Wabhekana naye uAron, wabona bona isikhumba sakhe simnyama.
Wathi kuMosesi, Ngicela, kosi yami, ungasifaki phezu kwethu isono esinjalo, njengombana sakwenza ngokungaqondi.
Akufanele abe njengomuntu ozalwa efile, nengxenye yenyama yakhe itholwe.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, ethi, OThixo, ngicela, umphilise.

Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Uma ubaba wakhe ephuza emlonyeni wakhe, angabi ngeqiniso engahloniphi amalanga ezisixhenxe? Uzobeka ngaphandle kwesiqhingi amalanga ezisixhenxe; ngemuva kwalokho uzovunyelwa ukuba afike.
UMiriamu ke wagcinwa ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi amalanga ezisixhenxe; abantu abahambanga, kuze kube kufike uMiriamu.
Basuka eHazerothi, bamisa isikhashana esiqhingini sasePharan.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses, "Thumela abantu ukuba babhekane nezwe laseKanana, elingeke ngilinike izingane zakwaSirayeli; thumela umuntu oyedwa ophethe isizwe ngayinye.
Wabathumela ke uMoses emfuleni iFaran, njengokuthi ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; bonke babe ngabaphathi phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Lawona amagama abo: ezweni lakwaRubheni, uShamua unyana kaZakhuri.
ezweni likaSimeoni, uShafati unyana kaHori.
Ezweni likaYuda, uKalebe unyana kaJefune.
ezweni lika-Issakha, uIgali unyana kaYosefu.
ezweni lika-Ephrayim, uHoshea unyana kaNuni.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin, uPalti unyana kaRaphu.
ezweni likaZabuloni, uGadiyeli unyana kaSodi.
Ezweni likaManase, ezweni likaYosefu, nguGadi unyana kaSusi.
ezweni likaDan, u-Amiyeli unyana kaGemali.
Ezweni lika-Ashere, uSethure unyana kaMikayeli.
Ezweni likaNaphtali, nguNahbi unyana kaVofsi.
ezweni likaGadi, uGeweli unyana kaMakhi.
Lawona amagama amadoda awathunyelwe nguMoses ukubheka izwe; uMosis wabiza igama likaHoshea, unyana kaNuni, bona nguYoshuwa.
UMoses wabathumela ukuba babhekane nephasi waseKanana, wathi kubo: "Niya ezweni laseNtshonalanga, nifike emadolobheni aphakeme.
Bona bona izwe libukeka kanjani. Thola bona ngabe abantu abahlala khona banamandla noma bangaphili, ambalwa noma abaningi.
Ingabe indawo abahlala kuyo iyindawo engcono noma ebi? Ingabe imiphakathi sabo yizindawo ezivulekile zokuhlala noma zikhuselwe ngamagquma?
Ingabe le mhlaba ugcwele noma awunawo? Ingabe kunezihlahla kulo noma cha? Yiba nobuhlakani, begodu ubuyisele emuva ezinye zezithelo zezwe." Kulokhu kwakuyisikhathi sokuqala sokuvuna izimbali.
Baye benyuka, bahlola izwe, kusukela emfuleni uZin, kuze kube nguRehobhi, lapho kufike khona eHamati.
Baya ezweni laseNtshonalanga, bafika eHebroni, lapho kwahlala khona uAhimana, noSheshai, noTalmai, izingane zikaAnaki. (IHebroni yakhiwa eminyakeni eyisixhenxe ngaphambili kukaZoan waseYiputa.)
Bafika emfuleni i-Eshkoli, baqotha khona inkomishi egcwele izimbali zewayini; ababini beyithwala phakathi kwabo emgodini; begodu bathatha ama-pomelo nama-tines.
Kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona yiGoli lika-Eshkole, ngenxa yeqoqo labo labaSirayeli abalile khona.
Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-40 zokuhlola izwe, babuyela.
Bafika kuMoses no-Aron, nabo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, eKadeshi, esiqhingini saseFaran; baphendula kubo, nakubo bonke ibandla, begodu babonisa izithelo zezwe.
Bathi kuMoses, "Sifike ezweni lapho usithumelele khona; yizwe elishayela ubisi nengulube; bheka lezi zithelo zaso.
Kodwana abantu abahlala khona banamandla, namadolobhana abo anezindlu zangasese, amakhulu khulu; sabona khona nabantwana baka-Anaki.
Ama-Amaleki ahlala enyakatho; ama-Hethi, nama-Yebhusi, nama-Amoreyi ahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme; nama-Kanana ahlala eduze kolwandle, kanye neJordani.
UKalebe wamisa abantu phambi kukaMoses, wathi, Siyahamba namuhla, siyithathe izwe; ngombana siyakwazi ukulihlasela.
Bathi abantu ababeya naye, Asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi sizokwazi ukuhlasela labo bantu; ngombana banamandla kunathi.

Bathi, "Izwe esiluvakashele lidla labo abahlala kulo; begodu bonke abantu esibabona khona yilabo abade khulu. Kulokhu sikhuluma ngezwe elingenalutho phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, ngombana izwe esiluvakashele lidla labo abahlala kulo.
Sibone khona namadoda amakhulu, amakhosikazi ka-Anaki, aphuma emndenini wamaNafilimi; sazizwa ngathi sifana nezingqungquthela, begodu sabona ngathi sifana nabo.
Ngaleyo busuku ibandla lonke lashaya ngamandla, begodu abantu balele.
Bathi bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuMoses noHaroni, bathi kubo ibandla lonke, Kube sengathi safa ezweni laseYiputa, noma ngalesi siqhingi esinjalo!
Kungani na bona ikosi asiholele kule lizwe, ukuze sibulawe emidlalweni? Namadodakazi ethu nabantwana bethu bathathelwe iziboshwa. Akulungile yini ukuba sibuye eYiputa?"
Bathi phakathi kwabo, Sikhetheni umholi, sizobuya eMizi-Yiputa.
UMoses no-Aron babhukha ngobuso babo ezweni, phambi kwebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli elihlangana khona.
UYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, noKhalebe unyana ka-Yefune, abantu abasuke bebhekele izwe, baxosha izigqoko zabo.
Bathi kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, besithi, Izwe elihlanganiswe ngaso soke isikhathi, liyilizwe elihle khulu.
Uma ikosi ethandana nathi, uzosingenisa kulolu mhlaba, begodu usinikeze lona, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nenyama.
Kodwana-ke, ningeke nigweme ikosi, ningeke nikhathazeke ngenxa yabantu balo lizwe; ngombana sizowadla njengamakhowe. Ukuvikelwa kwabo kuphelile, kodwana ikosi unethu; ningabakhathazeki ngenxa sabo.
Kodwana ibandla lonke lathi lizolibabula ngetshe; khona-ke ubuhle bukaYehova buvela esitezi sokuhlangana kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Ingabe kuze kube isikhathi esingakanani isizwe sizongikhohlisa? Ingabe kuze kube isikhathi esingakanani singakholwa kimi, ngenxa yezibonakaliso zonke engizenza phakathi kwabo?
Ngizowabulala ngegciwane, ngibakhulule; kodwana wena ngizokwenza ube wuhlanga olukhulu kunawo wonke, lunamandla khulu kunawo.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Bazokwazi ama-Egyptians; ngombana ngamandla akho wakhipha labo abantu phakathi kwabo.

begodu bazothi kilabo abahlali kule lizwe; ngombana bayazi bona wena, ikosi, uphakathi kwalaba bantu, bona ubonakala ngamehlo akho, bona icloud yakho ihlala phezu kwabo, nokuthi uhamba phambireigna ngesonto emgodini wezulu, nobusuku emgodini womlilo.
Uma ubulala labo bonke abantu ngasikhathi sinye, khona-ke izizwe ezikhuluma ngezwi lakho zizothi,
Ngokuba ikosi akakwazi ukuwangenisa la maqembu ezweni, awabhekile kubo; ngalokho wabulala labo esiqhingini.
Ngalokho manje, Kosi, ngikucela ubone bona amandla akho akhulu kangakanani, njengombana uthe:
uzimu ushesha ukucasuka, ugcwele inhlonipho; uxosha ububi nobubi, kodwana angeke agcine owinile ephephile; ubheka isono samababa kumantombazane kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu namashumi amane.
Ngikucela, usindise abantu bami; ngombana ubulungisa bakho bukhulu khulu, njengokuba ubabambisene nabo kusukela bephuma eYiputa kuze kube manje.
Wathi ikosi, Ngibaxoshe ngokusho kwezwi lakho.
Kodwana-ke, njengombana ngiphila, begodu njengombana izwe lonke lizogcwele ubuhle bukaYehova,

Wonke umuntu phakathi kwalabo abantu ngeke abone izwe. Babona ubuhle bam, nezibonakaliso zami engizenzayo eYiputa nasezindaweni ezishisayo; begodu bangisibuza izikhathi eziyisishiyagalombili, bangangilalelanga.
Akekho phakathi kwabo ozobona izwe engikhuluma ngalo kubaba babo; angeke akubona bonke labo abangikhohlisayo.
Kodwana umkhonzi wami uKalebe unengqondo ehlukile, begodu walandela ngami ngomphefumulo wakhe wonke; ngalokho ngizowufaka ezweni ebelubhekene nalo, nembewu yakhe izoyithola ibe yindawo sabo.
Ngokuba ama-Amaleki namadodakazi aseKanana ahlala emigodini, buyelani ngoMsombuluko, nihambe esiqhingini, ngendlela yolwandle olumnyama.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Ngabe ngizohlala isikhathi esingakanani ngalesi sizwe esibi, esinamahloni ngami? Ngiye ngalalela amahloni amakhosikazi aseSirayeli ngami.
Uzothi kubo: Ngiphila, kusho ikosi, uma ngingakwenzani nalokho engikubonayo ngamazwi wenu.
Kulesi siqhingi izicubu zenu zizofa. Wonke umuntu phakathi kwenu oneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu, owahlukaniswa ngenani lakhe, lowo owayenquma ukukhuluma ngami,
ngeke nifike ezweni engithembise bona ngizokushiyela kulo, ngaphandle kukaKalebe unyana kaJefune noYoshuwa unyana kaNune.
Uthe: "Izingane zenu zizothathwa njengeziboshwa," kodwana ngizozifaka, begodu bazoyidla izwe lenu olukukhohlisayo.
Kodwana-ke, mayelana nawe, izicubu zakho ezifile zizowela kulo mfula.
Bazohamba izingane zenu ezweni elimnyama iminyaka engama-40, begodu bazobhekana nokuhlukunyezwa kwenu, kuze kube yilapho zonke izicubu zenu zilele kulolu mhlaba.
Kusukela ngosuku olulodwa kuya kusuku olulodwa, kuze kube yiminyaka emashumi mane, nizothwala isono senu; ukuze nikwazi bona inkani lami linjani.
Ngikhuluma, ngiyathi, ngizozenza lezi zinto kulesi sizwe esibi soke, esizungezile ngami; lapha emfuleni bazophela, bazofa lapha.
Baphinde babuyela, abantu ababethunyelwe nguMosis ukubheka izwe, wabangela bona bonke abantu baseSirayeli babe nomsindo ngaye, ngenxa yolwazi olubi mayelana nezwe.
Lawa madoda, akhuluma ngokubi ngalolu lizwe, lahlaselwa yisifo, wafa phambi koYehova.
UYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, noKhalebe unyana ka-Yefune, abazange baphile phakathi kwamadoda onke adlulele ukubheka izwe.
Wathi uMosis kiwo wonke amadodana aseSirayeli amazwi kaYehova, begodu bahlupheka khulu.
Bavuka ekuseni khulu, baphuma befika esiphethweni somfula, bathi, Sithole isono; namuhla sizohamba ezweni ikosi akusho ngalo.
Wathi uMoses, Kungani na bona niphula umthetho kaYehova? Lo msebenzi awuzophumelela.
Musani ukunyuka, ngombana ikosi akakho phakathi kwenu, ukuze nigwetshwe phambi kwalabo abaphikisayo.
Bakhona khona ama-Amaleki nabaseKanana phambi kwenu, begodu nizoqhutshwa emdlalweni; ngenxa yokuthi niyibeke phasi izandla zenu enhliziyweni yeNkosi, yena ngeke abe nani.
Kodwana-ke, bakwazi ukunyuka bafike esiphethweni somfula; uMoses nodoti womthetho kaYehova abasukanga emgwaqweni.
Bakhuphuka ama-Amaleki namadodakazi aseKanana, ahlala kulo mfula, babhekana nabo, bababulala kuze kube yiHorma.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
"Uzokhuluma bantwana bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni engikunika lona ukuba yikhaya lenu,

uma ninesiphuzo somlilo esilungiselelwe ikosi, kusuka ezilwaneni zenu, noma kusukela emihlambini yenu; kungabe yisondlo esiqhutshwayo, noma isondlo esisodwa, ukufeza isibopho sakho, noma njengesibopho sesipho, noma ezimkhosini zenu, njengephunga elimnandi kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu enikela ngesibopho sakhe, kufanele aveze umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu: ilitha elilodwa lomhluzi ohlanzekile, elihlanganiswe nelitha elilodwa le-oyile.
Ngengane ngayinye yomnikelo wokushiswa, noma iyiphi enye inhlanhla, kufanele ulungiselele ilitha elilodwa lomnqumo wewayini.
Nomuntu wesifazane, ulungiselele isiphuzo somnqumo esifana nekhilogremu amathathu zoshizi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nolitha elilodwa nesithathu lephethroli;
kanye nelitha elilodwa nesithathu lewayini njengomnikelo wokudla; kuzoba yiphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uma ulungiselela inkomo encane, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, noma ibe yisonka, ukufeza isibopho esikhethekile, noma ibe ngumnikelo wokuthula kuYehova;
bese uletha nengulube isonka sokudla esingu-kilogremu ezinhlanu nesishiyagalombili sekhofi elihlanzekile, lixutshwe namalitha amabili ephethiloli.
begodu uthele ilitha elilodwa lewayini njengesonka, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, umhluzi othandekako kukaNkulunkulu.
Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngengulube ngayinye, nomuntu ngayinye, nengane yamahhashi noma inkomo.
Yenza lokhu ngesilwane ngayinye, kungakhathaliseki bona siningi kangakanani.
Wonke umuntu ozalwa kulolu lizwe kufanele akwenze njalo, uma enikela ngenhlanhla ngomlilo, ngephunga elimnandi kuYehova.

Uma kukhona ongaphandle uhlala phakathi kwenu, noma omunye umuntu ohlala phakathi kwenu eminyakeni ezayo, begodu enikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa wephunga elimnandi ikosi, njengombana nikwenzayo nikwenze naye.
Umthetho owodwa uzobe ukhona engqungqutheleni yenu, nani nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu; umthetho ohlala njalo kuzo zonke izizwe zenu. Lo mhlali nowezinye izizwe nifana phambi koYehova.
Umthetho owodwa nomthetho ofanayo uzobe ukhona phakathi kwenu, nani nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
"Ukhuluma kubantwana bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni lapho ngizokulethela khona,
begodu uma nidla ukudla kwezwe, kufanele niyibeke endaweni ekhethekile, ibe yisipho esikhethekile kuYehova.
Ngokuqala kwe-dough yakho, unikele i-loaf njengesipho esikhethekile. Nceda uyinike njengombana unikela ngesipho esikhethekile kusuka embewuni endaweni yokudla.
Ngazo zonke amalanga ezizayo, kufanele ninikeze umnikelo okhethekile kukaNkulunkulu, osuka engxenyeni yokuqala yomhluzi wenu.
Uma kungenxa yephutha lenu, ningagcinanga noma ngimuphi lo myalo ikosi abewisela kuMosesi;
nganoma iyiphi imiyalelo ikosi awawisela kuwe ngesandla sikaMoses, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho wabeka khona imiyalelo yakhe, kuze kube yilapho.

Uma ibandla lonke lisenza lokhu ngephutha, ngaphandle kokukwaziyo, khona-ke ibandla lonke lizonikela inkomo encane eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa, ube ngumhluzi othandekako kukaNkulunkulu, nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesipho saso sotshwala, ngokusho komthetho; nomkhwenyana wesifazane owodwa abe yisondlo sesono.

Wathi umbingeleli alungise ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli phambi koNkulunkulu, begodu bakhululwe; ngombana kwakuyiphutha labo. Banikeza umnikelo wabo wokushiswa kuYehova kanye nesonka sabo sokuhlukunyezwa ngenxa yephutha labo.
Wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli uzoxoshwa, nalabo abangaphandle bemi phakathi kwabo; ngombana abantu bonke babe yingxenye yephutha labo.
Uma umuntu ephelelwe yithemba, kufanele athathe inkomo yonyaka owodwa, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Umbingeleli kufanele alungise lowo muntu phambi koNkulunkulu, ngenxa yesono sakhe esingenakulindela; begodu uma elungiswe phambi koThixo, uzoxoshwa.
Lolu mthetho luyasebenza kiwo wonke umuntu onephutha, noma akhuleke ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma abe ngumuntu ovela kwelinye izwe ohlala phakathi kwabo.
Kodwana uma umuntu ephelelwa yithemba, ekhohlisa ngokucacile, noma ngabe ungumnikazi wezwe, noma ngabe unomhlalaphansi, yena uphula umthetho kaYehova; lowo muntu kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Uthe wakhohlisa ilizwi likaYehova, waphula umthetho wakhe; lowo muntu kufanele akhululwe; ubugebengu bakhe bukhona kuye.
Kwathi lapho abantu bakaSirayeli behlala ezweni laseNdiya, kwatholakala umuntu eqoqa imithi ngeSonto.
Bathi labo ababemuthola eqoqa imithi, bamletha kuMoses no-Aron, nebandla lonke.
Bagcina ngaphasi kwengcindezi, ngombana kwakungeke kube kucacile bona yini okufanele kwenziwe kuye.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Umuntu lowo kufanele abulawe; ibandla lonke kumele ligweme ngamathumba ngaphandle kwesiqhingi.
Wathi ke wonke umphakathi wamkhipha ngaphandle kwesiqhingi, wamgqugquzela ngamatshe, waza wafa; njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMosis.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Bheka, ngikhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, ngitjho kubo: Kuzohlala isikhathi eside bona nikwenze izibopho ezinqolobaneni zezigqoko zenu, ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.

Uzozikhumbula ngazo zonke izimiso zikaYehova, uma uzibona, ukuze uzenze; begodu ngeke ulandele imibono yenhliziyo yakho, noma imicabango yamehlo akho, eyenza bona ningikhohlwe. Uzozikhumbula ngazo zonke izimiso zikaYehova, uma uzibona, ukuze uzigcine.
ukuze niyikhumbula yonke imiyalo yami, niyenze, nibe ngcwele kuThixo wenu.
Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu, owazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngibe uzimu wenu; ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu.
UKora, unyana ka-Izhar, unyana ka-Kohati, unyana ka-Levi, waba mkhulu; naye wahlangana naye uDathani noAbironi, oonyana baka-Elibha, noOn, unyana ka-Pelethe, waseRubeni.
Basuka babhekana noMoses, namadoda amakhulu amabili namahlanu aseSirayeli, abezikhulu ezidume khulu, abakhethiwe ngumphakathi.
Bahlangana noMoses no-Aron, bathi kubo: "Niya phambili khulu; ibandla lonke lingcwele, wonke umuntu, begodu ikosi unguye kubo; kungani nizibeka phezu kwabantu bakaYehova? "
UMoses, lapho ekubona khona lokhu, wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi.
Wathi kuKora, nakwabo bonke ababili bakhe, Ngosuku oluzayo ikosi uzobonisa bona ngubani owakhe, nokuthi ngubani ongcwele, ukuze amsize afike kuye; nomuntu owazikhethela yena, ukuze amsize afike kuye.
Ngalokho lokhu kufanele ukwenze, wena nomndeni wakho wonke, wena noKora; nithathe iziqhingi zomlilo.
Uzobeka phezu kwazo umlilo nofuzo phambi koYehova kusasa; begodu umuntu okhethayo ikosi, yena ozobe ngungcwele. Niye, abakwaLevi, nidlulele khulu!
Wathi uMoses kuKora, Ngisho manje, nilabaLevi!

Ingabe akuncane kuwe, bona uzimu kaSirayeli awazihlukanisile nisuka engqungqutheleni, ukuze anidlulise kuye, ukuba nisebenzele itente elingcwele likaYehova, nihlale phambi kwengqungquthela, nibambisene nabo?
Wakudlulisa wena nabangani bakho bonke, abaLevi, kuye; begodu nifuna ukuba ngabapristi?
Kulungile, wena nomndeni wakho wonke nihlangane noYehova; yini uAron, bona nimbukele kuye?
Wathumela uMoses, wabiza uDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha; bathi ke, Asizofika.
Kuncane yini lokhu, bona usikhuphule ezweni eligcwele ubisi nenyamakazi, ukuze ushukumise esiqhingini? Ufuna begodu ukuba ngummengameli wethu?
Akekho umuntu owaziyo bona sizofika ezweni elishayela ubisi nengulube, noma sizothola iimila nezihlahla zezinkomo. Ingabe ucabanga bona uzozikhohlisa lezi ndodana? Asizofika!'
UMoses wehluleke khulu, wathi kuYehova, Ungavumeli umnikelo wabo; angikaze ngiwuthathe lutho kubo, noma inkomo eyodwa kuphela, begodu angikaze ngikwenze kabi omunye wabo.
Wathi uMoses kuKora, Thola wena nomndeni wakho wonke phambi koYehova ngoLwesihlanu; wena nabanye, noAron.
Niyithathe inkomishi ngayinye, nifake kuyo uvumba; nizibeke phambi kukaYehova: iinkomishi ezimakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu; wena no-Aron nizithele izinkomishi zenu.
Bathatha ke wonke umuntu inkomishi yakhe, babeka kuyo umlilo, namafutha omnqumo, behlala emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, noMoses noAron.
UKora wahlangana nabo bonke abantu bakhe emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana; khona-ke ubuhle bukaYehova babuvela emphakathini wonke.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
"Hamba kude nalabo abantu, ukuze ngibasindise ngasikhathi sinye!
Wathi uMoses noAron, babhujiswa ngobuso babo ezweni, bathi: ONkulunkulu, uzimu onikeza umoya kiwo wonke umuntu ophilayo, ngabe umuntu owodwa enze isono, begodu wena ugweme isizwe soke?
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi kulowo mhlangano: "Nquma ukuba ukhambe kude nezindawo zokuhlala kukaKora, noDathani, noAbironi."
Wavuka uMoses, waya kuDathani no-Abironi; nabo bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli balandela.
Wathi kubo bonke ibandla, Nisuka ezindaweni zokuhlala zalabo bantu ababi, nize ningagculisi lutho olulodwa oluye lwaba lwayo, ukuze ningabi nokufa ngenxa yazo zonke izigebengu zabo.

Basuka khona ezindaweni zokuhlala kukaKora, noDathani, noAbironi, ngazo zonke izingcezu; uDathani noAbironi baphuma behlala emgwaqeni wezindawo zabo zokuhlala, namadodakazi abo, nabantwana babo, nezingane zabo.
Wathi uMoses, Ngalokhu nizokwazi bona nguYehova obemithumela ukuba ngikwenze lezi zinto zonke, bona angizange ngikwenze ngami.
Uma labo bantu befa, njengokufa kwanoma ngimuphi umuntu, ikosi angithumelele.
Kodwana uma ikosi esenza into entsha, begodu izwe livuleka, liwaphuza labo nanoma yini enabo, bafike bephila emgodini wokufa; khona-ke nizozi bona laba bantu baphula umthetho kazimu.
Kwathi, lapho uMoses eqedile ukukhuluma ngalolu daba lonke, izwe elingaphansi kwabo lahlukaniswa.
Umhlaba wawuvuleka, wawela kubo, namakhaya abo, nalabo bonke abantu bakaKora, nezinto zabo zonke.
Baphuma bephila, nabo bonke ababenabo, bawela emgodini wokufa; izwe liwavala phezu kwabo, banyamalala phakathi kwebandla.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli onke asendaweni sabo, lapho ezwa khona izingcingo zabo, wabaleka, wathi: "Izwe lizosidla nathi."
Ke kaloku kwaphuma umlilo esuka kuYehova, wabulala labo bantu abangamakhulu amabili namashumi mahlanu abanikela ngefutha.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi ku-Elihazare, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, bona athathe amabhodwe omlilo emlilweni, begodu ahlukanise amakhowe akhanyayo; ngombana amabhodwe awangcwele.

Lezi yizinkomishi zabantu ababhidlile ngempilo sabo; uzokwenza ngazo izinkomishi ezincane, ukuze zigqoke isibingelelo; ngombana bathunyelwe phambi koYehova, begodu bangcwele; zibe yizibonakaliso kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi u-Elazar, umpristi, waqoqa amabhodlela egolide, abo bonke abantu abathunyelwe, wabeka ngazo isigqoko sendawo yokubhekwa.

Waba ngumbukiso kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bona akukho muntu ngaphandle kuka-Aron ozofika asindise inkungu phambi koYehova, ukuze angabi njengoKora nomndeni wakhe, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uEleazar ngoMoses.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli likhala ngoMosesi noAron, besithi, Nibulale abantu bakaYehova.
Kwathi lapho ibandla lihlangane noMoses na-Aron, babhekana nethenda lokuhlangana; kwabonakala bona izulu liyifihla, begodu ubuhle bukaYehova buvela.
UMoses no-Aron bafika phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Bathi: "Thumelani phakathi kwalabo bantu, ukuze ngibasindise ngaso soke isikhathi!" Bawubulale ubuso babo phasi.

Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, Thola inkomishi yakho yomlilo, ubeke kuyo umlilo osuka emgodini womlilo, ukhiphe phezu kwayo inkomishi yomlilo; uye engqungqutheleni, uxhumane nabo; ngombana inhliziyo kaYehova ihlukumezeke khulu, isifo esibulalayo siqala.
U-Aron wenza njengombana uMoses atjhilo, wahamba phakathi kwabaningi, lapho isifo saqala khona phakathi kwabantu. Wabeka phezu kwawo umnqumo, walungisa abantu phambi kukaThixo.
Wahlala phakathi kwabafileyo nalabo abaphilayo, khona-ke isifo sayeka.
Abantu abamashumi amabili nanhlanu amawaka namakhulu asixhenxe bafa ngalolu bhubhane, ngaphandle kwalabo ababefa ngenxa kaKora.
Wabuyela uAron kuMoses, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana; ngombana isifo saso siphelile.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSirayeli: "Ukhulume nabantwana baka-Israyeli, uze ubathathele izinkomishi ezingu-12; inkomishi ngayinye ibe yindodana yomndeni kayise.
Kiwo umkhonyovu kaLevi, ubhale igama lika-Aron. Kuzomele kube nomkhonyovu owodwa wesizwe ngayinye somzali.
Uzibeke esitezi sokuhlangana, phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, lapho ngizohlangana khona nawe.
Uma umuntu ngiwukhetha, khona-ke itshe lakhe lizokhula libe yizimbali; begodu ngale le ngizomisa ukubhukha kwabantu bakaSirayeli phezu kwakho.

Wakhuluma ke uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; begodu abaphathi babo bamnika izinkomishi ezilishumi elinambini, umholi ngamnye wamadodakazi abo, inkomishi ngayinye; inkomishi ka-Aron yayiphakathi kwabo.
Wabeka uMoses izintambo phambi koYehova, esitezi somthetho wobufakazi.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, uMoses efika esihlalweni sethunywa somthetho, wabona bona intambo ka-Aron, eyakwaLevi, yakhula, yavula amaqabunga ayo, yavula izimbali zayo, yavuna amaqanda ayo.
Wazikhipha uMoses zonke izinkomishi phambi kweNkosi, wazisa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; babhekana nabo, begodu umholi ngamnye wafumana inkomishi yakhe.

Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Yenza isandla sika-Aron sibuyiselwe emuva phambi kwebhokisi lesinqumo; ligcinwe khona, libe ngubufakazi kubo bonke labo abakhohlisayo, ukuze kungabikho ukucasuka kwabo ngami, ukuze bangafa.
Wakwenza ke uMoses, njengombana ikosi abemwisile.
Bathi amadodana aseSirayeli kuMoses, Sizofa; silahlekile, silahlekile bonke.
Wonke umuntu ofinyelela efulethini elingcwele leNkosi, uzofa; ngabe sizofa bonke?
Wathi ikosi ku-Aron, Uzothwala wena, nabantwana bakho, nendlu yakho yomndeni, isono sendawo engcwele; uzothwala wena, nabantwana bakho, isono semisebenzi yenu yamabhishobhi.
Udadewabo, isizwe samaLevi, isizwe sobaba wakho, ubeke phambi kwakho, ukuze basebenze nawe; wena nobana bakho nisebenza phambi kwendlu yomthetho.
Bazosebenza ngaphasi kwakho, begodu bazogcina umsebenzi wesitezi soke; kodwana ngeke bafinyelele ezintoni ezingcwele, noma emgodini womlilo, ukuze bangafa bonke, bona nowe.
Bazoqhathaniswa nawe, begodu bazogcina umsebenzi wesitezi sokuhlangana, ukuze basebenze kuyo yonke imisebenzi yayo; ngeke kube khona umuntu othile ongakufinyelela.
Uzogcina isikhundla sendawo engcwele, kanye nesihlalo somlilo, ukuze kungabikho ubuhlungu phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Ngabona bona ngithathe abazalwane benu, abaLevi, phakathi kwabenyunyana bakaSirayeli; nibanikeze umnikelo wokudla, banikezelwe kuYehova, ukuze benze umsebenzi wesitezi sokubonisa.

Kodwana wena nobana bakho nizosebenza njengombhishobhi, ngezinto zonke eziphathelene nesihlalo somlilo, nalapho kungena khona ifasitela; ngombana ngikulethela umsebenzi wombhishobhi njengomnikelo. Wonke umuntu ofika endaweni engcwele kumele abulawe.

Wathi ikosi ku-Aron, Khangela, ngikubeke wena phezu kwezipho zami ezikhethekile, ngazo zonke izinto ezingcwele zabantwana bakaSirayeli, abazinikela kimi; ngiyazinika kuwe, nawe izingane zakho, zibe yingxenye yenu kuze kube sekupheleni; ngombana ukhonjwe.

Le ngxenye izobe iyiyakho, kuzo zonke izinto ezingcwele khulu, ezenziwe ngomlilo: yonke iminikelo sabo yokudla, nomnikelo wosono, nomnikelo wesono, nanoma iyiphi insizakalo sabo yokusola; yizinto ezingcwele khulu, zizoba zakhona wena nabana bakho.
Uzozidla njengokudla okungcwele khulu; wonke umuntu umfazi uzozidla, uzoba ngumuntu ongcwele.

Lezo zinto ziye zibe zakho: iminikelo yokwahlulela, ethathwe kiwo wonke ama-offering aqhutshwayo omndeni wakwaSirayeli; ngizinika wena, nabantwana bakho, namantombazane akho, njengomthetho wakho ohlala njalo. Wonke umuntu ohlanzekile endlwini yakho angazidla.
Begodu ngikulethela konke okungcono kwe-olive oil, newayini elisha, nembewu, izingcezu zokuqala zokuvuna kwabo, abazozinikela kuYehova.
Zonke izithelo zokuqala zezwe labo, abazoziletha kuYehova, zizobe zakhona; wonke umuntu ohlanzekile emndenini wakho angazidla.
Wonke umuntu ezweni lakwaSirayeli, onikezelwe ngokuphelele kuYehova, uzobe wakho.

Wonke umuntu ozalwa kuqala, noma inkomo ezalwa kuqala, izobe iyiyakho; kodwana wonke umfazi ozalwa kuqala, nomuntu ozalwa kuqala, noma inkomo ephilayo engahlanzekile, kumele uyithengele imali yokubuyisa.
Uma beneminyaka emibili ubudala, kufanele bathengiswe ngemali elinganiselwe yegolide elinhlanu, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele, okungu-shekeli eziyishumi nambili.

Kodwana uma uvula ibele lengulube, noma ibele lengulube, noma ibele lemvu, awukwazi ukulithenga; ngombana lingcwele. Uzolibazisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo, begodu uzowusindisa umkhuhlane wabo, ibe yisonka esiqhutshwa ngamlilo, njengephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Inyama sabo izobe yakho, njengokuba ibele elibiwe nemilenze yesobunxele ziyobe zakho.

Wonke umthwalo ophakanyisiwe, wezinto ezingcwele abazinikela ngazo izingane zakwaSirayeli kuYehova, ngiwunike wena, nabangane bakho, nabantwana bakho, njengomthetho wakho wokugcina;reign of salt ephilayo phambi kweNkosi, isivumelwano esihlala isikhathi eside, kuwe nomndeni wakho ngemuva kwakho.
Wathi ikosi ku-Aron, Awunazo izimpahla ezweni lakwaSirayeli, begodu awunayo inkontileka phakathi kwabantu; mina ngiyinkontileka yakho nempahla yakho emnothweni phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ngabona bona ngibanike amaLevi ishumi lazo zonke izinto ezweni laseSirayeli, ibe yimikhaya sabo, ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo owenza emkhunjini wokuhlangana.
Ngaleso sikhathi abantu bakaSirayeli ngeke bafinyelele entabeni yokuhlangana, ukuze bangaba nesono, begodu baphile.

AbaLevi kuphela abazosebenza esitezi sokuhlangana, begodu bazoyithwala iphutha layo. Kuye kube ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside emiphakathini yenu yonke; begodu abakwaLevi ngeke babe nempahla phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Kodwana ishumi eliphelele, labo abaSirayeli abanikela ngalo umnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ngilinikeza amaLevi libe yimihlaba sabo; ngalokho ngitjho, Akufanele babe nempahla phakathi kwabaSirayeli.'
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Uzokhuluma kwabaLevi, usithi kubo: Uma nithola emindenini yabantwana bakaSirayeli ingxenye yeshumi engikulethelayo njengempahla yenu, kufanele ninikeze ingxenye yeshumi laleyo ingxenye yeshumi, ibe yisibopho esiphakeme kukaNkulunkulu.
Isipho sakho sizobhekwa kuwe njengokuba kuyisithelo esivela ezindaweni zokudlidliza noma isiphuzo esivela emgodini.
Ngale le nizonikela ngomnikelo oshiswayo kuYehova, ngazo zonke izingxenye zeshumi eziphikisayo ezithathwe kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; nizonikeza uAron ukumkani inkontileka kaYehova.
Kuzo zonke izimpahla zakho ongazitholayo, uzozinikela ngalokho okungcwele khulu, njengomnikelo wokudla kaYehova.
Uzokhuluma kuLevi, usithi: Uma ninikela ngento engcono khulu, itholwe kuwe njengento ephuma emgodini wokudla, nento ephuma emgodini wewayini.
Ungayidla kuphi naphi, ninemindeni yenu; yimali yenu ngenxa yomsebenzi wenu esitezi sokuhlangana.
Uma unikela ngento engcono khulu yayo, ngeke ube nesono ngaleyo nto; kodwana akufanele unciphise izinto ezingcwele zakwaSirayeli, ukuze ungafa.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Lokho wumthetho owawuthi ikosi, uthi kubantwana bakaSirayeli, bona bakulethe kuwe inkomo encane ebomvu, engabi necala nanoma yikuphi okumbi kuyo; ingulube engasebenzisi umkhonyovu.
Uzoyinikela ku-Elazarhi umbingeleli, ithathwe ibe ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, ibe yinyama phambi kwakhe.
U-Elazar, umbingeleli, uzothatha igazi layo emlonyeni wakhe, aphuze igazi lakhe izikhathi ezisixhenxe ebusweni besitezi sokuhlangana.
Uma kunjalo, ingulube kumele igcwaliswe lapho ebheka khona: isikhumba sayo, inyama yayo, ushukela wayo, nenyama yaso kufanele igcwaliswe.
Umbingeleli uzothatha umnqumo wezinkuni, ne-hysop, nentambo emnyama, azozibeka phakathi komlilo lapho inkomo iqhuma khona.
Uzohlamba izigqoko zakhe, begodu uzohlanza umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, bese ubuyela esiteshini; kodwana ngeke abe nenyama kuze kube sebusuku.
Umfazi owenza umlilo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Umuntu ohlanzekile kumele aqoqe inkungu yengulube, ayibeke endaweni ehlanzekile ngaphandle komkhosi, ukuze igcinwe yibandla lakwaSirayeli, ibe ngamanzi okuwahlanza; kuyinto yomnikelo wokudla.

Uma umuntu eqoqa inkungu yakhe, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, begodu abe nakanjani kuze kube sebusuku. Kube ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, nakwalowo ohlala phakathi kwabo.
Wonke umuntu onqoba umuntu ofile, uzobe unqunywe amalanga ezisithupha.
Uzohlanzwa ngamanzi ngosuku oluthathu, nosuku lwesixhenxe, begodu uzohlanjululwa; kodwana uma engazihlanza usuku lwesithathu, nosuku lwesixhenxe, ngeke ahlanzwe..

Wonke umuntu ocindezela umuntu ofile, engeke ahlanze isikhumba sakhe, ungenza isivivinyo esingcwele sikaYehova sibe mnyama; lowo muntu kufanele ahlonyiswe emazweni aseSirayeli. Ngokuba amanzi okuhlanza awaphuziswe phezu kwakhe, ube mnyama; ububi bakhe buhlala kuye.
Lokho wumthetho, uma umuntu efa enhliziyweni; wonke umuntu ophuma enhliziyweni yakhe, nanoma ubani ohlala enhliziyweni yakhe, bazobe bengenawo amanzi amalanga ezisithupha.
Yonke inkomishi evulekile, engenasici esiboshwe phezu kwayo, izobi.
Wonke umuntu, uma ebhekene nomuntu obulawe ngeqhwa, noma ophilayo, noma ithambo lomuntu, noma isibhedlela, ezweni elivulekile, uzobe unqunywe ubusuku obuyisithupha.
Ukwenza bona umuntu ongcolileyo ahlanzeke, kufanele ubeke inkungu yesonka esilahliwe emgodini, uthele phezu kwayo amanzi ahlanzekile.

Umuntu ohlanzekile kufanele athathe imbewu ye-hyssop, ayitshebe emanzini, afafaze inkosikazi, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, nalabo bonke abakhona; begodu kumele afafaze lowo yizicubu zomuntu, noma umuntu obulawe, noma umuntu owafa, noma isibhedlela.

Umuntu ohlanzekile kufanele ahlanze umuntu ongcolileyo ngosuku lwesithathu, begodu ngosuku lwesithupha. Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili kumele ahlanze umuntu ohlanzekile; begodu umuntu ohlanzekile kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, bese emini uzohlanzwa.

Uma umuntu engenawo uthuli, begodu engahlanzeki, lowo muntu onjalo uzosuswa emiphakathini yenu; ngombana wahlambalaza indawo engcwele kaYehova; amanzi okuhlanzeka awaqhutshwa phezu kwakhe; yena ungcolile.
Lo mthetho uzoba ngumthetho wabo ohlala njalo; umuntu onqoba amanzi okuhlanza kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, nalowo onquma amanzi okuhlanza kumele abe nenyama kuze kube semini.
Nanoma yini ayishiye umuntu ongcolileyo, izobi namanzi; begodu wonke umuntu oyishiye, uzobi namanzi kuze kube semini.
Kwafika ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli esiqhingini sikaZin, ngonyaka wokuthoma, bahlala eKadeshi; khona-ke wafa uMiriam, wabanjwa khona.
Akukho amanzi emphakathini, khona-ke ibandla lahlangana kuMoses noHaarnau.
Baze baxoxa noMoses, bathi, Ngabe sifile lapho abazalwane bethu befa phambi kukaYehova!
Kungani na bona ningenise abantu bakaYehova kulolu lwandle, ukuze sife lapha, nathi nezilwane zethu?
Kungani na ke bona nithule sisuka eYiputa, nisiveze kulo mhlaba obuhlungu? Akunawo ubisi, noma ama-tines, noma izimbali zewayini, noma ama-pomegranate; begodu akukho amanzi okuwadla.
UMoses no-Aron basuka engqungqutheleni, befika emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, bahlaliswa ngobuso babo phasi; begodu ubuhle bukaYehova babuvela kubo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Thola isandla sakho, wena noAron umkhuluwa wakho, niyihlanganise inkundla; bese nikhuluma kulo mbhoshongo phambi kwamehlo abo, khona-ke uzokhipha amanzi alo; begodu nizo ukukhishwa kwamanzi emibhoshongoni, ukuze inkundla ibe nenyama sabo.
Wathatha uMoses isandla esingaphambilini kweNkosi, njengokuba ikosi abemwisile.
UMoses no-Aron baqoqa abantu phambi kodonga. Wathi kubo uMoses, "Hlelani, nibuxoki! Ingabe sizokulethela amanzi kusuka kulodonga?"
Waphakamisa uMoses isandla sakhe, washaya isibhakabhaka ngentambo yakhe izikhathi ezimbili, kwaphuma amanzi ngokunethezeka; yadla inkundla nenyama yawo.
UYehova wathi kuMosesi noHaronu, Ngokuba ningakholwa kimi, bona ningingcwele phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ngalokho-ke ngeke ningenise leli bandla ezweni engiyabanika lona.
Laziwa bona amanzi eMeriba, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakaSirayeli baxoxa khona noYehova; wabonisa bona ungcwele kubo.
UMoses wathumela abathunywa eKadeshi kuye ukumkani waseEdom, bathi kuye, Usho lokhu inkosikazi yakho uSirayeli, ethi: Uyazi zonke izimo ezibuhlungu esidlule kuzo;
lapho ababa bethu behla eYiputa, sahlala khona iminyaka eminingi; begodu abaMisitaniya bakwenza kabi nathi nababa bethu.
Sacela ikosi, waphendula, wathumela isithunywa, wasikhipha eYiputa; begodu manje sikhona eKadeshe, emzini ophakathi kwezwe lakho.

Siyakucela, usivumele sidlule ezweni lakho; ngeke sidlule ezindlini zakho, noma emivinini yakho, begodu singadla amanzi emfuleni onke. Sizohlala esiphelweni sendlela yobukhosi; ngeke sishintshe ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, kuze sidlule ezweni lakho.
Wathi uEdom kuye, Awuzodlula lapha; ngombana uma udlula khona-ke, sizophuma begodu sizokuhlasela ngekhebula lethu.
Bathi kubo: "Sizohlala kulolu hambo; uma sidla amanzi akho, thina noma izilwane zethu, sizokhokha inhlawulo yamanzi ethu, begodu siyahamba ngezinyawo kuphela."
Wathi ke uEdom kubo, Uzodlula kuphi? Waphuma khona uEdom ebhekana nabo, eneqembu elikhulu, elinamandla khulu.
Kwathi, ngenxa yokuthi uEdom akhenge avumele amaSirayeli ukuba adlule ezweni lakhe, amaSirayeli awashiya.
Basuka eKadeshi, bafika emfuleni uHori, bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses noAron, emfuleni iHori, enhliziyweni kaEdomu, wathi,
U-Aron uzofa, ahlangane nabantu bakhe; ngeke afike ezweni enginika lona izingane zakwaSirayeli, ngenxa yokuthi ninqobile umyalo wami ngamanzi aseMeriba.
Thola uAron noEleazaru, unyana wakhe, bafike emfuleni iHori.
Uzowususa u-Aron izigqoko zakhe zokuba ngumpristi, uzozigqokisa u-Elazar, unyana wakhe; u-Aron uzofa khona lapho, ahlangane nabantu bakhe.
Wakwenza uMoses njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo; benyuka phezulu emfuleni iHori, phambi kwamehlo komphakathi wonke.
UMoses wasusa izicathulo zika-Aron, wamgqoka uEleazaru unyana wakhe. Wafa khona khona u-Aron phezulu emfuleni; uMosis no-Eleazaru baphuma emfuleni.
Kwathi lapho ibandla lonke libona bona uAron ufile, bonke amadodana aseSirayeli abulale uAron izinyanga ezimashumi amathathu.
Kwathi lapho ukumkani wakwaKanana wase-Aradi, ohlala eNtshonalanga, ekwazi bona abantu bakaSirayeli befika ngendlela se-Atarim, wahlasela amaSirayeli, wathatha abanye kubo.
Wathi uSirayeli, ekhuluma kukaNkulunkulu, bona: "Uma unikela ngalolu hlanga emlenzeni wethu, siyazibulala zonke izizwe zabo."
UYehova waphendula amaSirayeli, wabanikela ngabaseKanana phambi kwabo; babenquma ukuwabulala bonke namadolobha abo; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iHora.
Basuka eMfuleni uHori, behamba ngendlela yolwandle olumnyama, ukuze bajikeleze izwe lika-Edom; kodwana abantu baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngesandla esinzima.
Bakhuluma ngoNkulunkulu noMoses, bathi, Kungani na bona nisikhuphele ezweni laseMizi-Yiputa, ukuze sife esiqhingini? Akukho ukudla, akukho amanzi; begodu siyamthanda lokudla okumbi.
Wathumela ikosi phakathi kwabantu izinkomo ezibi khulu, zazibulala abantu; kwaba khona abantu abaningi baseSirayeli abafile.
Bafika ke abantu kuMoses, bathi, Sifile thina, ngombana sakhuluma ngoYehova nowe; thandaza kuYehova bona asuse kuzona lezi ntaka. UMosis wathandaza ngenxa yabantu.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Yenza inkomo encane, uyibeke emgodini, ukuze wonke umuntu onqunywe ngayo abheke kuyo, aphile.
Wakwenza uMoses inkomo yesiliva, wayibeka emgodini; ngaso soke isikhathi lapho umuntu ethenjwa yinkomo, ebheka inkomo yegolide, waphila.
Basuka abantu bakaSirayeli, bamisa isiqhingi eObhothi.
Basuka e-Obhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Iye-Abarim, esiqhingini esibhekene neMowabi, eningizimu.
Basuka khona khona, bamisa isibhedlela eGoli laseZeredi.
Basuka khona khona, bamisa isikhashana ngaphesheya komfula i-Arnoni, esiqhingini esifinyelela ezweni lama-Amori; u-Arnoni ungumkhawulo phakathi kukaMowabhi nezwe lama-Amori.
Lokhu wukuthi kungani Incwadi yamaMfazwe kaYehova ikhuluma ngo "Waheb eSuphah, nama-valleys eArnon,
kanye nezingqimba zezintaba ezifinyelela edolobhaneni le-Ar begodu zihlala eduze komgwaqo weMoab.
Basuka khona bafika eBeeri, lapho ikosi wathi kuMosese, Zihlanganisa abantu, ngizobanikeza amanzi.
Wathi uSirayeli wadlala lo mculo, wathi: "Nqoka, ifulegi, dlala ngalo!
Uthi, "Uzokhuluma nge ifulegi, okuyinto abaphathi waxhuma, bona amadoda abalulekile abantu waxhuma nge izintambo zabo royal kanye izintambo zokuhamba. "
kusukela Mattana Nahaliel, begodu kusuka Nahaliel Bamoth.
Basuka eBamothi, bafika emfuleni waseMowabi, lapho phezulu komfula iPisga ubona khona indawo enqaba.
Kwathi amaSirayeli athumela abathunywa kuShehoni, ukumkani wama-Amori, besithi,
Sizodlula ezweni lakho; asiyi kungena ezindaweni zokulima, noma ezivinini, siyodla amanzi emfuleni onke. Sizohlala emgwaqweni omkhulu wokumkani kuze sidlule ezweni lakho.
Kodwana uShehoni akhenge avumele amaSirayeli ukuba adlule ezweni lakhe; wahlanganisa wonke umkhosi wakhe, waphuma waya esiqhingini, wahlasela amaSirayeli. Wafika eYahazi, wahlasela amaSirayeli.
AbaSirayeli bamhlasela emdlalweni, bathatha izwe lakhe kusukela emfuleni uArnoni kuya emfuleni uYabhoki, kuze kube yizweni lakwa-Amoni; ngombana umkhawulo wamadodana ka-Amoni wawuqinile.
Bathatha amaSirayeli yonke imiphakathi yama-Amori, bahlala kuyo, kanye neHeshboni nezindawo zayo zonke.
(Ngenxa yokuthi iHeshboni ibiyidolobha likaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori; yena owabhekana nobukhosi bokuqala bamaMowabi, wathatha lonke izwe lakhe kuya emfuleni uArnoni.)
Ngenxa lalokho abalobi bathi, Yeni eHeshboni; uSihone kufanele aphinde akhiwa begodu aqiniswe.
Ngenxa lalokho, kwaphuma umlilo eHeshboni, umsindo emzini kaShehoni; wasindisa i-Ar yaseMowabhi, namadodana asezintabeni ngase-Arnoni.
Uzolahlekelwa, wena uMowabhi! Uzolahleka, wena umuntu okhonza uKemoshi. Washiya oonyana bakhe bahambe, washiya izingane zakhe zithathelwe nguSihoni ukumkani wama-Amori.
Siwuthule uHeshboni kuze kube yiDiboni; siwuthule kuze kube yiNofa, efinyelela eMedebha.
Wahlala ke uSirayeli ezweni lama-Amori.
UMoses wathumela abantu ukuba babhekane noJazeri; begodu abaSirayeli bathatha izindlu zayo, bakhipha ama-Amori ahlala kuzo.
Baphinde babuyela, benyuka ngendlela ehamba eBhashani. Waphuma uOg ukumkani waseBhashani, naye wonke umkhosi wakhe, wabahlasela e-Edrei.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Ungamkholeli; ngombana ngiwubeke phambi kwakho, yena nabantu bakhe bonke, nezwe lakhe. Uzokwenza kuye njengokuba wenza kuSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni.
Babulala uOgi, nabantwana bakhe, nomndeni wakhe wonke; akhenge ashiye umuntu ophilayo; bathatha izwe lakhe.
Basuka ke amakhosi aseSirayeli, bamisa isikhashana ezindaweni ezingenamanzi zaseMowabi, ngaseJordan, enkabeni yeJericho.
UBalaka unyana kaSipore wabona konke okwenze amaSirayeli kwabaAmori.
Abantu baseMowabhi bakhathazeka khulu, ngenxa yokuthi abantu bakaSirayeli babeningi khulu. Amakhosi aseMowabhi ahlupheke khulu ngenxa yabantu bakaSirayeli.

Bathi amaMowabi kwabaphathi baseMidiyani, Lizodla leli qembu zonke izinto eziseduze kwethu, njengokuthi inkomo idle izithelo ezindaweni zomhlaba. UBalaka unyana kaSiphore waba ngukumkani wamaMowabi ngalolu sikhathi.

Wathumela, wabiza uBhileham, unyana kaBeore, ohlala ePethori, enhliziyweni yomfula i-Efrayi, ezweni lakhe lokuzalwa. UBalaka wathi, "Kuyavela isizwe esigcwele siphuma eYiputa; bona, bagubuzela indawo yomhlaba wonke, behlala eduze kwami.

Ngiyakucela, thola manje, ubulale lo mhlanga ngami; ngombana banamandla kunami. Kungenzeka bona ngikwazi ukuwahlasela, begodu ngiwakhuphule ezweni; ngombana ngiyazi bona lowo owubhaptizelayo ubhaptizwa, nolowo owubulalayo ubhaptizwa.
Basuka ke abakhulu baseMowabhi nabaseMidiyani, bethathe ngezandla zabo izimali zomuntu okhuluma ngezinkanyezi; bafika kuBhalamu, baveza kuye amazwi kaBalaka.
Wathi kubo uBhileham, "Bukelani lapha kusasa; noma yini ongangiphendula yona ikosi, ngizobuya ngikutshele." Bahlala khona abakhulu baseMowabi.
Wafika uzimu kuBhileham, wathi, Babani labo abantu abakho kuwe?
Wathi uBhileham kuThixo, UBalaka unyana kaSipho, ukumkani wakwaMowabi, wathumela kuye, esithi,
Ngiyabona isizwe siphuma eYiputa, begodu siyagqugquzela isikhumba sezwe; manje ke uxhumane nami, ubeke phezu kwabo inkulumo, ukuze ngikwazi ukubhekana nabo, ngibakhuphe.
Wathi uzimu kuBhileham, "Ungayihamba nabo; ungababulali labo bantu, ngombana basindisiwe."
Wavuka ke uBhileham ekuseni, wathi kubo abakhulu bakaBalaka, Yiya ezweni lenu; ngombana ikosi akafuni bona ngihambe nani.
Babuyela kubo uBalaka abakhulu bakaMowabi, bathi, UBhalamu akafuni ukuba nathi.
Wathi uBalaka wathumela abanye abaphathi, abaningi kubo begodu abakhulu kunabokuqala.
Bafika kuBhileham, bathi kuye, Uthi uBalaka unyana kaSipho: Ngikucela, ungenzi lutho oluzokuvimbela bona ungangifiki.
Ngizokulethela umnikelo omkhulu khulu, begodu ngizokwenza konke okushoyo; ngiyakucela, zulazula kilabo bantu ngami.

Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kubo abakhonzi bakaBalaka, Nakuba uBalaka anganginika indlu yakhe egcwele isiliva negolide, angikwazi ukuphula umthetho kaYehova uzimu wami, ngikwenze lutho olukhulu noma oluncane.
Uma kunjalo, hlalani lapha namuhla, njengokuba nabo bahlala khona; ngizobona bona ikosi uzongitshela yini.
Kwafika uzimu kuBhileham ngemini leyo, wathi kuye, Uma abantu befikile ukukubiza wena, uhamba nabo; kodwana kwenze lokho engikushoyo kuwe.
Wavuka ke uBhileham ekuseni, wamisa isikelemu sakhe, waya nabaholi baseMowabi.
uzimu wagwema ngenxa yokuthi wayehamba, wabeka isithunywa sikaYehova endlelani, ukuze agweme indlela yakhe; yena uBhileham wayehamba phezu kwebhuza lakhe, nabangane bakhe ababi.
Ithole libona uMoya oNgcwele uhlala emgwaqeni, nekhebula esikhaleni sakhe, lisuka emgwaqweni liye esivandeni; uBhileham wabulala ithole, ukuze libuyele emgwaqweni.
Wathi uMoya oNgcwele, wahlala enhliziyweni encane phakathi kwezindawo ezimbili zokutshala izimbali zewayini; bekukhona umgwaqo ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla.
Yabona inkomo isithunywa soNkulunkulu, yacindezela ikhanda layo edongweni, yacindezela nenyawo likaBhileham; yena waphinde wamshaya.
Umbingeleli kaYehova waya phambili, wahlala endaweni encane, lapho kwakungekho khona indawo yokujika ngakwesokudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Yabona inkomo uMoya oNgcwele, yalala ngezansi kukaBhileham; yena waphoqa inhliziyo yakhe, wayishaya ngentambo.
Wakwenza ikosi bona ibele likhulume, lathi kuBhileham, Yini engiyikwenzele wena, wukuthi ubumishe ngami izikhathi amathathu?
Wathi uBhileham kulowo mkhwenyana, Ungikhohlisa; uma nginekhephu esandla sami, ngingakubulala manje.
Wathi ubhishobhi kuBhalamu, Ingabe angiyiyo ibhishobhi yakho, oyihamba ngayo kuze kube ngalolu busuku? Ngangikwenze yini lokhu kwangaphambilini? Wathi, Akunjalo.
Wavula ikosi amehlo kaBhileham, wabona isithunywa soMoya oNgcwele sisendlela, nesikhephe esisemandleni akhe; wathi uBhileham, uxhumane ngobuso bakhe phasi.
Wathi yena umbingeleli kaYehova kuye, Kungani na bona ugweme isikelemu sakho lezi zinsuku amathathu? Ngiye ngafika ngikuvimbele indlela yakho; ngombana indlela ohamba ngayo ayilungile phambi kwami.
Yabona ibhutshuzwayo bona ngikhona, yabuya yami ngalezo zikhathi amathathu; uma ingekabuya, ngibe sengikubulala wena manje, kodwana ngiyishiye iphila.
Wathi uBhileham kusingxobo sikaYehova, Ngihlulekile; ngombana angizange ngizi bona usukhona endlelani ukungivimbela; ngalokho-ke, uma kungakuhle kuwe, ngizobuyela ekhaya lami.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuBhalamu, Yiya nalabo bantu; kodwana lokho ngikutshelayo wena, lokho kuphela ozokusho. Wahamba ke uBhalamu nabaholi bakaBalaka.
UBalaka, lapho ekwazi bona uBhileham usefika khona, waphuma wahlangana naye emzini wamaMowabi, ogwini lwe-Arnoni, enhliziyweni yezwe lakhe.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Angikuthumeli yini wena ngamandla bona ufike? Kungani na bona ungafika nami? Ingabe ngingeke ngikwazi ukukunika inzalo enhle?
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Yabona, ngifike kuwe manje; kodwana ngizokwazi yini bona ngikhulume lutho? Okuthini uzimu abeke emlonyeni wami, lokho ngizokhuluma.
Wahamba ke uBhileham noBalaka waya eKiriyati-huzothi.
UBalaka wanikela ngezinkomo nezimvu, wabanika inyama uBhileham nabaholi ababe naye.
Wathi uBalaka ekuseni, wathatha uBhileham waya eBamoti-bhaali, lapho kuphakame khona uBhileham; wababona khona abantu baseSirayeli.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Ungikhiphe lapha izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, ngilungiselele khona izinkomo ezisixhenxe nezimvu ezisithupha.
Wakwenza uBalaka njengokuthi uBhileham, wanikela ngengulube kanye nomuntu omncane emgodini ngamnye.

Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Nqamula lapha eduze komnikelo wakho wokushiswa, ngize ngihambe; kungase kube khona bona ikosi angihlangane nami; noma yini engibonisa yona, ngizokutshela. Wahamba ke ehlathini elisha.
Wahlangana uzimu noBhileham, wathi kuye: Izibingelelo ezisixhenxe ngizilungiselele, begodu nganikela ngenkomo kanye nomkhwenyana phezu kwezibingelelo zonke.
Wabeka ikosi incwadi emlonyeni kaBhileham, wathi, Yibuye kuBalaka, ukhulume ngale le.
Wabuya ke uBhileham, wabona uBalaka uhlala eduze komnikelo wakhe wokudla, naye wonke abaholi baseMowabi.
UBhalamu waqala ukukhuluma, wathi: "UBalaka ungiveze e-Aram; ukumkani wakwaMowabi ungiveze emadolobheni asenyakatho. Wathi, 'Thina, zulazula kuYakobi; thina, zulazula eSirayeli.'
Ingabe ngizowubulala lowo uzimu angawubulali? Ngabe ngizokhuluma ngalowo ikosi akhenge akhulume ngawo?
Kusuka eziphezulu zezintaba ngibabona; kusuka emadolobheni ngiwabheka. Babantu abaphila ngokuzimela, bangazizwa sebeyizwe elilodwa phakathi kwamazwe.
Ubani okwazi ukubala abantu bakaYakobi? Baningi njengamatshe; ubani okwazi ukubala isigamu sabantu bakaSirayeli? Ngizofa ngifana nalabo abasebenza ngokulungile, begodu isiphelo sami sifane nabo.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Ungikwenzelani kuphi lokhu? Ngikutholile lapha bona unqume izidumbu zami; kodwana wena ubabalise!
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi, Ingabe angeke ngilinde bona ngikhulume lokho uzimu obeka emlonyeni wami?
