Wathi ke uBalaka kuye, Ngicela ngikutshele, landelana nami uye kwenye indawo lapho ungababona khona; kodwana uzowabona kuphela amacala abo, awuzowabona wonke; begodu ngaleso sikhathi ungibulale.
Wathi uBalaka wamthatha waya ezindaweni zaseZophim, eziphezulu koMfula iFisga; wakhiwa khona izibingelelo eziyisixhenxe, wanikela ngengulube kanye nomuntu omncane phezu kwezibingelelo ngazo.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Nqaba lapha eduze komnikelo wakho wokushiswa, nami ngizobhekana noYehova lapho.
Wahlangana ikosi noBhileham, wabeka incwadi emlonyeni wakhe, wathi, Yiya kuBalaka, ukhulume ngalokho.
Wabuya ke uBhileham, wabona uBalaka uhlala eduze komnikelo wakhe wokushiswa, namadoda amakhulu aseMowabi; wathi kuye uBalaka, Uthe yini ikosi?
Waqala uBhileham ukushumayela, wathi, Yisuse, Balaka, ulalele; lalela, wena unyana kaSipore.
uzimu angeke abe ngumntu, ukuze akhohlwe. Angeke abe umuntu, ukuze ashintshe ingqondo yakhe. Ingabe uthembisa begodu akakwenzanga? Ingabe ukhuluma begodu akakwenzanga?
Ngiyabona bona ngithunyelwe ukubonga. uzimu ubekezela, begodu angikwazi ukuwushintsha.
Akatholanga lutho olubi kuYakobi, akabona lutho olubi eSirayeli. UYehova uzimu wabo ukhona phakathi kwabo; baphuma becela ukuba abe ngukumkani wabo.
uzimu wabasusa eYiputa, Wabanikeza amandla afana nengulube yomhlaba.
Akukho lutho oluzosebenza ezweni likaYakobi, begodu akukho lutho oluzobangela ubuhlungu ezweni likaSirayeli. Bazothi kaYakobi nakwaSirayeli, Thola lokho uzimu akwenze!
Beka, abantu bavuka njengama-lions, baphuma njenge-lion; ngeke baphumule kuze kube sekuphele ukudla kwabo, bese bephuza igazi labo ababulawa ngalo.
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Uma ungawaphazamisi, akusho bona awubambisene nabo.
Waphendula ke uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, Angikushonga yini kuwe, bona konke okushoyo ikosi kufanele ngikwenze?
Wathi uBalaka kuBhileham, Yeza, ngizokuthathela enye indawo; kungase kube sengathi kulungile ebusweni bukaThixo, bona ungenzi izulu labo ngami khona khona.
Wathatha ke uBalaka uBhileham, waya esiphethweni somfula iPeori, obhekene ne-Eresi.
Wathi uBhileham kuBalaka, Ungikhiphe lapha izibingelelo ezisixhenxe, ngilungiselele khona izinkomo ezisixhenxe nezimvu ezisithupha.
Wakwenza uBalaka njengokuthi uBhileham, wanikela ngengulube nomuntu omncane emgodini ngamunye.
Wabona uBhileham bona kulungile emehlo kaYehova ukuba asindise amaSirayeli; akayeki ukubuza izibonakaliso, njengokuthi wayekwenze ngaphambilini; wabuyela, wabheka phambili, waya esiqhingi.
Waphakamisa uBhileham amehlo akhe, wabona isizwe sakwaSirayeli sisesitezi ngasesitezi; wafika phezu kwakhe umoya kaThixo.
Wathi uBhileham, yena unyana ka-Beori, umuntu obona ngokucacile ngamehlo akhe, uthi:
izindaba zomuntu okhuluma amazwi kaThixo, obona umbono ovela kulowo Onamandla onke, ohlala phantsi ngamehlo akhe avulekile:
Ngabe zihle kanjani izindlu zakho, abantu bakaYakobi, nezindlu zakho, abantu bakaSirayeli!
Bahlukaniswa njengamabhayisikili, njengezihlahla eziphakathi komfula, njengezinhlamvu ze-aloe azenzayo ikosi, njengezihlahla zezikedrubhi ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwamanzi.
Umanzi azophuma emabhodweni abo, begodu imbewu sabo izothola amanzi amanengi; ukumkani wabo uzoba mkhulu kuna-Agagi, nobukhosi babo buzophakama.
uzimu owabasusa eYiputa, uzoba nomthelela wabo ofanayo nenyama yenkomo. Bazodla izizwe ezingezinhlekazi zabo; bazobacindezela amathambo abo, begodu bazowabulala ngemicibisholo sabo.
Bahlala bephumula njengama-lion, njengendodana ye-lion; ngubani ozowavusa? Wonke umuntu okubambisana nawe, abe ngubabalo, begodu wonke umuntu okuphazamisa wena, abe nguphazamiso.
UBalaka wehla emlonyeni kaBhileham, washaya izandla zakhe, wathi kuBhalamu, Ngikubiza bona unqume izidumbu zami; kodwana namuhla ubabalise izikhathi amathathu.
Ngokuba, phuma lapha, uye ekhaya lakho; ngitjho, Ngizokulethela umholo omkhulu; kodwana ikosi unciphise umholo wakho kuwe.
Waphendula uBhileham, wathi kuBalaka, "Angazitshela kanjani abathunywa owawumithumela?
Nakuba uBalaka anganginika indlu yakhe egcwele isiliva negolide, angikwazi ukuphula umyalo kaYehova, ukuba ngikwenze kahle noma ngikwenze kabi ngezandla zami; ngizokhuluma lokho okushoyo ikosi.
Ngabona bona ngizobuya abantu bami; thola, ngikutshele lokho abakwenzayo labo bantu kubantu bakho, ezikhathini ezizayo.
Wathi uBhileham, yena unyana ka-Beori, umuntu obona ngokucacile ngamehlo akhe, uthi:
Izwi lomuntu okhuluma amazwi kaThixo, onolwazi oluvela kulowo ophezulu, obona umbono ovela kulowo onamandla onke, ohlala ekhonzeni, amehlo akhe evulekile:

Ngizokubona, kodwana akusekho manje; ngizobhekana naye, kodwana angeke abe eduze. Kuzophuma inkanyezi esuka kuYakobi, begodu isandla sobukhosi sizokhuphuka eSirayeli; uzophula izindlebe zakwaMowabi, nezingulube zabahlali bonke baseShethi.
I-Edom izonqotshwa, begodu iSeiri, ikosi yakhe, izonqotshwa; kodwana isiSirayeli sizoba namandla.
Uzophuma umholi ezweni likaYakobi, begodu uzobulala labo abasele kulo mzi."
Wabona uBhileham ama-Amaleki, wakhuluma wathi, Amaleki ubekuqala phakathi kwezizwe, kodwana ekupheleni kwakhe uzobiwa kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wabona amaKenithi, wakhuluma wathi kubo, Ikhaya lakho liphephile, njengenjabulo ebekwe emadolobheni aphezulu.
Kodwana-ke, wena, uKeni, uzodlwengulwa, lapho iAshuri izokuthwala ejele."
Wathi, "Ubani ongaphila uma uzimu ekwenza lokhu?
Kuzofika izinqanawa ezisuka ezindaweni zase-Israyeli, ziyophula i-Ashuri ne-Ebheri; begodu labo nabo bazolahleka kuze kube sekupheleni.
Wavuka ke uBhileham, wabuyela ezweni lakhe; noBalaka wahamba indlela yakhe.
Kwathi lapho amaSirayeli uhlala khona eShitimi, kwaqala amadodana abo ukuba namaMowabhi.
Bathi, "Sicelani umnikelo wokudla," begodu bakhonza amadini abo angcwele; abantu babedla iminikelo sabo yesonka, bewuhlonipha lo mthetho.
Kwathi amaSirayeli ahlanganisana noBhaali wePehore; ikosi wagwema khulu amaSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Thola bonke abaphathi bezizwe, ubabulale, ubakhonze phambi koYehova emini; ukuze indlala yobubi beNkosi ihambe ezweni laseSirayeli.
Wathi uMosis kwabaphathi bakaSirayeli, Ubulalani wonke umuntu othile phakathi kwenu amadoda akhe ahlobene noBaali-peori.
Kwathi lapho uMoses nomphakathi wonke waseSirayeli belele emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, kwafika umuntu wesiSirayeli, waveza indodakazi yaseMidiyani ekhempini yakhe, ebhekene nabo.
Wakubona lokhu uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazarhi, oyise ka-Aron umpristi; wavuka phakathi komphakathi, wathatha isibhamu esandla sakhe.
Walandela lowo muntu waseSirayeli, waya esitezi, wabeka isibhamu phakathi kwabo bobabili, phakathi komuntu nomfazi; khona-ke lo mkhuhlane obulalayo waba mnyama phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.
Kodwana abantu abangu-24,000 babesele befa ngenxa yesifo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

UPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazarhi, umngane ka-Aron ukumkani, washintsha inkohliso yami kilabo baseSirayeli; ngenxa yothando lwami lokugcina inhliziyo yami phakathi kwabo, ngaze ngazisusa izizwe zakwaSirayeli enhliziyweni yam.
Ngiyaxolisa khulu ngalokhu, begodu ngizoqhubeka nokwenza lokhu.

Lokhu kuzobe yisivumelwano sakhe, kanye nembewu yakhe ngemuva kwakhe, bona babe ngabapristi kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku; ngenxa yokuthi wabhekana ngothando nozimu wakhe, walungisa abantu bakaSirayeli phambi kukaThixo.
Umfazi waseSirayeli, owafa nomfazi waseMidiyani, wayenguZimri unyana kaSalu, owayengumholi weqembu lemindeni eyisizwe sikaSimeoni.
Uwesifazane waseMidiyani owabulawa wuCozbi, intombi kaZur, owayengumholi weqembu lemindeni eMidiyani.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
"Ukwelapha Midianites njengezitha begodu ukuhlasela kwabo.
Ngokuba bakwenzani nibe ngabaphikisi, lapho bekuzazisa bona nikhonza uBhaali we-Peori, noKozbi, intombi yomphathi waseMidiyani, umngane wabo, owafa ngosuku lwesifo ngenxa ye-Peori.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses no-Eleazaru, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, ngemuva kokugula okubulalayo, wathi,
Uthi uMosis ku-Israyeli, Bhala ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli ngokwemindeni sabo; babalo bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, angaphuma emkhosini eSirayeli.
UMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli bakhuluma abantu ezindaweni ezingenamanzi zaseMowabi, eduze komfula iYorodani enkabeni yeJericho, bathi,
Babala bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, njengokuthi ikosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses. Lokho kwakungubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli ababephuma eYiputa:
URubhen ube ngumzali kaSirayeli. Ezweni likaRubhen kwakunguHanoki, umndeni wamaHanoki; ezweni likaPalu, umndeni wamaPaluiti;
ku-Heshroni, imindeni yama-Heshroni; ku-Karmi, imindeni yama-Karmiti.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaRubhen; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-43 namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Unyana kaPalu nguElibha,
Oonyana bakaElibha: uNemuyeli, noDathani, noAbironi. Lowo nguDathani noAbironi, abaqondisi bomphakathi, abaye babhekana noMoses noAron; babekhona phakathi kweqembu likaKora, lapho bebhekana noYehova.
Umhlaba wawuvuleka, wawela kubo kanye no-Korah; begodu abakhonzi bakhe bafa, lapho umlilo wehlisa khona abantu abangumakhulu amabili namashumi amahlanu.
Kodwana oonyana bakaKora abafile.
KuSimeoni kwaba yimindeni elandelayo: NgoNemuyeli, imindeni ye-Nemuyeli; ngoYamini, imindeni ye-Yamini; ngoYakini, imindeni ye-Jahini;
kuZeraha, imindeni yamaZerahhi; kuShawuli, imindeni yamaShauli.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaSimeoni; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-22 namakhulu amabili.
KuGadi kwaba yimindeni sabo: Ngo-Zephon, indodana ka-Zefoni; ngo-Hagi, indodana ka-Hagi; ngo-Shuni, indodana ka-Shuni;
ku-Ozni, umndeni ka-Oznite; ku-Eri, umndeni ka-Erite;
ku-Arode, imindeni yama-Arodi; ku-Areli, imindeni yama-Areli.
Lezi ziyizizwe zikaGadi; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-40.
Bafa amadodana amabili kaYuda, uEr noOnan, ezweni laseKanan.
Basuka ezweni laseYuda: kusukela kuShela, imindeni yamaShelani; kusuka kuPerezi, imindeni yamaPerezi; kusuka kuZeraha, imindeni yamaZerahhi.
Ku-Perezi bekukhona izizwe ezilandelayo: ku-Heshroni, isizwe sama-Heshroni; ku-Hamuli, isizwe sama-Hamuli.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaYuda; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti ayishumi nesishiyagalombili namawaka amabili namakhulu amahlanu.
Imindeni ka-Issakha: ku-Tola, imindeni yamaTholayi; ku-Puwa, imindeni yamaPhunayi;
kuYashubu, imindeni yamaYashubi; kuShimroni, imindeni yamaShimroni.
Kulezi izizwe zakwa-Issakhar; labo ababalolwe kubo beyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili namashumi amane anane, amakhulu amathathu.
KuZabuloni bekukhona izizwe ezilandelayo: kuSeredi, isizwe sama-Zerethi; ku-Elon, isizwe sama-Eloni; ku-Yahleeli, isizwe sama-Yahleeli.
Kulezi izizwe zikaZebulun; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti amashumi ayisishiyagalombili amawaka namakhulu amane.
Izizwe ezisuka kuYosefu zafika bantwana bakhe, uManase noEfrayim.
NgaManase kwavela izizwe: kuMakhire, isizwe samaMakhiri; uMakhire ube ngubaba kaGiliyadi; eGiliyadi kwavela isizwe samaGiliyadi.
Lawa amabandla asuka eGiliyadi: ku-Yezere, imindeni yamaJezeri; ku-Heleki, imindeni yamaHeleki;
ku-Asriyeli, imindeni yama-Asriyeli; eShekem, imindeni yama-Shekemi;
ku-Shemida, imindeni yama-Shemidayi; ku-Hepher, imindeni yama-Heferi.
UZelofehadi unyana ka-Heferi, akhenge abe namadodana, kodwana kwaba nezingane; begodu lamagama izingane zakhe: uMahala, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaManase; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-52 namakhulu ayisithupha.
Ezweni lika-Ephrayi bekukhona izizwe ezilandelayo: ku-Shutela, isizwe sama-Suthelahi; ku-Bekhere, isizwe sama-Bekheri; ku-Tahani, isizwe sama-Tahani.
Kusuka ku-Eran, unyana ka-Shuthelah, kwafika iqembu le-Eranite.
Bazo zonke lezi izizwe zakwa-Ephrayi; labo ababalolwe kubo, kwaba ngumakhulu mathathu, amabili anamakhulu amahlanu. Zonke lezi zizwe zasuka kuYosefu.
Kwabe sekukhona izizwe zakwaBhenjamini: ku-Bela, isizwe sama-Belayithi; ku-Ashbeli, isizwe sama-Ashbelithi; ku-Ahiramu, isizwe sama-Ahiramithi;
ku-Shephupham, ikosi yama-Shufami; ku-Hupham, ikosi yama-Huphami.
Izizwe ezisuka ku-Ardi noNaamani, oonyana bakaBela: kusuka ku-Ardi, isizwe sama-Arditi; kusukela ku-Naamani, isizwe sama-Naamini.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaBhenjamin; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-45.
Umndeni kaDani: uSuhami, umndeni wamaSuhami; lezi ziyimindeni yakwaDani.
Wonke umndeni wakwa-Shuhami waba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, anamashumi amane nane amawaka, namakhulu amane.
Ku-Ashere bekukhona amaqembu: ku-Imna, iqembu lama-Imnite; ku-Ishivi, iqembu lama-Ishivite; ku-Beriya, iqembu lama-Berite.
Ngaye kwavela imindeni kaBeriya: Ngo-Ebheri, imindeni yamaHeberi; ngo-Malkhiyeli, imindeni yamaMalkhiyeli.
U-Ashere ube nenkosikazi, igama layo nguSera.
Bazo zonke izizwe zakwa-Ashere, labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti ayishumi nambili namawaka amathathu anamakhulu amane.
KuNaphtali kwaba yimindeni sabo: kusuka ku-Yasheeli kwakuyimindeni ye-Yasheeli; kusuka eGuni kwakuyimindeni ye-Guni;
ku-Yezere, imindeni yamaJezerithi; ku-Shileme, imindeni yamaShilemi.
Kulezi izizwe zakwaNaphtali; labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-45 namakhulu amane.
Wonke umkhawulo wabo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, ababalolwe, waba ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namawaka amabili namakhulu amathathu nesithupha.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Bahlukanise izwe phakathi kwalezi zakwaSirayeli, ngokwenani lamagama abo, ukuze kube yibo.
Vumela isizwe esikhulu sithole inkontileka enkulu yendawo begodu isizwe esincane sithole inkontileka encane. Isizwe ngayinye sizothola indawo ngokuya ngenani labantu ababalolwe.
Kodwana-ke, izwe kumele lihlukaniswe ngokushaya inkontileka. Isizwe ngayinye somndeni wakwaSirayeli sizothola inkontileka yayo ngokwegama lesizwe saso.
Ingxenye ngayinye izohlukaniswa ngodlame phakathi kwezizwe ezinkulu nezincane.
Lawa amaqembu emindeni yamaLevi, labo ababhekwayo: kusuka kuGershoni, imindeni yamaGershoni; kusuka kuKohati, imindeni yamaKohati; kusuka kuMerariya, imindeni yamaMerariya.
Lezi ziyimindeni yamaLevi: imindeni yamaLibni, nemindeni yamaHebroni, nemindeni yamaMaheli, nemindeni yamaMushi, nemindeni yamaKorahi. UKohati ube ngubaba kaAmram.
UJokhebedi, indodana kaLawi, owazalwa kumndeni kaLawi eYiputa, wayeyinkosikazi kaAmram; wazala uAron noMoses, noonyana ababi, noMiriam, inkosikazi sabo.
U-Aron waba ubaba kaNadabhi, no-Abihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
Kodwana uNadabhi no-Abhihu bafa, lapho benikela ngomlilo kuYehova, ongeke kwenziwe.
AbaLevi ababalolwe, amadoda aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-23; bebengabalwa phakathi kwamadodakazi kaSirayeli, ngombana kwakungaba nezwe phakathi kwabo.
Lokho yibo ababalowe nguMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli, lapho bebala khona oonyana bakaSirayeli ezindaweni ezisempumalanga zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan, eJericho.
Akukho omunye wabo phakathi kwalabo ababalolwe nguMoses no-Aron umpristi esiqhingini iSinai.
Ngokuba ikosi wathi ngalabo abantu, Bazofa ezweni lezulu elimnyama; kwakungekho muntu osele kubo, ngaphandle kukaKalebe unyana kaJefune noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.

Kwafika khona izingane zikaZelofehadi; uZelofehadi ube nguyise kaHeferi, umfazi kaGileyadi, umfazi kaMakhire, umfazi kaManase, emndenini kaManase, umfazi kaYosefu. Amagama izingane zakhe zaba nguMahla, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.
Bahlala phambi kukaMoses, no-Elazare umbingeleli, nabaphathi, nebandla lonke, emgwaqeni wetente lengqungquthela, besithi,
Ubaba wethu wafa esiqhingini, naye akabe yilungu leqembu likaKora, labo abaphikisayo noYehova; kodwana wafa ngenxa yobubi bakhe, akhenge abe nezingane.
Kungani ke bona igama lobaba wethu liphele emndenini wakhe, ngenxa yokuthi akhenge abe nendodana? Sinike izwe phakathi kwemindeni yobaba wethu.
Wathi uMosis, waveza isinqumo sabo phambi koYehova.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Zilungile izingane zikaZelofehadi; uzobanikeze imbewu phakathi kwabangane bakababa babo, njengento sabo; ubanikeze inkontileka yobaba wabo.
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, usithi: Uma umuntu efa, engeke abe nendodakazi, niyinike inkosikazi yakhe imbewu yakhe.
Uma engeke abe nendodakazi, unikele izwe lakhe abazalwane bakhe.
Uma engeke abe nabangane, unikele izwe lakhe abangane bakababa wakhe.

Uma ubaba wakhe engeke abe nabangane, khona-ke niyinike imbewu yakhe umngane wakhe osonhlalakahle khulu emndenini wakhe, ibe yindawo yakhe. Kuye kube ngumthetho nomthetho kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, njengombana ikosi awisenzile uMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Yiya phezulu kulo mnxweme we-Abarim, ubone izwe engilifumene lamadodana kaSirayeli.
Uma usuyibona, uzofa nawe, uhlangane nabantu bakho abafileyo; njengombana kwakufa uAron umzalwana wakho.
Ngokuba niyiphula imithetho yami, bona ngibe ngungcwele phakathi kwabo ngamanzi, lapho ibandla likhuluma nami esiqhingini sikaZin. Laziwa bona yimanzi kaMeriba eKadeshi, esiqhingini sikaZin.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova,
"uzimu, wena uzimu onikeza umoya kiwo wonke umuntu. Nceda ukhethe umuntu phezu kwalolu hlanga
Uzobasusa emdlalweni, begodu uzowabuyisela ezweni labo; ukuze abantu bakaYehova bangabi njengamakhoboka angeke abe nomlimi.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Thola uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, indodana yomoya, uyibeke isandla sakho phezu kwakhe.
Uzobeka phambi kuka-Elazare, umbingeleli, nomphakathi wonke, ube nguMengameli phakathi kwabo bonke.
Uzobeka phezu kwakhe igunya lakho, ukuze bonke abantu bakaSirayeli bamthobele.
Uzohlala phambi kuka-Elazare, umbingeleli; yena uzobuza isinqumo seNkosi ngale-Urim. Ngomyalo wakhe uJoshua nomndeni wonke wakwaSirayeli, ibandla lonke, bazophuma nabo bafike.
Wakwenza uMoses njengombana ikosi abemwisele umthetho ngawo; wathatha uYoshuwa, wambeka phambi kuka-Elazare umpristi, nomphakathi wonke.
Wabeka izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe, wamisa ukuba abe nguMengameli, njengombana ikosi atjhilo ngoMosese.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMoses, 20Ubatshele izingane zakwaSirayeli bona: "Njengombana nifuna ukunginikela ngomnikelo wami wesono ezikhathini zabo ezifanele; ukudla kwami okwenziwa ngomnqumo womlilo, njengephunga elimnandi.
Uzothi kubo, Le yiminikelo yenu eyenziwe ngomlilo, ongayinikela kuYehova: izinkomo ezimbili ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala, ezingabi necala, ngosuku ngalunye, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo.
Uzonikela ngengane eyodwa ekuseni, nenye uma ilanga liphuma.
Nokho, ngaye ngamunye nizoletha isiphuzo sokudla esifana nekhilogremu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yobisi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nolitha elilodwa le-oyile ye-olive.
Lo ngumnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, owanikela ngawo emfuleni iSinayi; umnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo, wephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uzonikela ngesipho sokudla, isilitha ngayinye sewayini elisha; uzolibazisa ikosi endaweni engcwele..
Uzonikela isibeleko esisodwa emini, kanye nomnikelo wayo wokudla, nesipho sayo sotshwala, njengokuthi ukwenze ekuseni; yisondlo esishiswa ngomlilo, iphunga elimnandi kuYehova.

NgoMsombuluko, ninikeze izimbuzi ezimbili ezineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, ezingabi nephutha, kanye nomnikelo wokudla we-efa yesiliva, ehlotshiswe ngephethiloli, kanye nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Lo ngumnikelo oshiswayo wesonto ngalinye, ngaphezu komnikelo oshiswayo ohlala njalo nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga, nizonikela umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, nomuntu omdala owodwa, namaqanda amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi nenkinga.

Nomnikelo wokudla, umnikelo wesonka esifana nekhilogramu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yobisi oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, ngengulube ngayinye; nomnikelo wokudla ofana nekhilogramu amathathu zobisi oluhlanganiswe nophethiloli, ngemvu.

Uzonikela ngomnikelo oshiswayo, umnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo, wephunga elimnandi kuYehova, ilitha elilodwa neshumi nesigamu sekhilogremu yobisi oluhlanzekile oluhlanganisiwe nophethiloli, kanye nomntwana owodwa.

Namanzi abo okudlela azobe elingana nelitha elilodwa lewayini ngengulube ngayinye, nelitha elilodwa nesithathu ngemvu, nelitha elilodwa nesithathu ngengane ngayinye. Lo ngumnikelo wokushiswa ngonyaka wonke, ngenyanga nganye.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane owodwa njengomnikelo wesono kuYehova, ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nesonka saso.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala, amalanga ezingu-14 zoMsombuluko kaYehova.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga kuzoba khona isikhumbuzo; usuku oluyisixhenxe nizodla inyama engenasici.
Ngosuku lokuqala, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze lutho olujwayelekile.
Ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, isonka somlilo: izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, nomkhwenyana owodwa, namaqanda amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi nenkinga.
Nakho-ke nizonikela ngomnikelo wokudla, ubisi olufino oluhlanganisiwe neoli, amakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili ngengulube ngayinye, namakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili ngemvu.
Kuzo zonke izingulube ezisixhenxe, thola ikhilogramu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili.
Ninikeze nenyama yenkomo eyodwa, ibe yisonka sesono, ukuze nilungise.
Uzonikela ngale nto ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa ojwayelekile.
Uzokwenza njalo ngosuku, amalanga ezisixhenxe; yinyama yomnikelo wokudla owenziwe ngomlilo, uphunga elimnandi kuYehova; ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nomnikelo wayo wokudla.
Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nikwenze umsebenzi ojwayelekile.
Ngosuku lokuqala lokuvuna, lapho ninikela khona umnikelo wokudla okusha kukaNkulunkulu emcimbini wamaviki, kumele kube nengqungquthela engcwele; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi ojwayelekile.
Uzonikela ngenhlanhla yokudlwengula izinkomo ezimbili ezincane, nomuntu omdala owodwa, namabele aneminyaka eyisithupha ubudala, njengephunga elimnandi kuYehova.
kanye nesibopho sazo sesonka, isikhunta esifinyeliwe, esimisiwe ngephethiloli, ilitha elilodwa legolide ngayinye inkomo, nelitha elilodwa legolide ngalinye ingulube;
begodu mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.
Bathi: "Kulungile. Sizokulethela isimbuzi esisodwa esifileyo,
Uzonikela ngale nto kanye neziphuzo zayo, ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo nomnikelo wayo wokudla; uzoba nenyama engabi nephutha.
Ngonyaka wesixhenxe, ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga, kumele kube khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze umsebenzi othile; kufanele kube yimini yokuphuza izipho.
Ninikeze isonka esishiswayo, njengephunga elimnandi ikosi: inkomo eyodwa encane, nomuntu oyedwa, namabele amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi necala.
kanye nesibopho sazo sokudla, imbewu ehlanzekile encibilikisiwe ngephethiloli: amasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ngengulube eyodwa, namasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ngemvu;
begodu mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.
Ninikeze nenyama yenkomo eyodwa, ibe yisonka sesono, ukuze nilungise.

Lokhu kungenxa yomnikelo wokushiswa wonyaka omusha, nomnikelo wayo wesonka, kanye nomnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nomnikelo wayo wesonka, neziphuzo zazo, ngokusho komthetho; yi yizipho ezifakiwe ngomlilo, iphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga yesixhenxe, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nidle ukudla, begodu ngeke nisebenze lutho.
Ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa, oyisiphuzo esithandekayo kukaNkulunkulu: inkomo eyodwa encane, nomuntu oyedwa, namabele amane aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala, angabi necala.
kanye nesibopho sazo sokudla, imbewu ehlanzekile encibilikisiwe ngephethiloli: amasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ngengulube eyodwa, namasentimitha ayisishiyagalombili ngemvu;
begodu mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.
kanye nobhontshisi omncane owodwa njengomnikelo wesono, ngaphezu komnikelo wesono wokwenza isiqiniseko, nomnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nesonka saso sokudla, neziphuzo zaso.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesixhenxe, kuzobe kukhona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi omusha onke. Usuku lokuphumula loNkulunkulu luzohlala amalanga ezisithupha.

Ninikeze isonka esishiswayo, isiphuzo somlilo sephunga elimnandi ikosi: izinkomo ezincane eziyishumi nambili nesikhombisa; izimvu ezimbili; amaqanda aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi namaphutha.

kanye nomnikelo wazo wokudla, ubisi olufino oluhlanganisiwe nephethiloli, okungu-sethi elilodwa lama-shekeli kinanyana iyiphi ingulube eyisishiyagalombili, no-sethi elilodwa lama-shekeli kinanyana iyiphi inkomo emibili;
begodu mayelana eyodwa nengxenye amakhilogremu ngayinye yezinkomo eziyisithupha.
kanye nobhontshisi omncane owodwa njengomnikelo wesono, ngaphezu komnikelo wokushiswa oqhubekayo, nesonka saso nesiphuzo sokudla.
Ngosuku lwesibili, ingulube encane ezingu-12, inkunzi yemvu ezimbili, nenyama yenkomo yonyaka owodwa eyishumi nane; akukho lutho olubi kiwo.
kanye nezingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi, ninikeze inkomishi yazo yokudla nokuphuza, ngokuya ngenani lazo, njengombana kusho umthetho.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.
Ngosuku lwesithathu ninikeze izinkomo ezingu-11, namakhoboka amabini, nezingulube ezinonyaka owodwa eziyishumi nambili; azibi.
kanye nezingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi, ninikeze inkomishi yazo yokudla nokuphuza, ngokuya ngenani lazo, njengombana kusho umthetho.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.
Ngosuku lwesine, ingulube ezingu-10, amakhowe amabili, namaqanda aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi nephutha.
kanye nezingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi, ninikeze inkomishi yazo yokudla nokuphuza, ngokuya ngenani lazo, njengombana kusho umthetho.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.
Ngosuku lwesihlanu: izinkomo eziyisishiyagalombili, izimvu ezimbili, amabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala amashumi amabili nanhlanu, angabi necala.
kanye nezingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi, ninikeze inkomishi yazo yokudla nokuphuza, ngokuya ngenani lazo, njengombana kusho umthetho.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.
Ngosuku lwesishiyagalombili, ingulube eziyisishiyagalombili, amakhowe amabili, namabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala alishumi elinane, angabi necala.
kanye nezingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi, ninikeze inkomishi yazo yokudla nokuphuza, ngokuya ngenani lazo, njengombana kusho umthetho.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe, ingulube eziyisishiyagalombili, inkomo emibili, amabele aneminyaka eyodwa ubudala amashumi amabili nanhlanu, angabi nephutha.
kanye nezingulube, nezimvu, nezimbuzi, ninikeze inkomishi yazo yokudla nokuphuza, ngokuya ngenani lazo, njengombana kusho umthetho.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.
Ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili, yenza isibingelelo esikhethekile begodu ungasebenzisi umsebenzi ojwayelekile.
begodu ninikeze isonka esishiswayo, isiphuzo esincibilikayo ngomlilo sephunga elimnandi kuYehova: inkomo eyodwa, umnqumo owodwa, namabele amane aneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, angabi necala.
Nomuntu wesifazane, nomuntu omncane, namadodakazi abo, ninikeze isonka sabo, neziphuzo zabo, ngokuya ngenani labo, ngokwemithetho ebhaliwe.
Uzonikela nomuntu wesifazane omncane, ibe yisonka sokudla, kanye nenyama yenkomo eyisishiyagalombili, ibe yisonka sesono.

Nizilungiselele lezi zinto kuYehova ezinyangeni zemikhosi yenu, ngaphandle kwezibopho zenu, nangaphandle komnikelo wenu wokudla, noma iminikelo yenu yokuthosa, noma iminikelo yenu yesonka, noma iminikelo yenu yotshwala, noma iminikelo yenu yezihlandlo zokuthula.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, konke okumwise ikosi.
Wathi uMoses kubaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, ethi, Lokho wukuthi umthethosivivinywa kaYehova:
Uma umuntu enikela isipho esikhethekile kuYehova, noma ephuza umlomo wakhe ngezwi eliqinile, angeke aphula igama lakhe; wonke amazwi akhe azowenza.
Uma uwesifazane uhlala ekhaya lobaba wakhe, esenza isibopho kuYehova, noma emisa inhliziyo yakhe ngomsebenzi,
uma ubaba wakhe ekhuluma ngaye, kodwana engasho lutho kuye, khona-ke zonke izibopho zakhe nezibopho zakhe kufanele zigcinelwe.
Uma ke ubaba wakhe ephoqelela, ngosuku akubona ngalo, khona-ke zonke izinyembezi zakhe, nanoma yiziphi izibopho zakhe, ngeke zisebenze; begodu ikosi uzomuxolela, ngombana ubaba wakhe uphoqelele.
Uma ibhishobhi ikhulelwe, begodu iyaqhubeka ihlobene ngesivumelwano, noma ngesinqumo esingenangqondo,
begodu umyeni wakhe ezwa ngalolu daba, kodwana akusho lutho kuye ngemini lapho ezwa ngayo, khona-ke izibopho zakhe nezibopho zakhe kumele zigcinwe.
Kodwana uma indodana yakhe, ngesikhathi esezizwa ngayo, ichaza bona akuvumelekile, khona-ke iphupho lakhe elibi, noma isibopho sakhe esingokwengqondo, ngeke lisebenze; begodu ikosi uzoyilungisa.
Noma yiziphi izibopho noma izinqumo ezithathwe nguwesifazane wesifazane noma obulawe kufanele zigcinwe.
Uma indodakazi yowesifazane isenza isibopho, noma iveza isandla sayo ngesinqumo, uhlala ekhaya lomyeni wakhe,
begodu indodana yakhe ikhuluma ngayo, kodwana ayibonisi lutho kuye, begodu ayivimbeli, khona-ke zonke izibopho zayo kanye nanoma yiziphi izibopho zakhe kumele zigcinwe.
Uma indodana yakhe iyisabalalisa ngalolu busuku, lapho ikhuluma khona, ngeke kube khona noma yini emthethweni wayo, noma esinqumweni sakhe; indodana yakhe iisabalalisa, begodu ikosi uzomuxolela.
Umfazi wakhe angavuma noma asuse noma yiziphi izibopho zakhe, nanoma yiziphi izibopho zokuyeka izinto.

Uma indodana yakhe ikhala ngayo kuze kube ngusuku olulandelayo, khona-ke umyeni wakhe uqinisile zonke izinyembezi zayo, nanoma yiziphi izibopho zakhe; ngombana wavuma ngazo ngosuku lapho ezwa ngalo, ngokukhala kwayo.
Uma elahlekile isikhathi esithileko ngemuva kokulalela ngazo, uzothwala isinqumo sayo sokuphula isibopho.
Lawa amalungiselelo, asho ikosi kuMoses, phakathi kumfazi nomfazi wakhe, phakathi koyise nonkosikazi yakhe, uhlala ekhaya lakhe.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uzophinde ukhokhele abantu baseMidiyani lokho abakwenzayo kubantu bakaSirayeli; bese uza kufa, uzohlangatshelwa nabantu bakho.
Wathi uMosis kubo bonke abantu, Nciphisani phakathi kwenu amadoda empilweni, ahambe ahlasele ama-Midiyani, abe yingozi kulowo muntu.
Sebenzisa abantu abangu-1 ezweni ngalinye lamadodakazi kaSirayeli, ukulwa.
Bakhetha abantu abangu-1 eqenjini ngalinye, phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli amakhulu amabili namashumi amahlanu.
Wabathumela uMoses emkhosini, isizukulwane ngayinye esingu-1; naye noPhinehasi indodana kaElazarhi umpristi. UPhinehasi wathatha ngesandla sakhe izinto zendawo engcwele, namaphoyinti okukhumbuza.
Bahlasela iMidiyani, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses; babulala wonke umuntu umfazi.
Babulala begodu uBalamu, unyana kaBeore, ngeqhwa, phakathi kwabo bonke abafileyo: uEvhi, no-Rekem, no-Zure, no-Hure, no-Reba, abaphathi beMidiyani.
Amadodana kaSirayeli athathe amadoda namantombazane aseMidiyani, nezingane zabo, nazo zonke izilwane zabo, nezimvu zabo, nempahla sabo.
Babulala wonke amadolobhana aseMidiyani, lapho behlala khona, kanye nezindawo zabo zokudlela.
Bathatha yonke into abayitholayo, nanoma yini ababeyiqoqe, abantu nenyama.

Bathi, "Sizokhipha izinyamazane zethu, nezilwane zethu, kanye nento ethengiswayo, siyiveze kuMoses, no-Elazare umbingeleli, kanye nebandla lakwaSirayeli, esiteji esisemaphandleni sakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan eJericho.
Waphuma ke uMoses, no-Elazare umpristi, nabaholi bonke bebandla, bahlangana nabo ngaphandle kwesiqhingi.
UMoses wehla emlonyeni wabaphathi bomkhosi, abaphathi bezinkulungwane, nabaphathi bezikhulu, ababuyayo emdlalweni.
Wababuza wathi, "Ngabe ushiye amadoda wonke ephila?
Baye labo abahamba ngemibono kaBhileham, baholela abantu bakaSirayeli ukuba bagweme ukuthula noYehova, ngomsebenzi wePeori; ngalokho kwaba khona isifo phakathi kwabantu bakaYehova.
Manje bulala wonke umfazi, begodu bulala yonke indodana uhlala nomuntu.
Ngalokho-ke, gcinani engqondweni yenu bona wonke uwesifazane ongazange ahlale nomuntu.

Wonke umuntu phakathi kwenu obulala umuntu, noma onquma umfileyo, kufanele ahlale ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi amalanga eziyisithupha; ngosuku oluthathu nosuku olusixhenxe kumele nihlanzeke, nina nalabo ababoshwe.
Uzohlanza nanoma iyiphi impahla, noma iyiphi into eyenziwe ngesikhumba, noma izinwele zengulube, noma imithi.
Wathi u-Elazare, umpristi, kwabazobe bephuma emkhosini, ethi, Lokho wumthetho womthetho owawusho ikosi kuMosese:
Igolide, isilivere, isibhakabhaka, insimbi, i-tin, ukuhola,

begodu noma yini engakwazi ukumelana nokushisa, kufanele idlule emgodini, bese ihlanzekile. Kodwana-ke, kumele ibe mhlophe ngemanzi okuhlanza. Nanoma yini engakwazi ukumelana nokushisa, kufanele idlule ngamanzi.
Nizihlanze izigqoko zenu ngosuku olusixhenxe, nihlale nihlanzekile; begodu ngemuva kwalokho ningaya eqenjini.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
U-Elazare umbingeleli, nawe, kanye nabaholi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli, kufanele nibalo bonke abantu nabanyama abathathwe.
Yabelana ngezingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo: eyodwa yabadlali abaphuma emdlalweni kanye nenye yabanye abantu.
Engxenyeni yalabo abahamba phambili, unikezwe umnikelo wokudla ikosi: umuntu owodwa ngamakhulu amahlanu, nokuba ngumuntu, noma inkomo, noma idla, noma ingulube, noma inkomo.
Uzothatha lokhu engxenyeni sabo, uyinike u-Elazare umpristi, ibe yisipho esikhethekile kuYehova.

Engxenyeni yabantwana bakaSirayeli, uzothatha umuntu owodwa kumakhulu amahlanu, nokuba ngumuntu, noma ingulube, noma inkomo, noma inkomo encane, noma inkomo enkulu, noma iyiphi enye into yokudla; uzowanikela kumaLevi, abaphatha umsebenzi wendawo engcwele kaYehova.
Wakwenza ke uMoses no-Elazare umpristi, njengokuba ikosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Izinto eziboshwe, ezingenayo imindeni sabo, zaziyizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili nesiyisishiyagalombili namashumi amane namahlanu amaphesenti;
izingulube ezingu-72,000,
izinkomo ezingu-61,000;
kanye ezingu-32,000 abesifazane abazange baphumule nomuntu.
Ingxenye yalabo abazobe besebenza emkhosini yaba ngumakhulu amathathu, amawaka amashumi amathathu nesishiyagalombili, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili embuzi;
Ingxenye kaYehova yaba ngamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anesihlanu.
Izingulube zaziyizinkulungwane ezingu-36,000; inkontileka kaYehova yayiyizinkulungwane eziyisixhenxe nambili.
Izikelemu zaziyizigidi ezimashumi mathathu namakhulu amahlanu; inkontileka kaYehova ibiyizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili.
Kwaba ngamaphesenti angama-16, begodu inkontileka kaYehova yaba ngamashumi amathathu anesibini.
UMoses wanikela ngomnikelo kaYehova ku-Elazare umpristi, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMosis.
Ingxenye yesithathu yaba yiyo yabantu bakaSirayeli, leyo ngxenye uMosis wayisabalalisa ezweni labo.
Ingxenye yomphakathi yaba ngumakhulu amathathu, amawaka amashumi amathathu anesithupha, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, izinkomo nezimvu,
izingulube ezingu-36,000,
ezingu-30 nezinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili,
namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye abantu.

Engxenyeni yamadodana kaSirayeli, uMoses wathatha umuntu owodwa kiwo wonke amashumi amahlanu abantu nokudla kwazo zonke izinto eziphilako, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo uMosis; wabanikela kwabaLevi, abaphatha umsebenzi wendawo engcwele kaYehova.
Bafika ke kuMoses abaphathi bemikhosi, abaholi bezikhulu nabenzi-nkulungwane.
Bathi kuye, "Sinezinkontileka nabasebenzi bakho abangaphansi kwesandla sethu, begodu asikho isifazane esisengozini.
Siyazisa, ngalokho, isipho kuYehova, ngazo zonke izinto zegolide esizitholayo, amabhande, namabhande, nezibopho, nezingcezu, namahlombe, ukuze sizinikele kukaNkulunkulu.
UMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli bathathe igolide kubo, lakhiwa zonke izinto zokuzigqoka.
Igolide lonke, labo abaphathi bezinkulungwane nezikhulu zamakhulu, ababelinikela njengomnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, kwakungushekeli elilodwa nesishiyagalombili lezigidi ezingu-16.
Wonke wesibhakabhaka wathatha iphoyinti lakhe.
UMoses no-Elazare umbingeleli bathatha igolide lamadodana ezigidini, namadodana emakhulu, babelimaza lisetentweni yokuhlangana, ukuze kube yinkundla yokukhumbula abantu bakaSirayeli.
Babona bona iJazeri neGiliyadi yindawo engcono khulu yokudla izinkomo, begodu uRubhen noGadi babe nezilwane ezifuywayo eziningi.
Amadodana kaGadi namadodana kaRubhen afike kuMoses, no-Elazare umbingeleli, nabakhulu bomphakathi, bathi,
no-Ataroth, no-Dibon, no-Yazer, no-Nimrah, no-Heshbon, no-Elealeh, no-Shebam, no-Nebo, no-Beon,
Le lizwe, ikosi alike walimaza phambi kwebandla lakwaSirayeli, izwe elilungile izilwane; begodu thina abakhonzi bakho sinezinja eziningi.
Bathi ke, Uma ubona bona silungile emehlo akho, lithunyelwe izwe labo abakhonzi bakho, libe yilungelo lethu; ungasidlulisanga iJordani.
Wathi uMoses kubonyana bakaGadi nakwaRubheni, Ingabe abazalwane benu, amadodana aseSirayeli, azoya emkhosini, nihlala lapha?
Kungani na bona nikhohlise izingane zakwaSirayeli, ukuze zingayidlula izwe ikosi awabanikela ngalo?
Ngalokho abababa bakho bakwenze, lapho ngibathumela eKadeshe-barnea ukuba babone izwe.
Baye benyuka, bafika emfuleni i-Eshkole, babheka izwe; begodu bavimbela amakhosi aseSirayeli bona angangeni ezweni ikosi abewanikela ngalo.
UYehova wagwetshwa ngalolu busuku, wathi:

Wonke umuntu ophuma eYiputa, oneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala nangaphezulu, ngeke abone izwe engikhuluma ngalo ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngenxa yokuthi abangitholanga ngenhliziyo sabo yonke.
UKalebe unyana kaJefune, umKenisi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune kuphela abazokubona; ngombana balandela ikosi intliziyo sabo yonke.
Wagwema ikosi isizwe samaSirayeli, wabashiya behamba esiqhingini iminyaka engama-40, kuze kube sekuphele isigaba soke esikwenzele okumbi phambi kwakhe.
Begodu manje, bhekani, niyinjabulo entsha yobubi, nithatha indawo yababa benu, ukuze niphuze inhliziyo kaYehova ngabaseSirayeli!
Uma nje nibuyela emuva, ningamlandelanga yena, uzophinde ashiye labo bonke abantu ezweni lesiqhingi; begodu nizoba yingozi sabo.
Bafike kuMoses bathi: "Sifuna ukwakha izindlu zezilwane zethu kanye nezindawo zokuhlala zabantwana bethu.
Sizozivikela, sizobhekana namadodakazi kaSirayeli, kuze kube sekufikeni kwabo ezweni labo; begodu izingane zethu zizohlala emizini enezindlu eziqinile, ziphephile kilabo bantu basezweni.
Sizobuyela ekhaya lethu kuze kube yilapho wonke umSirayeli ethola izwe lakhe.
Sizohlala nathi, begodu sizohlala ndawonye nabo ezweni elingaphandle kweYorodani; ngombana sithole izwe lethu lapha, ngasenyakatho yeYorodani.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Uma nikwenza lo msebenzi, uma nizibophezela emdlalweni phambi koYehova,
begodu bonke abantu bakho abaqeqeshiwe badlula iJordani phambi kweNkosi, kuze asuse izitha zakhe phambi kwakhe;
begodu izwe linqobelwe phambi koYehova, khona-ke nizobuya; nizowenza umsebenzi wenu kuYehova, nakwaSirayeli; begodu leli lizwe lizoba yinkontileka yenu phambi koYehova.
Uma ke ningakwenza lokhu, khona-ke nizosindisa isono senu phambi koYehova, begodu niziqiniseke bona isono senu sizokufinyelela.
Yakha izindlu zabantwana bakho namahhashi akho, begodu yenza lokho okushoyo."
Bathi oonyana bakaGadi noRubheni kuMoses, bathi, Ngokungafani nalokho owawusho ngawo unkosi wethu, sizokwenza thina abakhonzi bakho.
Abantwana bethu, namadodana ethu, nezilwane zethu, nazo zonke izinyamazane zethu, zizohlala lapha emizini kaGiliyadi.
Sizodlula thina bonke abakhonzi bakho, wonke umuntu ogqoke isibhamu sokulwa, ukubhekana nomlilo phambi koYehova, njengokuthi unkosi wethu uthi.
Wathi uMoses ku-Elazare umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, wathi kubo:

Wathi kubo, Uma izingane zikaGadi nezingane zikaRubhen zidlula ndawonye nani iJordani, wonke umuntu ogqoke isibhamu sokulwa, phambi koYehova, begodu izwe linqobelwe phambi kwenu, khona-ke nizobanika izwe laseGiliyadi libe yindawo sabo.
Kodwana uma bengeke badlule nawe, begqoke izibhamu zabo, khona-ke bazothatha inkontileka yakho ezweni laseKanana.
Baphendula amadodana kaGadi namadodana kaRubhen, bathi, Njengokuthi ikosi atjhilo, sizokwenza thina abakhonzi bakho.
Sizodlula sigqoke isibhamu phambi kweNkosi, sifike ezweni laseKanana; kodwana izwe lethu lomhlaba lizoba ngasenyakatho yeYorodani.

Wabanikeza uMoses amaGadi, namaRubheni, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, unyana kaYosefu, isizwe sikaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, nesizwe sikaOg, ukumkani waseBhashani, izwe lonke, namadolobha ayo, nelizwe labo elijikelezayo.
Amadodana kaGadi akhiwa iDiboni, ne-Ataroti, ne-Aroere,
u-Atrothi-shofani, no-Yazeri, no-Yogbeha,
NaseBeth-nimra, nasebe-Beth-harani, ezindaweni ezinezindlu eziqinile; begodu bakwakha amabhodwe ezilwanyana zabo.
Amadodana kaRubhen akhiwa iHeshboni, neElealeh, neKiriyatayim,
kanye neNebo, noBaale-mehon (abaguqule amagama abo), noSibma; babeka amagama amasha ezifundeni labo ababezikwakha.
Baye eGileyadi, bayisabalalisa, bakhipha ama-Amori ahlala khona.
UMoses wabanika iGiliyadi izingane zikaMakhire, unyana kaManase; bahlala khona.
UYahiri, umfazi waseManase, wahlasela namanye amadolobhana, wababiza bona amadolobhana kaYahiri.
Wathatha noNobha iKenati nezindawo zayo, wayibiza bona iNobha, ngegama lakhe.
Lezi ziyizindawo zokuhamba kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, lapho bephuma ezweni laseYiputa, ngoMosesi noAron, ngokwemikhosi sabo.
Wabhala ke uMoses, ngokusho komthetho kaYehova, imizila sabo yokuhamba; lezo ziyimizila sabo, kusukela emgwaqweni wokuthoma kuze kube emgwaqweni wokugcina.
Basuka eRameshe, ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yokuqala, ngosuku olulandelayo kosuku lwepasha; baphuma ngesandla esiqinile, phambi kwamehlo wonke amaMishi.
njengombana ama-Egipta enyamalala khona wonke umzali wesifazane wabo, owabulalayo ikosi; begodu ikosi wagwema izitha zabo.
Basuka abantu bakaSirayeli eRameshe, bamisa isikhashana eSukoti.
Basuka eSukhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Ethame, enkabeni yesiqhingi.
Basuka eEtham, babuyela ePi-Hahirothi, enyakatho yeBaale-zephoni, bamisa isicampani eMigdoli.
Basuka ePi-Hahirothi, bahamba phakathi kolwandle, befika esiqhingini; bahamba amalanga amathathu esiqhingini sama-Ethamu, bamisa ikosi eMara.
Basuka eMara, bafika ku-Elim; khona lapho bekukhona izimpophoma zezintaba ezingu-12, nezihlahla zendabuko eziyisixhenxe.
Basuka e-Elim, bamisa isikhashana emfuleni omnyama.
Basuka eMfuleni Omnyama, bamisa isikhashana esiqhingini saseSin.
Basuka esiqhingini sase-Sin, bafudukela eDofka.
Basuka eDophkah bamisa ikhempu eAlush.
Basuka e-Alushe, bamisa isibhedlela e-Refidim; kwakungekho khona amanzi abantu abawadla.
Basuka eRefidim, bamisa isikhashana emfuleni iSina.
Basuka eSinayini, bamisa isikhashana eKibrothi-hataava.
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bafudukela eHaserothi.
Basuka eHazerothi, bamisa isikhashana eRithma.
Basuka eRithmah bamisa ikhempu eRimmon Perez.
Basuka eRimon-perezi, bamisa isikhashana eLibna.
Basuka eLibna, bamisa isiqhingi eRisa.
Basuka eRisa, bamisa ikosi eKehelatha.
Basuka eKehelatha, bafudukela emfuleni iShepher.
Basuka eMount Shepher bamisa ikhempu eHarada.
Basuka eHarada, bafudukela eMakhelothi.
Basuka eMakhelothi, bamisa isikhashana eTahati.
Basuka eTahati, bamisa isicampani eTera.
Basuka eThera, bamisa isikhashana eMithkah.
Basuka eMithkah, bafudukela eHashmonah.
Basuka eHashmonah, bamisa isikhashana eMoseroth.
Basuka eMoserothi, bafudukela eBene Jaakan.
Bashiya i-Bene Jaakan basuka eHor Haggidgad.
Basuka eHore-hagidigadi, bamisa isikhashana eYotbata.
Basuka eYotbata, bamisa isikhashana e-Abrona.
Basuka e-Abronah, bamisa isibhedlela e-Ezion-geberi.
Basuka e-Ezion-geberi, bamisa isikhashana eKadeshi, emfuleni iZin.
Basuka eKadeshi, bamisa isikhashana emfuleni iHori, enhliziyweni yezwe laseEdomu.

U-Aron umbingeleli wehla emfuleni iHore, ngokusho komyalo kaYehova; wafa khona lapho ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yesihlanu, ngonyaka omashumi amane ngemuva kokuphuma kwabantu bakaSirayeli ezweni laseYiputa.
UAron ubeneminyaka engu-123 ubudala, lapho efa khona emfuleni iHor.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaKanana wase-Aradi, owahlala ezweni laseNtshonalanga, ezweni laseKanana, bona abantu bakaSirayeli befika.
Basuka emfuleni iHori, bamisa isicampani eSalmona.
Basuka eZalmona, bamisa icamp ePunon.
Basuka ePunon, bamisa isikhashana eObhothi.
Basuka e-Obhothi, bamisa isikhashana e-Iye-abarim, emfuleni waseMowabi.
Basuka e-Iyim, bamisa isikhashana eDiboni-Gad.
Basuka eDiboni-Gadi, bafudukela eAlmon-diblathaim.
Basuka eAlmon-diblathaim, bamisa isikhashana emadolobheni aseAbarim, eNebo.
Basuka emadolobheni ase-Abarim, bamisa isiqalo ezindaweni ezihlaba umxhwele zaseMowabhi, eduze komfula iJordani, ngaphesheya kweYericho.
Bamisa khona ezindaweni eziphakeme zaseMowabi, eduze kweYordan, kusukela eBhethi-yeshimothi kuya eAbeli-shithini.
Wakhuluma ikosi kuMoses, ezindaweni ezihlabani zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan enkabeni kaJericho, wathi,
"Ubatshele izingane zakwaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nidlula iJordani ezweni lakwaKanana,
Uzokhipha zonke izizwe ezihlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwenu; uzobulala yonke imihlobiso sabo, nezithombe zabo zegolide, begodu uzobaphula zonke izakhiwo zawo eziphakeme.
Niyithathe izwe, nihlale kulo; ngombana ngikulethela leli lizwe libe yilungelo lakho.

Yabelana izwe phakathi kwamaqembu akho ngokushaya inkontileka. Nceda unikele inkontileka enkulu kumaqembu amakhulu begodu inkontileka encane kumaqembu amancane. Noma yisiphi isifunda lapho inkontileka iphuma khona kinanyana iyiphi inkontileka izobe yaba sabo. Yabelana phakathi kwamaqembu obaba bakho
Uma ningawakhuphula amadolobha ayo, labo abashiyeyo bazobe yizicubu eenhliziyweni zenu, namahlombe enkundleni yenu; begodu bazoba yingozi yenu ezweni elihlala kulona.
Ngalokho ngizokwenza kuwe lokho engicabanga bona ngizokwenza kubo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 25"Ubatshele abantu bakaSirayeli bona: Uma nifika ezweni laseKanana, leli yizwe elizobe linikezwa wena njengomhlaba wakho womndeni.
Icala lakho lasenyakatho lizohlanganisa nengxenye yesiqhingi sase-Zin, ngaphesheya komgwaqo wase-Edom. Enyakatho, umgwaqo wakho osenyakatho uzoqala engxenyeni esenyakatho yolwandle olufile.
ibuye ibe ngepumalanga yeSkorpion Pass, iqhubekele eZin, ihambe ngepumalanga yeKadeshe-barnea, iphele eHazar Addar, ifike eAzmon.
Kusuka e-Azmon izoshintsha ibheke emfuleni ogwini lwe-Egypt begodu iphele eMfula iMedithera.
Umkhawulo wakho wasenyakatho uzobe ulwandle lwaseMedithera. Lokhu kuzoba umkhawulo wakho enyakatho.
Isifunda sakho sasentshonalanga, cindezela umgwaqo osuka eMedithera kuya eMount Hor
begodu kusukela emfuleni uHori, kuze kube yilapho kungena khona eHamati; begodu umkhawulo uzodlula eSedadi,
bese udlula eSiphroni, uphele eHazari-enani. Lokhu kuzobe yimikhawulo yenu yasenyakatho.
Isifunda sakho sasenyakatho, zobambisa umgwaqo osuka eHazar Enan ufike eShepham.
Kuze kube yilapho umkhawulo usuka eShepham udlula eRibla, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeAyin. Kuze kube yilapho umkhawulo usuka khona ezindaweni ezisempumalanga zolwandle lwaseGaliliya.
Uzodlula emfuleni iYorodani, ufike esiphethweni saso eMfula iYorodani. Lokhu kuzobe yizwe lenu, kanye nezindawo eziphakathi kwayo zonke.
UMoses wamisa oonyana bakaSirayeli, wathi, Le yilizwe lokuthi niyihlukanise phakathi kwenu ngesinqumo, njengombana ikosi ewiselayo ukuba linikezelwe izizwe eziyisishiyagalombili nengxenye.
Ngokuba isizwe sakwaRubheni, nesizwe sakwaGadi, ngezindlu zazo, kanye nengxenye yesizwe samaManase, bathole impahla sabo.
Lezi zinhlanga ezimbili nengxenye zazo zithole inhlalakahle yazo ngasenyakatho yeJordani, eduze kweJericho, enyakatho-mpumalanga.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Lawona amagama amadoda azowahlukanisela izwe phakathi kwenu: u-Eleazar umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNuni.
Khetha begodu umholi owodwa wesizwe ngayinye ukuze usize ukuhlukanisa izwe.
Lawona amagama abo: ezweni likaYuda, uKhalebe unyana kaJefune.
ezweni likaSimeoni, uShemuyeli unyana ka-Amihudi.
Ezweni likaBhenjamini, nguEliyada unyana kaKislon.
Kusuka ezweni likaDan, umholi Bukki unyana kaJogli.
Kwabesilisa oonyana bakaYosefu: kwesifundazwe sikaManase, uHaniyeli unyana ka-Efodi;
begodu ezweni lika-Ephrayim, umholi uKemuyeli unyana kaShiftana.
Ezweni likaZebulun, uMengameli uElizaphane unyana kaFarna.
Ezweni lika-Issakha, umholi uPalthiyeli unyana ka-Azzan.
Ezweni lika-Ashere, umholi u-Ahhude unyana kaShelomi.
Kwesifundazwe sakwaNaphtali: umholi uPedaheli, unyana ka-Amihudi.
Lokho wukuthi, abantu abashiwo nguYehova ukuba bahlukanise izwe likaKanana phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wakhuluma ikosi kuMoses, ezindaweni ezihlabani zakwaMowabi, ngaseYordan enkabeni kaJericho, wathi,
Wathi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 24"Ubambisene nabantu bakaSirayeli bona banike amaLevi amadolobha azohlala kiwo ezweni labo lempahla sabo; begodu babe nezindawo eziphakathi kwalawo madolobha.
Lawa madolobha azobe uhlala kiwo, begodu izindlu zangasese zizobe zikhona ezilwaneni zabo, nezingulube zabo, nazo zonke izinja zabo.
Izindawo zokudlela zedolobhana ngalinye, ongazinika labo abaLevi, kufanele zifinyelele emgwaqweni womgwaqo wedolobha, kuze kube ngamasentimitha ayishumi nesishiyagalombili.

Ngaphesheya komgwaqo, ulinganisele imitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho, nemitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho, nemitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni esenyakatho, nemitha eyishumi nesishiyagalombili engxenyeni yasenyakatho, nomgwaqo ubephakathi. Lokhu kuzobe yindawo sabo yokudla.

Ezindaweni eziyisishiyagalombili nizozinikela kilabo abaLevi, zibe yizindawo zokuphepha, ukuze umuntu obulalayo akwazi ukungena kuzo; naphezu kwalezi zidolobhana zinikelwe izizwe ezimashumi amane anembini.
Zonke lezi zidolobhana nizozinikela kumaLevi, zibe yizindawo ezingu-48 kanye nezifunda zawo.

Nasezindaweni zedolobhana ongazinikela ngazo kumaLevi, ezweni lamadodana kaSirayeli, kulowo owake waba mkhulu, uthathe amadolobha amanengi, begodu kulowo owake waba ncane, uthathe amadolobhana ambalwa; isizwe ngayinye sizonikela ngamaLevi emadolobheni ayo, ngokuya ngomhlaba wayo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
"Ubatshele izingane zakwaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma nidlula iJordani ezweni lakwaKanana,
Khetha amanye amadolobhana abe ngamadolobhana akho okuphepha. Umntu obulala umuntu ngengozi angahamba khona ukuvikela.
Lezi zifundazwe zizobe ziyindawo ephephile yomndeni ofuna ukukhokhela emuva ukubulala, ukuze umuntu ophenywa ngokubulala angafa ngaphambi kokuba abhekene necala phambi kweqembu.
Izindawo eziyisishiyagalombili ozozinika zizobe ziyizindawo zakho eziphephile.
Amadolobha amathathu azobe enyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, amadolobha amathathu azobe ezweni laseKanana; amadolobhana okuthula azoba khona.

Lawa madolobhana ayisishiyagalombili azobe ephephile kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, nalabo abavela kwamanye amazwe, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwabo, ukuze wonke umuntu onquma ukubulala umuntu ngephutha, ahambe khona.
Kodwana uma umuntu eshaya omunye umuntu ngento yensimbi, begodu lowo muntu efile, yena ngumuntu obulalayo. Umbulalayo kumele abulawa.
Uma umuntu enetshe esandla sakhe, elingakwazi ukubulala, lishaya omunye umuntu, begodu lowo muntu aphile, yena ngumuntu obulalayo. Lo muntu obulalayo kumele abulawa.
Uma umuntu enesitho somthi esandleni sakhe esingabulala, begodu eshaya omunye umuntu begodu lowo muntu efile, yena uyisisulu. Isisulu kufanele sibulawa.
Umngane okhokhela ukubulala kufanele asuse umbulalayo ngokwakhe. Uma etholakele, kufanele asuse umbulalayo.
Uma umuntu ecindezela omunye umuntu ngenxa yokuthi uyamthanda, noma ethutha enye into kuye ngenhloso kusukela endaweni yokufihla, ukuze aphile,

noma, uma ebulala umuntu ngesandla sakhe ngenxa yobugebengu, ukuze aphile, lowo obulalayo kumele abulawe; yena ngumuntu obulalayo. Uma umndeni womuntu obulalayo ethola lo muntu obulalayo, kufanele amfeze.
Kodwana-ke, umuntu angase acindezele omunye umuntu ngasikhathi sinye ngaphandle kokukhohlisa yena, noma athole into kuye ngaphandle kokwenza isinqumo,
noma, ngaphandle kokubona yena, throw phezu kwakhe itshe elincane ngokwanele ukubulala, ukuze aphele, begodu akayena umnakwabo wakhe, begodu akhenge afuna ukubuhlungu.
Ngalokho-ke iqembu kumele ligweme phakathi komuntu obulalayo nomndeni ofuna ukukhokhela ukubulala, ngokuya ngalezi mithetho.

Umphakathi kufanele ugweme umsolwa wokubulala emndenini ofuna ukuxosha, begodu wambuyisele edolobhaneni lakhe eliphephile lapho waphuma khona; kumele ahlale khona kuze kube yilapho umpristi omkhulu ohlotshiswe ngowoyela ongcwele efa.
Kodwana uma umuntu ophenywe ngokubulala efika ngaphandle komkhawulo wedolobha eliphephile lapho ehamba khona,
begodu umngane wakhe atholakale ngaphandle kwedolobha, wabulala yena, umngane wakhe ngeke abe necala lokufa.
Uzohlala edolobhaneni lakhe eliphephile, kuze kube sekufa umbingeleli omkhulu; kodwana ngemuva kokufa kombingeleli omkhulu, uzobuya ezweni lakhe.
Lezo zinto ziyimithetho nemibandela yenu, nemindeni yenu yonke, lapho nihlala khona.
Uma umuntu ebulala umuntu, kufanele abulawe njengomuntu obulalayo ngokusho kwamasosha. Akukho mntu ozodlalwa ngokusho kwasosha olunye kuphela.
Musani ukuthatha inhlawulo yokubulala umuntu ofanele ukufa; kufanele abulawa.
Uma umuntu ephuma emzini wakhe wokuvikela, ngeke nithathe inkontileka yokumvumela bona abuye ahlale ezweni lakhe, ngaphambi kokuba umpristi omkhulu aphele.
Ngalokho-ke, ukubulala kuyinhlekelele yezwe. Nokho, akukho lutho oluzolungisa izwe phambi kuka-Allah uma umuntu ebulawa, ngaphandle kokufa komuntu obulalayo.
Mhlawumbe niyihlanze izwe lapho nihlala khona, izwe lapho ngihlala khona; ngombana mina ikosi ngihlala phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Bafike abaphathi bezindlu zakwaGileyadi, uGileyadi indodana kaMakhire, indodana kaManase, ezindaweni zomndeni wakwaYosefu; bakhuluma kuMoses, nabaphathi, abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli.

Bathi, Kosi yami, ikosi akuwisela umthetho wokuthi uhlukanise izwe phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ngokufaka isikhunta; begodu ikosi akuwisela umthetho wokuthi ubenike izwe likaZelofehadi, umngane wethu, izingane zakhe.
Uma behlala ezindaweni ezahlukene zakwaSirayeli, khona-ke izwe labo lizothathwa ezweni lemindeni yethu, begodu lizofakwa ezweni lesifundazwe lapho bazohlala khona; ngalokho sizoba nengxenye encane.
Uma unyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili wamadodana kaSirayeli ufika, khona-ke izwe labo lizofakwa ezweni lesifundazwe esibophezela kulo; begodu lizothathwa ezweni lesifundazwe sababa bethu.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, ngokusho komthetho kaYehova, wathi, Isizwe sabantwana bakaYosefu sikhuluma kahle.
Lokhu wumthetho kaYehova mayelana nezingane zikaZelofehadi, ethi: Bazokwazi ukushada nalowo abawuthandayo; uma nje befuna ukushada nomuntu osuka emndenini wesizwe soyise wabo.
Akufanele izwe ezweni lakwaSirayeli lidlule kusuka kuhlanga elilodwa kuya kolunye; wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli kufanele agcine izwe leqembu lakhe.
Intombazane ngayinye, uma ithola isizwe ezweni lamadodana kaSirayeli, kufanele ibe nguwesifazane wesizwe sikayise, ukuze wonke amadodana kaSirayeli athole isizwe sabafazi bakhe.
Akukho lizwe elizodluliswa kusuka emndenini owodwa kuya komunye, ngombana wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli kufanele agcine izwe lakhe.
Wakwenza ke uZelofehadi, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Namadodakazi kaZelofehadi, uMahala, noThirsa, noHogela, noMilka, noNowa, bashada nabangani babo bomndeni wabo.
Bathe bazalwa uManase, indodana kaYosefu; begodu izwe labo lahlala emndenini nosukundelweni bukababa babo.
Lawa amalungiselelo, nalawo mthetho, akhuluma ngawo ikosi kuboSirayeli ngesandla sikaMoses, ezindaweni ezingenamanzi zaseMowabi, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeYorodani, eJericho.
